zh.tag: 让编程 Agent 先给答案、别绕弯子的输出规范技能
zh.what: 这是一个给编程助手（coding agent）用的输出风格技能，强制它先给行动、再给解释，用编号步骤代替长篇铺垫。它不改变模型能力，只改变回答的组织方式，让结果像给 ADHD 用户看的一样直接。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md 里的 10 条规则，外加 INSTALL.md 安装说明、AGENTS.md 给 agent 的指引，以及多语言 README 和 logo。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，本质是 Markdown 技能文件，通过 Claude 插件市场（claude plugin marketplace）安装，可 fork 后自行改规则。
zh.hot: 它精准戳中「AI 回答又长又绕」的痛点，用极简规则给出可感知的前后对比，今日新增 4650 star、总数 34632，直接冲上 GitHub 日榜第一。
uses: 每天被 AI 长回复淹没、只想快速拿到下一步操作的开发者
用 Claude 等 coding agent 写代码、希望输出更紧凑的团队
想自定义 agent 输出规范、愿意 fork 改 SKILL.md 的进阶用户

en.tag: A skill that stops your coding agent from burying the answer
en.what: It's an output-style skill for coding agents that forces action-first answers with numbered steps instead of long preambles. It doesn't change model capability, only how responses are organized, making them ADHD-friendly and to the point.
en.content: The core is a 10-rule SKILL.md under skills/i-have-adhd/, plus INSTALL.md, an AGENTS.md for agents, multilingual READMEs, and a logo.
en.stack: Python is the listed language, but it's essentially a Markdown skill file installed via the Claude plugin marketplace and forkable for custom rules.
en.hot: It nails the pain of bloated AI answers with a simple rule set and a clear before/after demo, gaining 4,650 stars today to 34,632 total and hitting #1 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers drowning in long AI replies who just want the next action
Teams using coding agents like Claude who want tighter, more actionable output
Advanced users who want to fork and customize the SKILL.md rules

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 跨平台 iOS 侧载工具，一键安装 SideStore 并导入配对文件
zh.what: iloader 是一款面向普通用户的 iOS 侧载工具，帮助你在电脑上给 iPhone/iPad 安装 SideStore 等应用。它会自动导入证书和 rppairing/lockdown 配对文件，并支持导入任意 IPA、管理配对文件与吊销开发证书。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用源码（含本地化文件 src/loc*）、构建工作流与发布配置，官网 iloader.app 是唯一官方下载渠道。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，桌面端应用，依赖 usbmuxd（Windows 需 iTunes，macOS 自带，Linux 视发行版而定），并提供 NixOS flake 与社区维护的 Homebrew/AUR/COPR 包。
zh.hot: iOS 侧载长期缺少好用的跨平台图形工具，iloader 把繁琐的配对与证书流程自动化，今日新增 50 star、总数 2908，冲上 GitHub 日榜第 3。
uses: 想给 iPhone/iPad 安装 SideStore 或任意 IPA 的普通 iOS 用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 上管理配对文件与开发证书的进阶玩家
希望本地化 iloader 到更多语言的翻译贡献者

en.tag: Cross-platform iOS sideloader that installs SideStore and imports pairing files with ease
en.what: iloader is a user-friendly iOS sideloading tool that helps you install SideStore and other apps onto your iPhone/iPad from a computer. It automatically imports certificates and rppairing/lockdown pairing files, and supports importing any IPA, managing pairing files, and revoking development certificates.
en.content: The repo contains the TypeScript desktop app source (including localization files under src/loc*), build workflows, and release configuration; iloader.app is the only official download channel.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript as a desktop app, it depends on usbmuxd (iTunes on Windows, built-in on macOS, distro-dependent on Linux), and ships a NixOS flake plus community-maintained Homebrew/AUR/COPR packages.
en.hot: iOS sideloading has long lacked a good cross-platform GUI tool; iloader automates the tedious pairing and certificate flow, gaining 50 stars today for a total of 2,908 and hitting #3 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Everyday iOS users who want to install SideStore or any IPA on their iPhone/iPad
Advanced users managing pairing files and development certificates on Windows/macOS/Linux
Translation contributors who want to localize iloader into more languages

zh.tag: 开源自托管 AI 销售 CRM，原生 AI 代理接管 WhatsApp 聊天
zh.what: DeskcommCRM 是一个开源的 AI 销售操作系统，把能接待、筛选并促成成交的 AI 代理直接嵌进 CRM，通过 WhatsApp（WAHA）与客户对话。它是 Kommo、Octadesk、Intercom 的开源替代品，数据自持、无月费、无功能锁。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用主体、WAHA 的 WhatsApp 集成、Supabase 数据库与认证、多租户与 LGPD 合规逻辑，以及 hostgator-setup-kit 一键部署脚本和架构/路线图文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 TypeScript（strict）+ Next.js 16，后端依赖 Supabase（Postgres、Auth、Storage），WhatsApp 通道使用 WAHA，支持 MCP、多租户与自托管部署。
zh.hot: 上线不久即冲到 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，今日新增 152 star、总数 1347，说明拉美市场对「开源 + WhatsApp 原生 AI 销售」的需求被长期压抑。
uses: 通过 WhatsApp 成交的中小企业与销售团队，想摆脱 Kommo/Octadesk 的月费与功能锁定
需要数据主权与 LGPD 合规、希望把 CRM 跑在自己 VPS 上的巴西及拉美公司
想给现有销售流程加 AI 代理、并接入 MCP 生态的开发者与集成商
寻找 Intercom 开源替代、重视自托管与多租户能力的 SaaS 团队

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted AI sales CRM with native AI agents on WhatsApp
en.what: DeskcommCRM is an open-source AI sales OS that embeds AI agents capable of greeting, qualifying and closing deals directly inside a CRM, conversing with customers over WhatsApp (WAHA). It positions itself as the open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk and Intercom, with self-owned data, no monthly fees and no locked features.
en.content: The repo contains the Next.js app, WhatsApp integration via WAHA, Supabase database and auth, multi-tenant and LGPD compliance logic, plus a hostgator-setup-kit one-command deploy script and architecture/roadmap docs.
en.stack: Built with strict TypeScript and Next.js 16, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), using WAHA for the WhatsApp channel, with MCP support, multi-tenancy and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: It hit #4 on GitHub Trending with 152 stars added today and 1,347 total, showing pent-up demand in LATAM for an open-source, WhatsApp-native AI sales tool.
uses: SMBs and sales teams closing deals on WhatsApp who want to escape Kommo/Octadesk monthly fees and locked features
Brazilian and LATAM companies needing data sovereignty and LGPD compliance by running the CRM on their own VPS
Developers and integrators adding AI agents to existing sales flows and plugging into the MCP ecosystem
SaaS teams seeking an open-source Intercom alternative with self-hosting and multi-tenancy

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程代理桌面工作台，自带模型、插件可扩展
zh.what: PI-Desktop 是一个本地优先的桌面应用，为 AI 编程代理提供独立工作空间，支持打开任意本地项目并让代理自主工作。它不强制账号或中转服务，用户可自带模型，并保持对流程的控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面端、Rust 主机核心、pi Agent Harness 以及可安装插件系统，并配有文档、截图和发布包。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，结合 Electron 和 Rust 主机核心，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 项目今日新增 417 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名，反映出开发者对本地优先、可自控的 AI 编程代理桌面工具的高度关注。
uses: 希望脱离终端和编辑器插件、在独立桌面环境中使用 AI 编程代理的开发者
需要自带模型（如 OpenAI、Anthropic 或本地模型）并保持数据本地化的团队
想要通过插件扩展代理能力、管理多项目与长会话的高级用户

en.tag: Local-first desktop workspace for AI coding agents with bring-your-own-model and plugins
en.what: PI-Desktop is a local-first desktop app that gives AI coding agents their own workspace, letting them open any local project and work autonomously. It requires no account or mandatory relay, supports bring-your-own-model, and keeps users in control.
en.content: The repo contains an Electron desktop app, a Rust host core, the pi Agent Harness, and a user-installable plugin system, along with docs, screenshots, and release builds.
en.stack: The stack is primarily TypeScript with Electron and a Rust host core, supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.hot: It gained 417 stars today and ranked 12th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong developer interest in local-first, controllable AI coding agent desktop tools.
uses: Developers who want AI coding agents in a standalone desktop workspace instead of a terminal or editor extension
Teams that need bring-your-own-model (OpenAI, Anthropic, or local models) and local data control
Advanced users who want to extend agent capabilities via plugins and manage multiple projects and long-running sessions

zh.tag: 开源3D PBR纹理绘制工具，支持多平台
zh.what: ArmorPaint 是一款用于 3D PBR 纹理绘制的软件，允许艺术家在 3D 模型上直接绘制材质纹理。它由 Armory3D 团队开发，旨在提供免费开源的替代方案，但官方二进制版本需付费以支持项目发展。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码，主要使用 C 语言编写，并提供了构建脚本和文档。目录结构包括 paint（主代码）、base（构建工具和依赖）等，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS、Android、iOS 和 WASM 平台。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 C 语言为核心，使用自定义构建系统（base/make），依赖 clang 编译器和各平台 SDK。支持通过 WASM 在浏览器中运行。
zh.hot: ArmorPaint 在 GitHub 上获得了 4419 颗星，今日新增 72 星，登上 Trending 日榜第 10 名。其热度源于开源 3D 纹理绘制工具的稀缺性以及跨平台支持，吸引了开发者和艺术家的关注。
uses: 3D 艺术家和游戏开发者 —— 用于为模型绘制 PBR 纹理，无需昂贵商业软件。
开源爱好者与贡献者 —— 可参与开发，改进工具功能或移植到新平台。
教育工作者与学生 —— 作为学习 3D 纹理绘制的免费工具，降低学习成本。

en.tag: Open-source 3D PBR texture painting tool with multi-platform support
en.what: ArmorPaint is a software for 3D PBR texture painting, enabling artists to paint textures directly on 3D models. Developed by the Armory3D team, it aims to provide a free and open-source alternative, though official binaries are paid to fund the project.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, primarily written in C, along with build scripts and documentation. The directory structure includes paint (main code), base (build tools and dependencies), and supports Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, and WASM platforms.
en.stack: The tech stack is centered on C, using a custom build system (base/make), and depends on clang compiler and platform SDKs. It supports running in browsers via WASM.
en.hot: ArmorPaint has gained 4,419 stars on GitHub, with 72 new stars today, ranking 10th on the Trending daily list. Its popularity stems from the scarcity of open-source 3D texture painting tools and cross-platform support, attracting developers and artists.
uses: 3D artists and game developers — for painting PBR textures on models without expensive commercial software.
Open-source enthusiasts and contributors — can participate in development, improve features, or port to new platforms.
Educators and students — as a free tool for learning 3D texture painting, reducing learning costs.

zh.tag: 跨千余市场的开源自主 AI 交易代理，支持预测市场与加密合约
zh.what: Clodds 是一个自托管的个人 AI 交易终端，基于 Claude 驱动，可在预测市场、加密现货、永续合约、代币发行和 Bittensor 子网挖矿中自主扫描套利机会并即时执行。它还能通过自然对话管理投资组合，并内置机器对机器支付的代理商业协议。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的交易代理核心、118+ 交易策略、21 个消息平台接入、WebChat 界面，以及覆盖 10 个预测市场和 7 个期货交易所的适配器。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 22+ 和 TypeScript 5.3，通过 npm 全局安装，依赖 Claude 模型，集成 Solana（Jupiter、Pump.fun、Raydium 等）与多条 EVM 链。
zh.hot: 上线 12 天即获 1647 星、今日新增 277 星，冲上 GitHub 日榜第 4，14 天内被克隆 10.7k 次，叠加 Colosseum 黑客松与加密交易热度。
uses: 加密交易者：希望用 AI 自动扫描预测市场与合约套利机会
开发者：想研究或二次开发自主交易代理与代理支付协议
量化爱好者：需要多交易所、多链的统一交易终端与策略库
自托管用户：重视隐私，想在自己机器上运行交易机器人

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI trading agent across 1000+ prediction and crypto markets
en.what: Clodds is a self-hosted personal AI trading terminal powered by Claude that autonomously scans for edge and executes trades across prediction markets, crypto spot, perpetual futures, token launches, and Bittensor subnet mining. It also manages portfolios through natural conversation and ships an agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript trading agent core, 118+ trading strategies, integrations for 21 messaging platforms, a WebChat UI, and adapters covering 10 prediction markets and 7 futures exchanges.
en.stack: Built on Node.js 22+ and TypeScript 5.3, installed globally via npm, powered by Claude, with Solana (Jupiter, Pump.fun, Raydium, etc.) and multiple EVM chain integrations.
en.hot: It gained 1,647 stars in 12 days with 277 added today, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending, plus 10.7k clones in 14 days, fueled by the Colosseum hackathon and crypto trading hype.
uses: Crypto traders who want AI to auto-scan prediction markets and futures arbitrage
Developers researching or extending autonomous trading agents and agent payment protocols
Quant enthusiasts needing a unified multi-exchange, multi-chain trading terminal and strategy library
Self-hosting users who value privacy and want to run a trading bot on their own machine

zh.tag: 自动构建个人知识库的跨平台桌面应用
zh.what: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，能自动将你的文档转化为结构化、互链的知识库。它不采用传统 RAG 每次从零检索的方式，而是让 LLM 增量构建并维护一个持久的 Wiki。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，涵盖多格式文档解析、多模态图像处理、知识图谱构建、向量语义搜索、持久化摄入队列以及 Rust 后端聊天代理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，结合 Rust 后端，依赖 LanceDB 进行向量搜索，支持 OpenAI 兼容的模型端点，并集成 Tavily、SerpApi、SearXNG 等搜索服务。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 142 颗星，总星数达 18105，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 14 名，因其创新的自动知识库构建方式和强大的多模态处理能力受到关注。
uses: 研究人员和学生——需要从大量文档中自动构建可检索知识库
知识工作者——希望将分散的文档、网页和媒体整合成结构化 Wiki
开发者——想要一个可本地部署、支持自定义模型的 AI 知识管理工具
团队——需要跨设备迁移和共享项目档案的协作场景

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop app that auto-builds a personal knowledge base
en.what: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that automatically turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base. Instead of traditional RAG, the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, covering multi-format document parsing, multimodal image processing, knowledge graph construction, vector semantic search, persistent ingest queue, and a Rust backend chat agent.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript and a Rust backend, using LanceDB for vector search, supporting OpenAI-compatible model endpoints, and integrating search services like Tavily, SerpApi, and SearXNG.
en.hot: With 142 stars added today and a total of 18,105 stars, it ranks 14th on GitHub Trending daily, gaining attention for its innovative auto-knowledge-base approach and powerful multimodal capabilities.
uses: Researchers and students — need to automatically build a searchable knowledge base from large document sets
Knowledge workers — want to integrate scattered documents, web clips, and media into a structured wiki
Developers — seek a locally deployable AI knowledge management tool with custom model support
Teams — require cross-device migration and sharing of project archives for collaboration

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的技能框架与软件开发方法论
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套面向编码代理的完整软件开发方法论，建立在可组合的 skills 之上，并配有初始指令确保代理自动调用这些技能。它让代理在动手写代码前先厘清需求、产出规格与实现计划，再以子代理驱动的方式逐项完成任务。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本和技能定义文件为主，包含安装与集成说明、基础工作流文档、技能目录（What's Inside）以及哲学与贡献指南等部分。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主要语言，围绕 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot CLI 等多种编码代理 harness 提供插件式安装与技能触发机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 28.4 万 star、日增 688 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3，说明开发者对「让编码代理真正按工程方法论工作」的需求极为强烈。
uses: 希望让编码代理遵循 TDD、YAGNI、DRY 等工程规范的开发团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等代理工具并想提升自主开发可靠性的个人开发者
需要在企业环境中引入代理开发流程与商业支持的技术负责人

en.tag: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills plus initial instructions that make sure the agent actually uses them. Instead of jumping straight into code, the agent teases out a spec, produces an implementation plan, then runs a subagent-driven development loop task by task.
en.content: The repo is mostly Shell scripts and skill definition files, including install/integration docs, the basic workflow, a skills catalog (What's Inside), plus philosophy and contributing sections.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, with plugin-style installation and skill-triggering mechanisms across many coding-agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI.
en.hot: With 284k stars, +688 today and #3 on the GitHub Trending daily chart, it shows huge demand for making coding agents actually follow a real engineering methodology.
uses: Dev teams that want coding agents to follow engineering practices like TDD, YAGNI and DRY
Individual developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor who want more reliable autonomous coding
Tech leads looking to adopt agent-driven development workflows with enterprise support

zh.tag: 面向 Usenet 与 BT 用户的智能剧集 PVR 自动下载管理器
zh.what: Sonarr 是一款剧集 PVR（个人视频录像机）工具，可监控多个 RSS 源，自动抓取、整理并重命名你喜爱剧集的新剧集。它还能扫描已有媒体库补齐缺失剧集，并在出现更高画质版本时自动升级。
zh.content: 仓库为 C# 编写的完整应用源码，包含前端 UI、下载客户端集成、索引器与通知模块，并配有 Logo、翻译与 Open Collective 赞助相关资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C# / .NET 开发，跨平台支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 与树莓派，并集成 SABnzbd、NZBGet、Kodi、Plex 等外部服务。
zh.hot: 作为自建媒体库生态的经典工具，Sonarr 已积累 15736 颗星，今日新增 191 星并登上 GitHub 日榜第 10 名，说明自动化追剧需求依旧旺盛。
uses: 自建媒体服务器（如 Plex、Kodi）用户，希望自动追更剧集
使用 Usenet 或 BT 下载的进阶用户，需要自动抓取与重命名
想统一管理剧集画质升级与失败重试的媒体库管理员

en.tag: Smart PVR for Usenet and BitTorrent users that automates TV episode downloads
en.what: Sonarr is a PVR for Usenet and BitTorrent users that monitors multiple RSS feeds for new episodes of your favorite shows and automatically grabs, sorts and renames them. It can also scan your existing library for missing episodes and auto-upgrade files when a better quality release appears.
en.content: The repo holds the full C# application source, including the web UI, download-client integrations, indexer and notification modules, plus logo, translation and Open Collective sponsorship assets.
en.stack: Built mainly in C# / .NET, it runs cross-platform on Windows, Linux, macOS and Raspberry Pi, and integrates with SABnzbd, NZBGet, Kodi and Plex.
en.hot: A classic in the self-hosted media ecosystem, Sonarr has reached 15,736 stars with 191 added today, ranking 10th on GitHub Trending, showing strong ongoing demand for automated TV management.
uses: Self-hosted media server users (Plex, Kodi) who want automatic episode tracking
Advanced Usenet or BitTorrent users needing automated grabbing and renaming
Media library admins wanting unified quality upgrades and failed-download retries

zh.tag: 专为数学建模打造的自动化 Agent，一键生成可提交论文
zh.what: MathModelAgent 是一个面向数学建模竞赛的 AI Agent，能够自动完成从问题分析、建模、编码、绘图到论文撰写的全流程，最终生成一份格式规范、可直接提交的完整论文。它支持多 Agent 协作与多模型配置，并内置人机协作与容错机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面版安装包（macOS/Windows）、SKILLS 驱动的核心逻辑、17 套 Typst 论文模板、内置建模知识库与 RAG 检索模块，以及 Web 搜索、代码解释器等组件。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，使用 litellm 接入多种大模型，支持 Jupyter 本地代码解释器及 E2B、Daytona 云端解释器，结合 ChromaDB 与 Rerank 实现 RAG，并采用 Typst 排版论文。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 129 星，总星数达 4858，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。其“3 天比赛变 1 小时”的愿景和开箱即用的桌面版极大降低了数学建模门槛，吸引了大量学生与研究者关注。
uses: 参加数学建模竞赛的学生，可快速生成完整论文初稿
需要自动化建模与论文撰写的科研人员或工程师
希望学习数学建模流程与最佳实践的初学者
需要批量处理建模任务并集成自定义模板的团队

en.tag: An agent that automates mathematical modeling and generates submission-ready papers
en.what: MathModelAgent is an AI agent for mathematical modeling competitions that automates the entire workflow—problem analysis, modeling, coding, plotting, and paper writing—to produce a complete, submission-ready paper. It supports multi-agent collaboration, multi-LLM configuration, and includes human-in-the-loop and fault-tolerance mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes desktop installers (macOS/Windows), SKILLS-driven core logic, 17 Typst paper templates, a built-in modeling knowledge base with RAG retrieval, plus web search and code interpreter components.
en.stack: Built in Python, it uses litellm for multi-LLM support, Jupyter local and E2B/Daytona cloud code interpreters, ChromaDB with Rerank for RAG, and Typst for paper typesetting.
en.hot: It gained 129 stars today, reaching 4,858 total and ranking #11 on GitHub Trending daily. Its vision of turning a 3-day competition into 1 hour and the out-of-the-box desktop version greatly lower the barrier to mathematical modeling, attracting many students and researchers.
uses: Students in math modeling competitions who need a complete paper draft quickly
Researchers or engineers seeking automated modeling and paper writing
Beginners wanting to learn the modeling workflow and best practices
Teams needing to batch-process modeling tasks with custom templates

zh.tag: 可插拔传输的 TCP 隧道网络栈研究工具
zh.what: OpenFlux 是一个用 Go 编写的 TCP 隧道工具，客户端运行 SOCKS5 代理，流量经可插拔传输层送到出口节点再转发到互联网。它定位为网络栈研究项目，目前提供 Yandex 与 Max 两种实验性传输方式。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 代码：main.go 提供 client / exit-node 命令行入口，transport/ 目录定义 Transport 接口并实现压缩器与各传输方式，另有 export_ios.go 用于 iOS 静态库的 cgo 桥接。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go（要求 1.26.3+），构建 Android 客户端需 NDK 27+，iOS 客户端需 Xcode 26.6+，出口节点需 Linux VPS/VDS；传输层依赖 Yandex Docs 与 WebRTC DataChannel。
zh.hot: 今日新增 198 star、总数 1149，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名，说明可插拔传输与网络栈研究这一话题正被大量开发者关注。
uses: 网络协议与传输层研究者，用于实验可插拔传输架构
Go 开发者，想学习 SOCKS5 代理与隧道出口节点的实现
需要自建 Linux VPS 出口节点做流量转发的技术用户
关注移动端网络扩展（Android APK / iOS Network Extension）的开发者

en.tag: Network stack research tool: a TCP tunnel with pluggable transports
en.what: OpenFlux is a Go-based TCP tunnel where a client-side SOCKS5 proxy sends traffic through a pluggable transport layer to an exit node that forwards it to the internet. It is framed as a network stack research project, currently shipping two experimental transports, Yandex and Max.
en.content: The repo is mostly Go code: main.go provides the client / exit-node CLI entry, transport/ defines the Transport interface plus a compressor and the transport implementations, and export_ios.go bridges cgo for the iOS static library.
en.stack: Primarily Go (requires 1.26.3+), with Android builds needing NDK 27+ and iOS builds needing Xcode 26.6+, plus a Linux VPS/VDS exit node; transports rely on Yandex Docs and WebRTC DataChannel.
en.hot: It gained 198 stars today for a total of 1,149, landing at #12 on GitHub Trending daily, showing strong developer interest in pluggable transports and network stack research.
uses: Network protocol and transport-layer researchers experimenting with pluggable transport architectures
Go developers wanting to study SOCKS5 proxy and tunnel exit-node implementations
Technical users who run their own Linux VPS exit node for traffic forwarding
Developers interested in mobile network extensions (Android APK / iOS Network Extension)

zh.tag: 把 Claude Code 变成持久化深度研究代理的知识库工具
zh.what: Hyperresearch 是一个代理驱动的深度研究框架，让 Claude Code 按 16 步自适应流水线自动搜集、检索并综合网络资料，产出带完整溯源、经对抗式审计的研究报告。每次读取的来源都会沉淀进持久可搜索的知识库，使后续研究会话越来越聪明。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式发布在 PyPI，核心是 16 步研究流水线、引用核查器、独立性审计与四路对抗批评器，并内置 scholar search 客户端层统一查询 OpenAlex、Crossref、CORE、SEC EDGAR 等八个学术与数据源。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+，通过 PyPI 安装，深度绑定 Claude Code 作为代理运行时，依赖多个学术与公开数据 API（OpenAlex、Crossref、CORE、DOAB、ClinicalTrials.gov、SEC EDGAR、FRED 等）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 153 star、总数 2615，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 13；它宣称在 DeepResearch-Bench RACE 榜领先 Gemini 与 OpenAI Deep Research，加上单次可抓取 250+ 来源、引用逐条核验的卖点，正好切中深度研究代理的热点。
uses: 需要做行业调研、竞品分析或学术综述的研究人员与分析师
希望把零散网页资料沉淀为可复用知识库的开发者与内容团队
想给 Claude Code 加装深度研究流水线的 AI 工程师
关注引用可溯源、反幻觉审计的合规与事实核查场景

en.tag: Turns Claude Code into a persistent deep-research agent with a searchable knowledge vault
en.what: Hyperresearch is an agent-driven deep research harness that turns Claude Code into a pipeline of 16 tier-adaptive steps, collecting, searching and synthesizing web sources into adversarially audited reports with full provenance. Every source read lands in a persistent, searchable vault so each session starts smarter than the last.
en.content: Shipped as a Python package on PyPI, it centers on a 16-step research pipeline, a cite-checker, an independence audit, four parallel adversarial critics, and a scholar-search client layer that unifies eight sources including OpenAlex, Crossref, CORE and SEC EDGAR.
en.stack: Python 3.11+, distributed via PyPI, tightly coupled to Claude Code as the agent runtime, and depends on multiple scholarly and public data APIs such as OpenAlex, Crossref, CORE, DOAB, ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC EDGAR and FRED.
en.hot: It gained 153 stars today for 2,615 total, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily; its claim of leading the DeepResearch-Bench RACE leaderboard ahead of Gemini and OpenAI Deep Research, plus 250+ sources per run and per-citation verification, rides the deep-research agent hype perfectly.
uses: Researchers and analysts doing industry, competitor or literature reviews
Developers and content teams wanting reusable, searchable research vaults
AI engineers adding a deep-research pipeline to Claude Code
Compliance and fact-checking workflows that need citation provenance and anti-hallucination audits

zh.tag: 本地优先的并行科研智能体工作台
zh.what: OpenResearch 把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等编码智能体改造成科研助手，可自动做文献综述、提出假设、跑实验并产出研究产物。它支持多个智能体并行探索不同研究方向，并用 git 原生实验树记录每次运行的不可变快照。
zh.content: 仓库提供桌面应用与 CLI（orx），包含本地仪表盘、实验树管理、技能安装（orx install-skills）以及远程/集群运行支持，另附本地模型接入文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，提供 macOS/Linux 安装脚本，可对接 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 及 LM Studio、Ollama 等本地模型端点。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获约 990 星、单日新增 210 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 3，契合了「让编码智能体自动做科研」这一热门方向。
uses: 想用 AI 智能体自动化文献调研与实验迭代的研究者
需要并行探索多个技术方向并保证实验可复现的工程团队
希望在本地或自有 GPU 集群上运行智能体、掌控数据的开发者
想把 Claude Code、Codex 等编码智能体接入科研工作流的 AI 工具爱好者

en.tag: Local-first workspace for parallel research agents
en.what: OpenResearch turns coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode into research agents that can review literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and produce research artifacts. It lets multiple agents explore directions in parallel while a git-native experiment tree preserves each run's immutable snapshot.
en.content: The repo ships a desktop app plus an orx CLI, including a local dashboard, experiment-tree management, skill installation (orx install-skills), and remote/cluster execution support, along with docs for connecting local models.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it offers macOS/Linux install scripts and integrates with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, plus local model endpoints like LM Studio and Ollama.
en.hot: It quickly reached ~990 stars with 210 added in a day and ranked #3 on the Rust daily trending list, riding the hot wave of using coding agents for automated research.
uses: Researchers who want AI agents to automate literature review and experiment iteration
Engineering teams needing parallel exploration with reproducible experiments
Developers who want to run agents locally or on their own GPU clusters while owning their data
AI tooling enthusiasts looking to plug Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents into research workflows

zh.tag: GitHub 官方的规格驱动开发工具包，让任意 AI 编码代理先写规格再写代码
zh.what: Spec Kit 是 GitHub 开源的一套规格驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development）工具包，主张在动手写代码之前先把「要构建什么」定义清楚。它提供一套开箱即用的流程，也可以接入你自己的流程，并支持与各类 AI 编码代理配合使用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 编写的 Specify CLI 为核心，配套文档站点、扩展与预设（Extensions & Presets）、面向角色的 Bundles 方案，以及各 AI 编码代理的集成说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，通过 Specify CLI 分发；依赖 GitHub Releases 与 GitHub Pages 文档，并适配多家 AI 编码代理的集成接口。
zh.hot: 背靠 GitHub 官方、主打与 AI 编码代理协作的规范流程，发布一年即达 1.0.0，累计约 13.6 万 star，今日再涨 1015 并登上日榜第 15 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Copilot 等 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望先定规格再生成代码
团队负责人想统一需求、设计与实现之间的协作流程
想用扩展和预设把 Spec Kit 改造成自家研发规范的组织
需要评估新想法或修复缺陷时，用规格流程做结构化拆解的工程师

en.tag: GitHub's spec-driven development toolkit that makes any AI coding agent define specs before writing code
en.what: Spec Kit is GitHub's open source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, which puts defining what to build before building it. It ships a ready-to-use process (or lets you bring your own) and works with any AI coding agent.
en.content: The repo centers on a Python-based Specify CLI, plus a docs site, extensions and presets, role-based bundles, and integration guides for various AI coding agents.
en.stack: Primarily Python, distributed via the Specify CLI; it relies on GitHub Releases and GitHub Pages docs, and adapts to multiple AI coding agent integrations.
en.hot: Backed by GitHub and pitched as a spec-first workflow for AI coding agents, it hit 1.0.0 in its first year and now sits at ~135.8k stars, gaining 1,015 today for #15 on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Copilot who want specs before code
Team leads aiming to unify requirements, design, and implementation workflows
Organizations wanting to customize Spec Kit via extensions and presets for their own standards
Engineers who want a structured spec process for assessing ideas or fixing bugs

zh.tag: 基于 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器，支持分享与本地运行。
zh.what: Pascal Editor 是一个使用 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU 构建的 3D 建筑编辑器，允许用户创建和分享建筑项目。它提供了完整的编辑工具、3D 渲染运行时，并支持通过 CLI 在本地运行。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Turborepo monorepo，包含 Next.js 应用、核心包（core）、查看器（viewer）、编辑器（editor）、节点定义（nodes）、CLI 和 MCP 服务器等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU，采用 Turborepo 管理 monorepo，并发布多个 npm 包。
zh.hot: 凭借 WebGPU 带来的高性能 3D 渲染和便捷的本地运行方式，项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 22k+ 星标，今日新增 168 星。
uses: 建筑师和设计师：快速创建和分享 3D 建筑概念模型。
开发者：在 React 应用中集成 3D 编辑器或查看器。
教育工作者：用于教学演示或学生项目。

en.tag: A WebGPU-powered 3D architectural editor for creating and sharing projects.
en.what: Pascal Editor is a 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU, enabling users to create and share architectural projects. It offers a full editing toolset, a 3D rendering runtime, and can be run locally via CLI.
en.content: The repository is a Turborepo monorepo containing a Next.js app, core packages (core, viewer, editor, nodes), CLI, and MCP server.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on React Three Fiber and WebGPU, managed as a Turborepo monorepo, and published as multiple npm packages.
en.hot: With high-performance 3D rendering via WebGPU and easy local setup, the project has gained 22k+ stars, including 168 today.
uses: Architects and designers: quickly create and share 3D architectural concepts.
Developers: integrate the 3D editor or viewer into React applications.
Educators: use for teaching demonstrations or student projects.

zh.tag: 支持600+语言的高质量零样本语音克隆TTS模型
zh.what: OmniVoice 是一个支持超过 600 种语言的大规模多语言零样本文本转语音（TTS）模型，能够进行高质量的语音克隆和语音设计。它基于扩散语言模型风格的新架构，在保证语音质量的同时实现快速推理。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型代码、预训练模型（Hugging Face）、演示页面、Colab 笔记本、安装指南、Python API、命令行工具以及训练和评估脚本。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 和 PyTorch，支持 NVIDIA GPU、Apple Silicon 和 Intel Arc GPU（XPU），依赖 torchaudio 等库。
zh.hot: 凭借 600+ 语言覆盖、高质量语音克隆和快速推理（RTF 低至 0.025），该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 12335 颗星，今日新增 572 颗，位列 Python 日榜第 5 名。
uses: 语音合成研究人员和开发者，需要多语言 TTS 模型进行实验和产品集成。
内容创作者和播客制作者，希望克隆自己的声音或设计特定风格的语音。
全球化应用开发者，需要为 600+ 语言提供语音交互功能。
AI 爱好者，想通过 Colab 和 Hugging Face Space 快速体验最先进的语音克隆技术。

en.tag: High-quality zero-shot voice cloning TTS supporting 600+ languages
en.what: OmniVoice is a massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model supporting over 600 languages, enabling high-quality voice cloning and voice design. Built on a novel diffusion language model-style architecture, it delivers both quality and fast inference.
en.content: The repository includes model code, pretrained models (Hugging Face), demo page, Colab notebook, installation guide, Python API, command-line tools, and training/evaluation scripts.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, supporting NVIDIA GPU, Apple Silicon, and Intel Arc GPU (XPU), with dependencies like torchaudio.
en.hot: With 600+ language coverage, high-quality voice cloning, and fast inference (RTF as low as 0.025), the project has quickly gained traction on GitHub, earning 12,335 stars with 572 added today, ranking 5th on the Python daily trending list.
uses: Speech synthesis researchers and developers needing a multilingual TTS model for experiments and product integration.
Content creators and podcasters looking to clone their voice or design voices with specific attributes.
Developers of global applications requiring voice interaction in 600+ languages.
AI enthusiasts wanting to quickly try state-of-the-art voice cloning via Colab and Hugging Face Space.

zh.tag: 自适应网页抓取框架，从单次请求到大规模爬取全搞定
zh.what: Scrapling 是一个自适应网页抓取框架，能自动适应网站结构变化，支持从简单的单次请求到大规模分布式爬取。它提供智能元素定位、反爬绕过和高效并发能力，让现代网页抓取变得轻松。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心抓取引擎、自适应解析器、反爬模块、命令行工具和 Docker 部署文件，以及多语言文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，依赖 asyncio、httpx、parsel 等库，支持 Docker 部署，并提供 MCP 协议集成。
zh.hot: 凭借其自适应抓取能力和易用性，Scrapling 已获得超过 8 万星标，今日新增 338 星，位列 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 6 名。
uses: 数据工程师和爬虫开发者 —— 需要高效抓取动态网站并应对反爬机制。
AI 应用开发者 —— 为模型训练收集网页数据，或集成 MCP 协议实现智能代理。
研究人员和数据分析师 —— 快速获取网络公开数据用于分析和研究。
运维和 DevOps 团队 —— 通过 Docker 部署大规模爬虫集群。

en.tag: Adaptive web scraping framework handling everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl
en.what: Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping framework that automatically adapts to website structure changes, supporting everything from simple single requests to large-scale distributed crawling. It offers smart element location, anti-bot bypass, and efficient concurrency, making modern web scraping effortless.
en.content: The repository includes the core scraping engine, adaptive parser, anti-bot modules, CLI tools, Docker deployment files, along with multi-language documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built in Python, relying on asyncio, httpx, parsel, etc., with Docker support and MCP protocol integration.
en.hot: With its adaptive scraping capabilities and ease of use, Scrapling has gained over 80k stars, adding 338 today, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending Python daily list.
uses: Data engineers and scraping developers — need to efficiently scrape dynamic websites and handle anti-bot measures.
AI application developers — collect web data for model training or integrate MCP for intelligent agents.
Researchers and data analysts — quickly gather public web data for analysis and research.
Ops and DevOps teams — deploy large-scale crawler clusters via Docker.

zh.tag: 李博杰《深入理解 AI Agent》开源全书，正文、PDF 与 109 个配套实验全公开
zh.what: 这是《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》的开源主仓库，围绕「Agent = LLM + 上下文 + 工具」这一核心公式，用 10 章内容把 AI Agent 从设计原理讲到工程实战。全书正文、配图与配套实验代码全部开源，读者可以亲手把实验跑一遍。
zh.content: 仓库包含全书 10 章正文、编译好的 PDF/EPUB 电子书、按章组织的 109 个配套实验代码，以及 15 种语言的翻译文档和在线阅读站点。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主要语言，配套实验代码依赖主流 LLM 与 Agent 框架；文档用 Markdown 编写，通过 GitHub Actions 自动构建 PDF/EPUB 并部署在线阅读站点。
zh.hot: 作为中文社区少见的系统化 AI Agent 开源教材，上线即获 45919 星，今日新增 301 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Python 第 7 名，反映开发者对体系化 Agent 学习资料的强烈需求。
uses: AI 应用开发者：系统掌握 Agent 的设计原理与工程落地方法
算法/后端工程师：通过 109 个实验动手复现 Agent 关键技术
高校师生与自学者：用作 AI Agent 课程教材或自学参考书
技术团队负责人：为团队选型与架构设计提供体系化参考

en.tag: Boji Li's open-source book on AI Agents: full text, PDFs, and 109 hands-on labs
en.what: This is the open-source main repository for "AI Agents in Depth: Design Principles and Engineering Practice," built around the formula "Agent = LLM + Context + Tools." Its 10 chapters walk from design principles to production engineering, with the full text, figures, and companion lab code all open-sourced so readers can run every experiment themselves.
en.content: The repo contains the full 10-chapter text, compiled PDF/EPUB ebooks, 109 chapter-by-chapter lab projects, translations in 15 languages, and an online reading site.

en.hot: As an official Atlassian MCP server, it addresses the pressing need for enterprises to let AI securely access Jira/Confluence data; with 1,033 stars and GA status, it hit #10 on the JavaScript daily trending list, showing MCP is rapidly penetrating enterprise toolchains.

zh.tag: 基于 TurboQuant 的 Rust 向量索引，内存省 8 倍且搜索快过 FAISS
zh.what: turbovec 是一个用 Rust 编写、提供 Python 绑定的向量索引库，基于 Google Research 的 TurboQuant 量化算法。它无需训练阶段即可在线摄入向量，把千万级文档语料的 float32 内存占用从 31 GB 压到 4 GB，同时搜索速度超过 FAISS。
zh.content: 仓库提供 Rust crate 与 PyPI 包 turbovec，核心 API 包括 TurboQuantIndex 与支持稳定 ID 的 IdMapIndex，支持 add/search/write/load 以及增量持久化的 sync(path)。
zh.stack: 主体为 Rust，通过 PyO3/maturin 提供 Python 绑定；手写 SIMD 内核覆盖 ARM NEON SDOT/SMMLA 与 x86 AVX-512 VNNI、vpermb，并带 AVX2 与标量回退。
zh.hot: 它直击 RAG 场景的内存与延迟痛点，宣称比 FAISS 快 3.4 倍（4-bit）且完全本地运行，已收获 16937 颗星，今日再涨 91，位列 GitHub Rust 日榜第 7。
uses: 需要本地化、隐私优先 RAG 的开发者，可用它搭配开源嵌入模型搭建完全离线的检索栈
内存受限或追求低延迟的向量检索服务，可用 4-bit/2-bit 量化大幅压缩索引体积
熟悉 Rust 并希望用 Python 快速验证的工程师，可直接 pip install turbovec 上手
需要增量写入、崩溃安全持久化与搜索时过滤的检索系统，可借助 sync 与 id 白名单能力

en.tag: A Rust vector index built on TurboQuant — 8x less memory, faster than FAISS
en.what: turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings, built on Google Research's TurboQuant quantization algorithm. It ingests vectors online with no training phase, shrinking a 10M-document float32 corpus from 31 GB to 4 GB while searching faster than FAISS.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust crate and the turbovec PyPI package, with core APIs TurboQuantIndex and IdMapIndex for stable IDs, supporting add/search/write/load plus incremental persistence via sync(path).
en.stack: Written in Rust with Python bindings via PyO3/maturin; hand-written SIMD kernels cover ARM NEON SDOT/SMMLA and x86 AVX-512 VNNI/vpermb, with AVX2 and scalar fallbacks.
en.hot: It targets RAG memory and latency pain points, claiming 3.4x faster than FAISS at 4-bit while staying fully local — now at 16,937 stars, up 91 today, ranking #7 on GitHub's Rust daily trending.
uses: Developers building privacy-first, fully local RAG stacks paired with open-source embedding models
Vector search services constrained by memory or latency, using 4-bit/2-bit quantization to shrink indexes

Retrieval systems needing incremental writes, crash-safe persistence, and search-time filtering via sync and id allowlists

zh.stack: 基于 Rust 与 rustc 后端，使用 Pliron（Rust 实现的类 MLIR IR 框架）构建编译管线：Rust → Rust MIR → Pliron IR → LLVM IR → PTX，并依赖 CUDA 驱动与运行时。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA Labs 官方项目，它把「用纯 Rust 写 CUDA」这一长期痛点变成现实，上线即获约 3273 stars，今日再涨 24，冲上 GitHub Rust 日榜第 8。

需要在同一项目里统一主机端与设备端代码的 Rust 工程团队

en.tag: A Rust-to-CUDA compiler that turns pure Rust into GPU PTX kernels
en.what: cuda-oxide is a rustc codegen backend from NVIDIA Labs that compiles standard Rust directly to CUDA PTX, letting you write SIMT GPU kernels in safe, idiomatic Rust. There are no DSLs or foreign-language bindings, and host and device code can live in the same file.
en.content: The repo is a Cargo workspace containing a rustc codegen backend, device-side abstractions (type-safe indexing, shared memory, scoped atomics, barriers, TMA, warp/cluster ops), compile-time kernel policies, plus host-side runtimes cuda-core / cuda-async and examples.
en.stack: Built in Rust on a rustc backend, using Pliron (an MLIR-like IR framework in Rust) for the pipeline: Rust → Rust MIR → Pliron IR → LLVM IR → PTX, with CUDA driver/runtime dependencies.
en.hot: As an official NVIDIA Labs project, it finally makes 'writing CUDA in pure Rust' real, quickly reaching ~3,273 stars with 24 added today and ranking #8 on GitHub's daily Rust trending list.
uses: Rust developers who want to write GPU kernels without learning CUDA C++ or a DSL
Rust teams wanting unified host and device code in a single project
Engineers researching compiler backends, MLIR/IR pipelines, and GPU codegen
Early adopters eager to try an alpha project, give feedback, and contribute

en.tag: Pool GPUs and memory across machines into one OpenAI-compatible LLM mesh
en.what: Mesh LLM pools GPUs and memory across machines and exposes the result as a single OpenAI-compatible API at http://localhost:9337/v1. Start one node and add more later; the mesh decides whether a model runs locally, routes to a peer, or uses Skippy stage splits for models too large for one box.
en.content: The repo centers on the Rust node and mesh-scheduling code, plus install scripts (install.sh / install.ps1), Homebrew and Linux packages, OCI images, docs for installing, meshes and Windows/WSL2, and a web console.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it serves an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API (port 9337) and a web console on 3131; it supports GGUF models and Skippy stage-split inference, installed via curl, Homebrew or PowerShell.
en.hot: With 3,384 stars and a No.12 spot on GitHub Trending (Rust daily), it shows strong developer interest in privately or publicly sharing compute for LLMs, and today's +5 suggests momentum is still building.
uses: Individual developers who want to combine several home or office machines to run large models
Teams needing a private OpenAI-compatible inference service without buying a full GPU box
Compute contributors who want to publish idle capacity as a public mesh for others or themselves
Engineers researching multi-node inference, model splitting and distributed scheduling

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer

Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

en.tag: Open-source developer platform turning scripts into webhooks, workflows and UIs
en.what: Windmill is a self-hostable open-source developer platform for building internal APIs, background jobs, workflows and UIs. Backend developers building background jobs, cron tasks and webhooks from scripts
Data/platform engineers needing lightweight workflow orchestration without Temporal's weight
Analysts and ops staff turning SQL or Python scripts into internal UIs in one click

en.tag: A GraphBLAS-powered sparse-matrix graph database built for LLM knowledge graphs and GraphRAG
en.what: FalkorDB is an ultra-fast, multi-tenant graph database that represents graphs as sparse adjacency matrices using GraphBLAS under the hood. It executes queries via linear algebra and aims to be the best knowledge graph for LLMs (GraphRAG), powering generative AI, agent memory, cloud security, and fraud detection.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust-based core database engine, OpenCypher query support, a property-graph model implementation, plus Docker images, a cloud trial entry point, and CI/coverage tooling.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on GraphBLAS for sparse matrix operations, supports OpenCypher, ships Docker images and a cloud service, and is licensed under the Server Side Public License.

uses: AI engineers building GraphRAG knowledge graphs for LLM retrieval augmentation
Developers needing low-latency graph queries for agent long-term memory

zh.tag: 本地优先的极速微虚拟机运行时，秒级启动隔离环境

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编程语言，依赖微虚拟机技术（如 Firecracker 或类似），支持 OCI 容器镜像，跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和不可信代码执行需求的增长，开发者需要快速、安全的隔离方案。Microsandbox 提供了低于 100 毫秒的启动时间和硬件级隔离，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，本月新增 959 星，总星数达 8021。

平台工程师：将微虚拟机嵌入应用，实现多租户隔离或动态代码执行。

en.tag: Fast, local-first microVM runtime for untrusted workloads
en.what: Microsandbox is a lightweight microVM runtime written in Rust that quickly launches isolated environments locally for untrusted workloads like AI agents, user code, CI jobs, and automation. It offers hardware-level isolation with Docker-like workflows and average boot times under 100 milliseconds.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, examples, integrations for Agent Skills and MCP server, and build/release configurations. The core is an embeddable library that spawns VMs directly in code without a daemon.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging microVM technology (like Firecracker), supports OCI container images, and is cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and untrusted code execution, developers need fast, secure isolation. Microsandbox offers sub-100ms boot times and hardware-level isolation, quickly gaining traction with 959 stars this month, reaching 8,021 total.
uses: AI agent developers: provide secure sandboxes for agents to execute user code or plugins.
CI/CD engineers: run tests or build tasks in isolated environments to prevent malicious code from affecting the host.
Security researchers: analyze untrusted binaries or scripts with hardware isolation to reduce risk.
Platform engineers: embed microVMs into applications for multi-tenant isolation or dynamic code execution.

zh.tag: 一站式管理各类 AI 编程助手配置的跨平台桌面工具箱

en.tag: A cross-platform desktop toolbox for managing AI coding assistant configs in one place

Advanced users wanting a local proxy gateway to unify Claude Code/Codex/Gemini CLI with usage stats

en.what: Worktrunk is a Rust-based CLI for managing Git worktrees, letting developers keep multiple working directories of the same repository in parallel. en.hot: With roughly 6,984 stars, +44 today, and a No. 18 spot on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, it rides strong demand in the hot area of parallel AI agent development.

Engineers developing several branches or features in parallel and switching contexts frequently
Teams wanting a CLI to simplify creating, switching, and cleaning up Git worktrees

zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码普及，代码溯源成为刚需，该项目以 2570 星、今日新增 6 星登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 第 19 名，契合开发者对 AI 代码可审计性的关注。

需要审计或合规记录 AI 生成代码的团队

en.tag: A Git extension that tracks AI-generated code in your repos
en.what: Git AI is an open source Git extension that tracks AI-generated code in your repositories. After installing it, every line of AI code is linked to the agent, model, and prompts that generated it, so you never lose the intent, requirements, and architecture decisions behind your code.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust-based Git extension itself, command implementations like git ai blame, and a Git AI standard spec document (git_ai_standard_v3.0.0.md), along with docs and assets showing support for many agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it integrates as a Git extension/hook, supports Mac, Linux, and Windows (WSL), and installs via a one-line script with no per-repo setup or git hooks required.
en.hot: As AI coding spreads, code provenance becomes essential; with 2,570 stars and 6 added today, it ranks 19th on GitHub Trending (Rust daily), resonating with developers' need for AI code auditability.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants who want to trace AI code origins
Teams needing audit or compliance records for AI-generated code
Engineers curious about which model and prompt produced a given piece of code
Maintainers of large repos who care about preserving code intent and architecture decisions

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上统一生成式与预测式 AI 推理平台
zh.what: KServe 是一个面向 Kubernetes 的标准化分布式 AI 推理平台，同时覆盖生成式 AI 与预测式 AI 两类负载。它把多框架模型部署、自动扩缩容、流量路由与模型可解释性等能力统一到一套声明式 API 中。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 编写的控制器与 CRD 实现，包含 Python 推理运行时、文档站点、示例与图表等目录。
zh.stack: 以 Go 和 Kubernetes Operator/CRD 为核心，依赖 Knative、Istio 等云原生组件，并集成 vLLM、Hugging Face 及 TensorFlow、PyTorch、XGBoost、ONNX 等推理后端。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 孵化项目，它踩中 LLM 推理落地与企业级 MLOps 的双重需求，近 5900 颗星且今日再登 Go 日榜第 3。
uses: 需要在 Kubernetes 上统一部署生成式与预测式模型的平台团队
希望用 OpenAI 兼容协议对外提供 LLM 推理服务的工程团队
正在落地 MLOps、需要金丝雀发布与推理流水线的企业
想用 vLLM 等后端做 GPU 加速推理与自动扩缩容的开发者

en.tag: Standardized generative and predictive AI inference platform on Kubernetes
en.what: KServe is a standardized distributed AI inference platform for Kubernetes that covers both generative and predictive workloads. It unifies multi-framework model deployment, autoscaling, traffic routing, and model explainability behind a single declarative API.
en.content: The repo mainly contains Go-based controllers and CRDs, plus Python inference runtimes, a docs site, examples, and diagrams.
en.stack: Built on Go and Kubernetes operators/CRDs, it relies on cloud-native components like Knative and Istio, and integrates backends such as vLLM, Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, and ONNX.
en.hot: As a CNCF incubating project, it rides the dual demand of LLM serving and enterprise MLOps, with nearly 5,900 stars and a #3 spot on today's Go trending list.
uses: Platform teams needing unified generative and predictive model serving on Kubernetes
Engineering teams exposing LLM inference via an OpenAI-compatible protocol
Enterprises adopting MLOps with canary rollouts and inference pipelines
Developers wanting GPU-accelerated serving and autoscaling with backends like vLLM

zh.tag: 开源软件工厂：把常规工程任务自动变成可评审的 PR
zh.what: SuperPlane 是一个开源的「软件工厂」，把高置信度的 backlog issue 自动转化为经过验证、可直接评审的 pull request。它协调编码代理、源码管理、CI、评审与审批流程，让工程师专注在真正需要判断力的工作上。
zh.content: 仓库包含工厂引擎核心代码（Go）、work order 与 automation line 等资源模型、策略与护栏机制，以及 docs 目录下的架构图、演示图片和官网/文档/贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，支持自选模型、云端或本地部署，并集成源码控制、CI 与评审系统。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 1，今日新增 251 star、累计 6577，说明「代理自动干活」的工程化落地正被大量开发者关注。
uses: 希望用 AI 代理自动消化常规 backlog 的工程团队
想搭建内部自动化研发流水线的平台/DevOps 工程师
关注 AI 代理与 CI/CD 深度集成的开源爱好者
需要可自托管、模型可替换方案的合规敏感企业

en.tag: Open-source factory turning routine engineering work into reviewed pull requests
en.what: SuperPlane is an open-source software factory that turns high-confidence backlog issues into verified, review-ready pull requests. It coordinates coding agents, source control, CI, review and approvals in one visible system so engineers can focus on work that needs judgment.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based factory engine, resource models such as work orders and automation lines, policy and guardrail logic, plus docs with architecture diagrams, demo images and contribution guides.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go under Apache 2.0, it supports bring-your-own models, cloud or on-prem deployment, and integrates with source control, CI and review systems.
en.hot: It hit #1 on GitHub Trending (Go) with 251 stars added today and 6,577 total, showing strong demand for productionizing agent-driven engineering work.
uses: Engineering teams wanting AI agents to burn down routine backlog work
Platform/DevOps engineers building internal automated delivery pipelines
Open-source enthusiasts tracking deep agent + CI/CD integration
Compliance-sensitive enterprises needing self-hosted, model-agnostic setups

zh.tag: 发现、验证并分析泄露凭证的开源密钥扫描工具
zh.what: TruffleHog 是一款强大的密钥发现、分类、验证与分析工具，用于扫描 Git、聊天、Wiki、日志、对象存储和文件系统等位置的泄露凭证。它不仅能识别 800 多种密钥类型，还能主动登录验证密钥是否仍然有效，并对常见凭证类型进行深度权限分析。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心扫描引擎、超过 800 个密钥检测器（位于 pkg/detectors）、命令行工具以及企业版相关文档，支持多种数据源和凭证类型的扫描与验证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 GoReleaser 进行发布，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证，并集成多种 API 客户端用于凭证验证。
zh.hot: 凭借 27,803 个 Star 和今日新增 38 个 Star，TruffleHog 在 GitHub Go 语言日榜排名第 5，反映出开发者对密钥安全扫描工具的高度关注和需求。
uses: 安全工程师和 DevSecOps 团队用于持续监控代码仓库和基础设施中的凭证泄露
开发者在提交代码前扫描本地文件系统，防止敏感信息意外泄露
企业安全团队利用其验证功能评估泄露凭证的实际风险并优先响应
研究人员分析常见凭证类型的权限和影响范围，用于安全评估和报告

en.tag: Open-source secrets scanner that finds, verifies, and analyzes leaked credentials
en.what: TruffleHog is a powerful secrets discovery, classification, validation, and analysis tool that scans Git, chats, wikis, logs, object stores, and filesystems for leaked credentials. It identifies over 800 secret types, actively verifies whether they are still live, and performs deep analysis on commonly leaked credential types.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based scanning engine, over 800 secret detectors under pkg/detectors, a CLI tool, and enterprise-related documentation, supporting scanning and verification across many data sources and credential types.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, uses GoReleaser for releases, is licensed under AGPL-3.0, and integrates various API clients for credential verification.
en.hot: With 27,803 stars and 38 new stars today, TruffleHog ranks 5th on GitHub's daily Go trending list, reflecting strong developer interest and demand for secrets scanning tools.
uses: Security engineers and DevSecOps teams continuously monitor code repositories and infrastructure for credential leaks
Developers scan local filesystems before committing code to prevent accidental exposure of sensitive information
Enterprise security teams use its validation to assess real risk of leaked credentials and prioritize response
Researchers analyze permissions and impact of common credential types for security assessments and reports

zh.tag: 让 AI 助手直连 Grafana 的官方 MCP 服务器
zh.what: 这是 Grafana 官方推出的 Model Context Protocol 服务器，让 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 客户端能够直接访问 Grafana 实例及其生态。通过它，AI 可以搜索、读取、创建和修改仪表盘，并查询面板与数据源信息。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Go 语言实现的 MCP 服务器，包含仪表盘、数据源等工具集，并提供单元、集成、E2E 测试与 Docker、Helm、二进制等多种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 MCP 协议，可通过 uvx、Docker、Helm 或二进制运行，要求 Grafana 9.0 及以上版本。
zh.hot: 作为 Grafana 官方项目，它把可观测性平台接入了 AI 代理生态，已获得 3449 颗星，今日新增 7 星并登上 Go 日榜第 6 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Desktop 或 Cursor 的开发者，希望用自然语言查询和操作 Grafana 仪表盘
运维与 SRE 团队，需要让 AI 助手快速检索面板、数据源和告警信息
平台工程师，想为内部 AI 工具集成 Grafana 的可观测性数据能力

en.tag: Official MCP server that connects AI assistants to Grafana
en.what: This is Grafana's official Model Context Protocol server, giving AI clients like Claude and Cursor direct access to a Grafana instance and its ecosystem. Through it, AI can search, read, create, and modify dashboards, and inspect panel and datasource information.
en.content: The repo is a Go-based MCP server with tool sets for dashboards and datasources, plus unit, integration, and E2E tests and multiple deployment options including Docker, Helm, and binaries.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go and based on the MCP protocol; it can run via uvx, Docker, Helm, or a binary, and requires Grafana 9.0 or later.
en.hot: As an official Grafana project, it plugs an observability platform into the AI agent ecosystem, with 3,449 stars, 7 added today, and a No. 6 spot on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Developers using Claude Desktop or Cursor who want to query and operate Grafana dashboards in natural language
Ops and SRE teams that need AI assistants to quickly retrieve panels, datasources, and alert information
Platform engineers looking to integrate Grafana observability data into internal AI tools

zh.tag: 基于 Envoy 的 AI 与 Agent 流量开源控制平面
zh.what: Agent Router 为应用团队提供统一、兼容 OpenAI 的 API，接入托管模型、自托管推理和 MCP 服务器。平台团队则集中管理凭证、路由、配额、故障转移和用量归因，由 Envoy 与 Envoy Gateway 执行。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制平面与数据平面代码、CRD（AIGatewayRoute、AIServiceBackend、BackendSecurityPolicy）、aigw CLI、Helm charts 与文档站点，支持本地单机运行和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.stack: 以 Go 为主语言，构建在 Envoy 与 Envoy Gateway 之上，提供 OpenAI 兼容 API，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，属于 Agentic AI Foundation 项目。
zh.hot: 作为原 Envoy AI Gateway 更名后的项目，它背靠 Envoy 生态，解决多模型统一接入与治理痛点，已获 2037 stars，今日新增 22，登上 Go 日榜第 14 名。
uses: 平台团队：集中管理多模型凭证、路由、配额与故障转移
应用开发者：用统一 OpenAI 兼容 API 接入各类模型与 MCP 工具
自托管推理团队：通过两层网关模式暴露并治理模型服务
企业架构师：在 Kubernetes 上构建合规、可观测的 AI 流量入口

en.tag: The open source control plane for AI and agent traffic, powered by Envoy
en.what: Agent Router gives application teams one consistent, OpenAI-compatible API for every model and tool, from hosted providers to self-hosted inference and MCP servers. Platform teams keep credentials, routing, quotas, failover, and usage attribution in one place, enforced by Envoy and Envoy Gateway.
en.content: The repo contains control-plane and data-plane code, CRDs (AIGatewayRoute, AIServiceBackend, BackendSecurityPolicy), the aigw CLI, Helm charts, and a docs site, supporting both local standalone runs and Kubernetes deployments.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go and built on Envoy and Envoy Gateway, it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API under Apache 2.0 as an Agentic AI Foundation project.
en.hot: As the renamed former Envoy AI Gateway, it leverages the Envoy ecosystem to solve unified multi-model access and governance, reaching 2,037 stars with 22 added today and ranking 14th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Platform teams centralizing credentials, routing, quotas, and failover across models
App developers using one OpenAI-compatible API for models and MCP tools
Self-hosted inference teams exposing and governing model serving via a two-tier gateway
Enterprise architects building compliant, observable AI traffic entry points on Kubernetes

zh.tag: 为终端打造的 DeepSeek 原生编码代理，围绕前缀缓存稳定性设计，可长期常驻运行
zh.what: Reasonix 是一个跑在终端里的 AI 编码代理，专为 DeepSeek 模型深度适配。它的核心设计目标是前缀缓存（prefix cache）稳定性，让会话可以长时间常驻而不必反复重建上下文，从而降低延迟与成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的主体引擎、npm 包 reasonix 的分发入口，以及 docs 下的 Guide、ACP、Extensions、Spec 等文档与 logo 资源，另有 CI 工作流、Discord 社区与官网。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 npm 包 reasonix 分发安装，配套 GitHub Actions CI，并支持 ACP 协议与扩展机制。
zh.hot: 已积累约 3.55 万 star，今日新增 50，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 Go 语言第 8 名，说明终端型编码代理与 DeepSeek 生态正持续吸引开发者。
uses: 习惯在终端工作、希望用命令行完成编码任务的开发者
使用 DeepSeek 模型、关注前缀缓存与长会话成本优化的团队
需要长时间常驻、可扩展的 AI 编码代理工作流的高级用户

en.tag: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal, engineered around prefix-cache stability so you can leave it running
en.what: Reasonix is an AI coding agent that lives in your terminal and is purpose-built for DeepSeek models. Its core design goal is prefix-cache stability, so a session can stay running for a long time without repeatedly rebuilding context, cutting latency and cost.
en.content: The repo holds the Go-based engine, the npm package `reasonix` as a distribution entry point, plus docs for Guide, ACP, Extensions and Spec alongside logo assets, CI workflows, a Discord community and a website.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, distributed via the npm package `reasonix`, with GitHub Actions CI and support for the ACP protocol and an extension mechanism.
en.hot: With roughly 35.5k stars and 50 added today, it ranks 8th on the GitHub Trending daily Go chart, showing sustained interest in terminal coding agents and the DeepSeek ecosystem.
uses: Developers who prefer working in the terminal and want coding tasks done from the command line
Teams using DeepSeek models who care about prefix caching and long-session cost efficiency
Power users who need a long-running, extensible AI coding agent workflow

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）功能。它可作为反向代理的认证层，支持 LDAP、OIDC 等集成，并已通过 OpenID 认证，且为后量子密码学做好准备。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心服务、命令行工具、配置示例、文档站点（authelia.com）以及用于构建和测试的 CI/CD 配置。代码结构清晰，包含认证、授权、会话管理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种 Go 库，支持 LDAP、OIDC、TOTP、U2F 等协议。前端可能涉及少量 JavaScript，用于登录页面。
zh.hot: 本月新增 359 星，总星数达 2.88 万，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10。其安全性和对现代认证标准的支持吸引了大量自托管和隐私敏感用户。
uses: 自托管服务（如 Nextcloud、Grafana）的统一登录与二次验证
企业或团队内部应用的单点登录，集成现有 LDAP 或 OIDC
希望为 Web 应用添加安全认证层，但不希望使用商业 SSO 的开发者
对后量子密码学感兴趣，希望提前适配未来安全标准的技术团队

en.tag: Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor Authentication portal for web apps
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication layer for reverse proxies, integrates with LDAP and OIDC, and is OpenID Certified and Post-Quantum Cryptography Ready.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, command-line tools, configuration examples, documentation site (authelia.com), and CI/CD setup for building and testing. The code is well-organized into modules for authentication, authorization, session management, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various Go libraries. Supports LDAP, OIDC, TOTP, U2F, and other protocols. The frontend may include minimal JavaScript for the login page.
en.hot: With 359 new stars this month and a total of 28.8k stars, it ranks 10th on the Go trending list. Its security focus and support for modern auth standards attract many self-hosters and privacy-conscious users.
uses: Centralized login and 2FA for self-hosted services like Nextcloud and Grafana
SSO for internal enterprise apps, integrating with existing LDAP or OIDC
Developers wanting to add secure auth to web apps without commercial SSO
Tech teams interested in post-quantum cryptography readiness

zh.tag: 自主AI渗透测试代理系统
zh.what: PentAGI 是一个全自主的 AI 代理系统，能够执行复杂的渗透测试任务。它利用先进的人工智能技术，为信息安全专业人员、研究人员和爱好者提供强大且灵活的安全测试解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的系统代码、架构文档、快速入门指南、LLM 提供商配置（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 等）、Docker 镜像配置、开发与测试工具（如 ftester）以及社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持多种 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、AWS Bedrock 等），集成 Docker 进行隔离，并支持 Langfuse 监控和知识图谱（Graphiti）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 与网络安全结合的热度上升，PentAGI 作为自动化渗透测试的领先项目，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 89 星，总星数达 22519，位居 Go 语言趋势榜第一。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 代理自动执行渗透测试，提高效率。
红队与蓝队：在授权环境中进行自动化安全评估。
AI 爱好者：探索 AI 在网络安全领域的实际应用。

en.tag: Autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing
en.what: PentAGI is a fully autonomous AI agent system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks. It leverages advanced AI technologies to provide a powerful and flexible security testing solution for infosec professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository includes full system code, architecture docs, quick start guides, LLM provider configurations (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), Docker image setup, development and testing tools (like ftester), and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, etc.), integrates Docker for isolation, and supports Langfuse monitoring and knowledge graph (Graphiti).
en.hot: With the rising intersection of AI and cybersecurity, PentAGI as a leading autonomous pentesting project has gained rapid traction on GitHub, adding 89 stars today to reach 22,519 total, ranking #1 in Go trending.
