Red and blue teams: conduct automated security assessments in authorized environments.
AI enthusiasts: explore practical applications of AI in cybersecurity.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 官方包管理器，用 Chart 打包与发布应用
zh.what: Helm 是 Kubernetes 的包管理工具，把一组预配置的 K8s 资源清单打包成 Chart，实现一键安装、升级与回滚。它像 K8s 世界的 apt/yum/homebrew，负责渲染模板并与 Kubernetes API 交互，可在本地、CI/CD 或任意环境运行。
zh.content: 仓库是 Helm 客户端主体，包含 cmd 命令行入口、pkg 核心库（chart 解析、模板渲染、release 管理、仓库索引）、charts 示例与大量文档、测试和 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 以 Go 为主语言，依赖 Go 模板引擎（sprig 函数库）、Kubernetes client-go 与 OCI/HTTP 仓库协议，提供多平台二进制与 Homebrew、Scoop、Snap 等安装方式。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目与 K8s 生态事实标准，Helm 长期稳居 Go 榜单，累计 3 万多 star；当前 v4 成为稳定版、v3 进入维护期，版本切换持续带来关注与讨论。
uses: Kubernetes 运维与平台工程师，用 Chart 标准化部署与升级应用
应用开发者，把自己的服务打包成 Chart 分发给用户
CI/CD 工程师，在流水线中实现可复现的 K8s 发布与回滚
想快速试用开源软件（如 Prometheus、Ingress）的自建集群用户

en.tag: The Kubernetes package manager that packages and ships apps as Charts
en.what: Helm is the package manager for Kubernetes, bundling pre-configured Kubernetes resources into Charts for one-command install, upgrade and rollback. Often described as apt/yum/homebrew for Kubernetes, it renders templates, talks to the Kubernetes API, and runs anywhere from a laptop to CI/CD.
en.content: The repo holds the Helm client itself: a cmd CLI entrypoint, the pkg core libraries (chart parsing, template rendering, release management, repo indexing), plus example charts, docs, tests and CI configuration.
en.stack: Written in Go, it leans on Go templates with sprig functions, Kubernetes client-go, and OCI/HTTP chart repositories, shipping cross-platform binaries plus Homebrew, Scoop, Snap and other install channels.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project and the de facto standard of the Kubernetes ecosystem, Helm has long stayed on Go trending lists with 30k+ stars; v4 now being stable while v3 enters support mode keeps it in the spotlight.
uses: Kubernetes operators and platform engineers standardizing app deploys and upgrades with Charts
Application developers packaging their services as Charts for distribution
CI/CD engineers wanting reproducible Kubernetes releases and rollbacks in pipelines
Self-hosted cluster users who want to quickly try open-source software like Prometheus or Ingress

zh.tag: 单二进制、无数据库的自托管工作流编排器，用 YAML 编排脚本与容器
zh.what: Dagu 是一个本地优先的工作流引擎，把已有的脚本、SSH 命令、Docker 容器和 Kubernetes Job 用声明式 YAML 串成 DAG，并补上调度、重试、依赖、人工任务和运行历史。它面向那些主业不是编排的团队，让工作流与业务逻辑保持分离。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的引擎与 CLI、内置 Web UI（Cockpit 运行视图、步骤日志、Wiki 页面）、REST API 定义、MCP server，以及大量 YAML 示例和文档。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，单二进制分发，无需外部数据库或消息中间件，支持 Linux/macOS/Windows，可运行 shell、Docker、K8s Job 与 SSH 远程命令。
zh.hot: 它以“一个二进制、零依赖”的轻量姿态，成为 Airflow / Cron / 任务调度器的替代方案，已获约 3.9k star，今日新增 35，登上 GitHub Go 日榜第 12 名。
uses: 运维与内部自动化团队，用 YAML 把现有脚本变成可调度、可重试的生产工作流
数据工程师，在资源受限或气隙环境中替代 Airflow 做轻量编排
需要自托管、数据与凭证不出内网的合规敏感型组织
想用 MCP 让 AI 助手检查、修改并控制工作流运行的开发者

en.tag: Self-hostable, single-binary workflow orchestrator that runs your scripts and containers from declarative YAML
en.what: Dagu is a local-first workflow engine that chains existing scripts, SSH commands, Docker containers and Kubernetes Jobs into DAGs via declarative YAML, adding scheduling, retries, dependencies, human tasks and run history. It targets teams whose main job isn't orchestration, keeping workflows separate from business logic.
en.content: The repo contains the Go engine and CLI, a built-in Web UI (Cockpit run view, step logs, Wiki pages), a REST API spec, an MCP server, plus many YAML examples and docs.
en.stack: Written in Go, shipped as a single binary with no external DB or message broker; runs on Linux/macOS/Windows and can execute shell, Docker, K8s Jobs and remote SSH commands.
en.hot: Positioned as a lightweight, zero-dependency alternative to Airflow / Cron / job schedulers, it has reached ~3.9k stars with 35 added today, ranking 12th on GitHub's daily Go trending list.
uses: Ops and internal-automation teams turning existing scripts into schedulable, retryable production workflows via YAML
Data engineers replacing Airflow with lightweight orchestration in resource-limited or air-gapped environments
Compliance-sensitive orgs needing self-hosting so data and credentials never leave their network
Developers wanting an MCP server so AI assistants can inspect, edit and control workflow runs

zh.tag: 用 Go 与 JavaScript 打造的现代负载测试工具
zh.what: k6 是一款面向 DevOps 时代的现代负载测试工具，用 Go 编写内核、以 JavaScript 编写测试脚本，让开发者像写单元测试一样做性能测试。它支持 HTTP、WebSocket、gRPC、浏览器等多种协议，可配置负载生成并集成到 CI 流程中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 k6 的核心 Go 源码、内嵌 JavaScript 引擎、脚本 API、命令行工具，以及文档、示例脚本和扩展生态相关代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，内嵌 JavaScript 引擎（基于 Sobek）执行测试脚本，依赖 Grafana 生态与多种协议库，支持导出指标到多种后端。
zh.hot: 作为 Grafana 旗下的明星项目，k6 已积累 31446 颗星，今日新增 10 星并登上 GitHub Go 日榜第 13 名，持续受到性能测试与 DevOps 社区关注。
uses: 后端与全栈开发者，用于在 CI 中对 API 做性能回归测试
SRE 与 DevOps 工程师，用于压测服务容量与稳定性
测试工程师，希望用 JavaScript 编写可版本控制的负载测试脚本
需要多协议（HTTP/gRPC/WebSocket/浏览器）压测的团队

en.tag: A modern load testing tool built with Go and JavaScript
en.what: k6 is a modern load testing tool with a Go core and JavaScript scripting, letting developers do performance testing much like unit testing. It supports HTTP, WebSocket, gRPC, and browser protocols, with configurable load generation and CI integration.
en.content: The repo contains k6's core Go source, the embedded JavaScript engine, the scripting API, the CLI, plus docs, example scripts, and extension ecosystem code.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go with an embedded JavaScript engine (Sobek) for test scripts, relying on the Grafana ecosystem and various protocol libraries, with metrics export to multiple backends.
en.hot: As a flagship Grafana project, k6 has reached 31,446 stars, gaining 10 today and ranking 13th on GitHub's Go daily trending list, staying popular in the performance testing and DevOps community.
uses: Backend and full-stack developers running performance regression tests in CI
SRE and DevOps engineers load testing service capacity and stability
QA engineers wanting version-controlled load test scripts in JavaScript
Teams needing multi-protocol (HTTP/gRPC/WebSocket/browser) load testing

zh.tag: 面向生产环境的企业级 Kubernetes 容器管理平台
zh.what: Rancher 是一个开源容器管理平台，帮助企业在生产环境中统一部署和运行 Kubernetes。它简化了多集群管理，满足 IT 合规要求，并赋能 DevOps 团队。
zh.content: 仓库是用于打包的元仓库，包含 Rancher 大部分核心代码，并整合了众多开源库与模块（详见 go.mod）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes 生态及大量开源组件，通过 Docker 镜像分发。
zh.hot: 作为老牌容器管理平台，Rancher 拥有 25900 颗星，今日虽仅新增 4 星，仍稳居 Go 日榜第 14 名，足见其长期影响力。
uses: 运维与 DevOps 团队：统一管理多集群 Kubernetes 环境
企业 IT 部门：满足生产环境的安全与合规要求
云原生开发者：快速搭建和测试容器化应用
SRE 工程师：简化跨云与本地数据中心的容器运维

en.tag: Enterprise-grade Kubernetes container management platform for production
en.what: Rancher is an open source container management platform built for organizations that deploy containers in production. It makes it easy to run Kubernetes everywhere, meet IT requirements, and empower DevOps teams.
en.content: This repo is a meta-repo used for packaging and contains the majority of the Rancher codebase, integrating many open source libraries and modules (see go.mod).
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it depends on the Kubernetes ecosystem and numerous open source components, distributed via Docker images.
en.hot: As a veteran container management platform, Rancher has 25,900 stars; though it gained only 4 today, it still ranks 14th on the Go daily trending list, showing its lasting impact.
uses: DevOps and operations teams: unify management of multi-cluster Kubernetes environments
Enterprise IT departments: meet security and compliance requirements for production
Cloud-native developers: quickly set up and test containerized applications
SRE engineers: simplify container operations across cloud and on-prem data centers

zh.tag: 以太坊 Layer 2 扩容的 OP Stack 核心实现
zh.what: Optimism 是以太坊的 Layer 2 扩容方案，通过 Optimistic Rollup 技术提升交易吞吐量并降低费用。该仓库包含 OP Stack 的核心组件，支撑 OP Mainnet、Base 等区块链的运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OP Stack 的核心实现，如 op-node、op-geth、op-batcher、op-proposer 等模块，以及智能合约、规范文档和开发工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖以太坊生态的 go-ethereum 等库，并包含 Solidity 智能合约。
zh.hot: 作为以太坊 Layer 2 的领先方案，Optimism 拥有庞大的生态和开发者社区，今日登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 15 名，获得 6470 颗星。
uses: 区块链开发者：构建基于 OP Stack 的 Layer 2 链
以太坊用户：享受低成本、高速的 L2 交易
研究人员：研究 Optimistic Rollup 和扩容方案
节点运营者：部署和维护 OP Stack 节点

en.tag: Core OP Stack implementation powering Ethereum Layer 2 scaling
en.what: Optimism is an Ethereum Layer 2 scaling solution that uses Optimistic Rollups to boost throughput and cut fees. This repository contains the core components of the OP Stack, powering chains like OP Mainnet and Base.
en.content: The repo includes core OP Stack components like op-node, op-geth, op-batcher, op-proposer, plus smart contracts, specs, and development tooling.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging go-ethereum and other Ethereum ecosystem libraries, with Solidity smart contracts.
en.hot: As a leading Ethereum Layer 2 solution, Optimism has a massive ecosystem and developer community, trending at #15 on GitHub Trending (Go) today with 6,470 stars.
uses: Blockchain developers: build Layer 2 chains with OP Stack
Ethereum users: enjoy low-cost, high-speed L2 transactions
Researchers: study Optimistic Rollups and scaling solutions
Node operators: deploy and maintain OP Stack nodes

zh.tag: 把已有 AI 编程代理配置成完整工程环境的开源工具
zh.what: Gentle-AI 是一个开源配置层，为你已经在用的 AI 编程代理（Claude Code、Cursor、OpenCode、Codex、Pi 等）统一注入持久记忆、规范驱动开发（SDD）、精选技能、MCP 服务器、人格设定与可选的有界审查。它不绑定任何单一代理，让不同工具共享同一套工程化配置。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写，包含 CLI 配置器、各代理的适配模板、技能与 MCP 配置清单、人格定义，以及品牌文档与 Wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go 1.25.10+，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，采用 MIT 许可，依赖各 AI 代理的配置格式与 MCP 生态。
zh.hot: 本周新增 345 star，总数达 6560，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 6 名；多代理共存与免锁定配置切中开发者痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个 AI 编程代理、希望统一配置的开发者
想为代理加入持久记忆与规范驱动开发流程的团队
需要集中管理技能、MCP 服务器与人格设定的工程师
关注开源、避免厂商锁定的技术选型者

en.tag: Turn the AI coding agents you already use into a configured engineering environment
en.what: Gentle-AI is an open-source configuration layer that equips the AI coding agents you already use (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Pi, and more) with persistent memory, Spec-Driven Development, curated skills, MCP servers, personas, and optional bounded review. It avoids agent lock-in by letting different tools share one engineering setup.
en.content: Written in Go, the repo ships a CLI configurator, per-agent adapter templates, skill and MCP configuration manifests, persona definitions, plus brand docs and wiki links.
en.stack: Primary language Go 1.25.10+, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows under the MIT license, relying on each AI agent's config formats and the MCP ecosystem.
en.hot: It gained 345 stars this week for a total of 6,560, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending's weekly Go chart; its multi-agent, lock-in-free configuration hits a real developer pain point.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents who want unified configuration
Teams adding persistent memory and Spec-Driven Development to their agents
Engineers managing skills, MCP servers, and personas centrally
Open-source advocates avoiding vendor lock-in

zh.tag: 全球最快的 Go 静态网站生成框架
zh.what: Hugo 是用 Go 编写的静态网站生成器，以极快的构建速度著称，通常几秒甚至更短时间就能渲染出完整站点。它提供强大的模板系统、资源管道、多语言与分类法支持，适合从博客到企业官网的各类站点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hugo 的核心源码（Go 实现）、内嵌开发服务器、模板与资源处理管线，以及安装、文档、主题和贡献指南等链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 工具链、Git，并支持 Dart Sass 转译 CSS，可在 Linux、macOS、Windows 及 BSD 上运行。
zh.hot: 近 9 万 star 的长期热门项目，今日再登 Go 日榜第 17 名，凭借极致构建速度与活跃社区持续吸引开发者。
uses: 需要快速构建博客、文档或企业官网的开发者
追求极致构建性能与灵活模板系统的前端/全栈工程师
希望用 Go 生态做静态站点部署的 DevOps 与内容团队

en.tag: The world's fastest Go-based static site generator framework
en.what: Hugo is a static site generator written in Go, renowned for its blazing build speed that renders a full site in seconds or less. It offers a powerful templating system, asset pipelines, multilingual support, and a robust taxonomy system for everything from blogs to corporate sites.
en.content: The repo contains Hugo's core Go source code, an embedded development server, templating and asset pipelines, plus links to installation, documentation, themes, and contribution guides.
en.stack: Built primarily in Go, it depends on the Go toolchain and Git, supports Dart Sass for CSS transpilation, and runs on Linux, macOS, Windows, and BSD.
en.hot: With nearly 90k stars, this long-standing favorite hit #17 on the Go daily trending list today, drawing developers with its extreme build speed and active community.
uses: Developers building blogs, docs, or corporate sites quickly
Frontend/full-stack engineers wanting extreme build speed and flexible templating
DevOps and content teams deploying static sites within the Go ecosystem

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，支持通过 Homebrew、Docker、Go 或二进制安装，并可集成到 pre-commit 钩子或 GitHub Action 中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖正则表达式库和熵计算，支持多种平台和容器化部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 215 星，总星数达 28786，位列 GitHub 周榜（Go）第一。其功能完善且维护者宣布转向新项目，引发关注。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描代码泄露
安全团队审计历史提交中的敏感信息
个人开发者本地检查仓库泄露风险

en.tag: Scan git repos for secrets, passwords, API keys, and tokens
en.what: Gitleaks is a tool for detecting secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repos, files, and stdin. It uses regex and entropy analysis to identify potential leaks and outputs detailed reports including file, line, commit, and more.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool, installable via Homebrew, Docker, Go, or binaries, and can be integrated into pre-commit hooks or GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging regex and entropy calculation, with support for multiple platforms and containerized deployment.
en.hot: Gained 215 stars this week, total 28,786, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its feature-complete status and maintainer's shift to a new project drew attention.
uses: Developers scanning for leaks in CI/CD pipelines
Security teams auditing historical commits for sensitive data
Individual developers checking repos locally for exposure

zh.tag: 多协议多用户的 Xray 代理管理面板
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器 Web 管理面板，用于部署、配置和监控多种代理与 VPN 协议。它是原 X-UI 项目的增强分支，支持从单台 VPS 到多节点部署，并提供多语言界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的面板后端、前端管理界面、安装脚本与多语言 README（中/英/波斯/阿拉伯/俄/西/土等），并附有截图与文档链接。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，基于 Xray-core，支持 TLS/XTLS/REALITY 及 TCP、WebSocket、gRPC、XHTTP 等传输方式，内置用户态 AmneziaWG 网络栈。
zh.hot: 凭借 46,215 颗星和今日新增 66 星登上 Go 日榜第 19 名，其丰富的协议支持与免内核模块的 AmneziaWG 抗审查能力持续吸引自建代理用户。
uses: 自建代理/VPN 的个人用户，需要图形化面板管理多协议节点
运维多台 VPS 或小型多节点部署的技术人员
需要按客户端统计流量、设置配额与到期时间的服务提供者
希望使用 REALITY、AmneziaWG 等抗审查传输的高级用户

en.tag: Multi-protocol, multi-user web panel for Xray-core
en.what: 3X-UI is an open-source web control panel for managing Xray-core servers, used to deploy, configure, and monitor a wide range of proxy and VPN protocols. An enhanced fork of the original X-UI, it scales from a single VPS to multi-node deployments with a multi-language interface.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based panel backend, a web admin UI, install scripts, and READMEs in many languages (Chinese, English, Persian, Arabic, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, etc.), plus screenshots and docs links.
en.stack: Written in Go and built on Xray-core, it supports TLS/XTLS/REALITY with transports like TCP, WebSocket, gRPC, and XHTTP, and bundles a userspace AmneziaWG network stack.
en.hot: With 46,215 stars and 66 added today, it ranks 19th on the Go daily trending list, drawing self-hosted proxy users with its broad protocol support and kernel-module-free AmneziaWG anti-censorship.
uses: Individuals self-hosting proxies/VPNs who want a GUI to manage multi-protocol nodes
Technicians running multiple VPS instances or small multi-node deployments
Providers needing per-client traffic accounting, quotas, and expiry dates
Advanced users wanting anti-censorship transports like REALITY and AmneziaWG

zh.tag: Go 语言官方开源仓库，简洁高效的编程语言本体
zh.what: 这是 Go 编程语言的官方源码仓库，由 Google 主导、数千名贡献者共同维护。它提供编译器、运行时、标准库以及完整的工具链，目标是让开发者轻松构建简单、可靠、高效的软件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 的编译器与运行时源码、标准库、官方工具链（go 命令、gofmt 等）以及文档和贡献指南，是 Go 语言所有官方发布的源头。
zh.stack: 项目自身用 Go 编写并自举（Go 编译器由 Go 实现），辅以少量汇编和 C；依赖集中在标准库与内部工具，无需外部框架。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 上 star 数最高的语言仓库之一，它已积累 138425 颗星，今日再增 424 星并登上 Go 日榜第 20 名，足见其长期热度与生态影响力。
uses: 后端与云原生开发者，用 Go 构建高并发服务与微服务
想学习语言设计与编译器/运行时实现的工程师
希望为大型开源语言项目贡献代码的开发者
需要在多平台上部署高效可执行程序的技术团队

en.tag: The official open-source repository of the Go programming language
en.what: This is the official source repository of the Go programming language, led by Google and maintained by thousands of contributors. It provides the compiler, runtime, standard library and full toolchain, aiming to make it easy to build simple, reliable and efficient software.
en.content: The repo contains Go's compiler and runtime source, the standard library, official tooling (the go command, gofmt, etc.), plus docs and contribution guidelines — the origin of all official Go releases.
en.stack: The project is written in and bootstrapped by Go itself (the compiler is implemented in Go), with some assembly and C; dependencies are limited to the standard library and internal tooling, with no external frameworks.
en.hot: As one of the most starred language repositories on GitHub, it has accumulated 138,425 stars, gaining another 424 today and ranking 20th on the Go daily trending list — a testament to its enduring popularity and ecosystem impact.
uses: Backend and cloud-native developers building high-concurrency services and microservices in Go
Engineers who want to study language design and compiler/runtime implementation
Developers hoping to contribute to a large open-source language project
Teams needing to ship efficient executables across multiple platforms

zh.tag: 基于 ggml 的纯 C++ 音频推理引擎，无需 Python
zh.what: audio.cpp 是一个高性能的纯 C++ 音频推理框架，基于 ggml 构建，旨在让本地音频模型变得实用、便携且快速。它支持 TTS、STT、VAD、语音转换、音乐生成等多种任务，并可在 Windows、Linux、macOS 上运行，支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Apple Silicon 和纯 CPU。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 推理引擎源码、GGUF 模型加载与优化、Arena 对比 UI、文档和性能报告，以及 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 上的 GGUF 模型包。
zh.stack: 基于 ggml 张量库，使用纯 C++ 编写，支持 CUDA、Metal、CPU 等多种后端，通过 GGUF 格式加载量化模型，无 Python 依赖。
zh.hot: 今日新增 89 星，总星数达 2590，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 类别第一。其纯 C++ 无 Python 依赖、高性能（CUDA 下 TTS 比 Python 快 1.8-8 倍）和广泛模型支持吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要在本地部署音频模型（TTS/STT/语音转换）的 C++ 开发者
希望摆脱 Python 环境依赖、追求高性能推理的工程师
在边缘设备或 CPU 上运行音频 AI 的研究人员
需要对比不同音频模型效果的 AI 应用开发者

en.tag: A pure C++ audio inference engine built on ggml, no Python required
en.what: audio.cpp is a high-performance pure C++ audio inference framework built on top of ggml, designed to make local audio models practical, portable, and fast. It supports TTS, STT, VAD, voice conversion, music generation, and more, running on Windows, Linux, macOS with NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, and CPU-only support.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ inference engine source, GGUF model loading and optimization, an Arena comparison UI, documentation and performance reports, plus GGUF model packages on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built on the ggml tensor library in pure C++, with support for CUDA, Metal, CPU and other backends, loading quantized models via GGUF format, with no Python dependency.
en.hot: It gained 89 stars today, reaching 2,590 total, and topped GitHub Trending daily for C++. Its pure C++ no-Python approach, high performance (1.8-8x faster TTS on CUDA vs Python), and broad model support attract significant attention.
uses: C++ developers deploying local audio models (TTS/STT/voice conversion)
Engineers seeking high-performance inference without Python dependencies
Researchers running audio AI on edge devices or CPU-only machines
AI app developers comparing different audio model outputs

zh.tag: 任天堂 Switch 定制固件，实现自定义系统与虚拟 NAND
zh.what: Atmosphère 是一个针对任天堂 Switch 的开源定制固件项目，通过替换和修改系统各个组件（如引导加载器、TrustZone、系统模块等）来实现自定义功能。它允许用户运行自制软件、备份和虚拟化 NAND 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：Fusée（第一阶段加载器）、Exosphère（自定义 TrustZone）、Thermosphère（emuNAND 支持）、Stratosphère（自定义系统模块）、Troposphère（应用程序级补丁），以及相关文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 libnx、devkitA64 工具链、FatFs、hekate 等开源项目。
zh.hot: 作为 Switch 破解社区的核心项目，Atmosphère 拥有近 2 万星标，今日新增 13 星，位列 C++ 日榜第二，持续受到关注。
uses: Switch 破解玩家：用于运行自制软件和备份游戏
安全研究人员：研究 Switch 系统安全与漏洞
自制软件开发者：基于 Atmosphère 开发自定义模块

en.tag: Custom firmware for Nintendo Switch enabling custom OS and emuNAND
en.what: Atmosphère is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch that replaces and modifies various system components (such as bootloader, TrustZone, sysmodules) to enable custom features. It allows users to run homebrew, backup and virtualize NAND, and more.
en.content: The repository contains multiple components: Fusée (first-stage loader), Exosphère (custom TrustZone), Thermosphère (emuNAND support), Stratosphère (custom sysmodules), Troposphère (application-level patches), along with documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on libnx, devkitA64 toolchain, FatFs, hekate, and other open-source projects.
en.hot: As a core project in the Switch hacking community, Atmosphère has nearly 20k stars, with 13 added today, ranking second on the C++ daily trending list, showing sustained interest.
uses: Switch hacking enthusiasts: to run homebrew and backup games
Security researchers: to study Switch system security and vulnerabilities
Homebrew developers: to build custom modules based on Atmosphère

zh.tag: 高性能内存图数据库，为 GraphRAG 与 AI 记忆提供实时图引擎
zh.what: Memgraph 是一个用 C/C++ 编写的高性能内存图数据库，专为实时 AI 上下文与图分析设计。它把向量/文本索引与图遍历放在同一查询层，让 GraphRAG、AI 记忆和智能体工作流能在单次原子查询中完成检索与多跳扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心数据库引擎、Cypher 查询层、内置向量/文本/地理索引，以及 MAGE 算法库（40+ 图算法，含 GNN、时序图网络与嵌入）。此外还有 AI Toolkit、MCP server 和主流智能体框架集成。
zh.stack: 核心用 C/C++ 实现，兼容 Neo4j Cypher，支持 ACID 与高可用；算法库覆盖 C++、Python 和 CUDA，并提供 MCP 与智能体框架集成。
zh.hot: GraphRAG 与 AI 记忆是当前热点，Memgraph 把向量检索与图遍历统一到单次查询，切中 RAG 多系统拼装的痛点。项目已获 4491 stars，今日新增 43，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 2。
uses: 构建 GraphRAG 与知识图谱检索管线的 AI 工程师
需要为智能体提供长期记忆与结构化上下文的开发者
做实时欺诈检测、网络分析或基础设施监控的数据团队
希望用 Cypher 快速搭建图分析应用的后端工程师

en.tag: High-performance in-memory graph database powering GraphRAG and AI memory
en.what: Memgraph is a high-performance in-memory graph database built in C/C++, designed for real-time AI context and graph analytics. It combines vector/text indexes with graph traversal in a single query layer, letting GraphRAG, AI memory, and agentic workflows run retrieval and multi-hop expansion as one atomic database operation.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ core database engine, a Cypher query layer, built-in vector/text/geospatial indexes, and the MAGE algorithm library (40+ graph algorithms including GNNs, temporal graph networks, and embeddings). It also ships an AI Toolkit, MCP server, and integrations with popular agentic frameworks.
en.stack: Core is implemented in C/C++, compatible with Neo4j Cypher, ACID-compliant and highly available; the algorithm library spans C++, Python, and CUDA, with MCP and agentic framework integrations.
en.hot: GraphRAG and AI memory are hot topics, and Memgraph unifies vector search with graph traversal in one query, addressing the pain of stitching RAG across multiple systems. It has 4,491 stars with 43 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending for C++.
uses: AI engineers building GraphRAG and knowledge-graph retrieval pipelines
Developers needing long-term memory and structured context for agents
Data teams doing real-time fraud detection, network analysis, or infra monitoring
Backend engineers who want to build graph analytics apps quickly with Cypher

zh.tag: NVIDIA 推理点对点通信加速库，统一内存与存储传输抽象
zh.what: NIXL 是 NVIDIA 推出的推理传输库，用于加速 AI 推理框架（如 NVIDIA Dynamo）中的点对点通信。它通过模块化插件架构，对 CPU/GPU 内存以及文件、块设备、对象存储等不同存储类型提供统一抽象。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 库与 Python API 绑定，配套 docs 文档（架构、Python API、后端开发、遥测、Doxygen 图）、benchmark 目录（nixlbench、kvbench）以及可选的 UCX/GDRCopy 后端集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++20（GCC>=11 或 Clang>=14），构建依赖 CMake、Meson/Ninja、pybind11，通信层基于 UCX 1.23.x，可选 GDRCopy 提升性能，仅支持 Linux（Ubuntu 22.04/24.04、Fedora）。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA Dynamo 生态的底层传输组件，NIXL 切中推理场景中 KV Cache 与张量跨节点/跨存储高效搬运的刚需，今日登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 4 名，累计 1249 stars。
uses: AI 推理框架开发者，需要优化多节点间张量/KV Cache 传输性能
NVIDIA Dynamo 等推理平台的集成与运维工程师
研究分布式推理与存储卸载（如对象存储、块设备）的科研人员
需要为 NIXL 开发自定义后端插件的系统工程师

en.tag: NVIDIA inference point-to-point transfer library abstracting memory and storage
en.what: NIXL is NVIDIA's inference transfer library that accelerates point-to-point communication in AI inference frameworks such as NVIDIA Dynamo. Through a modular plug-in architecture, it provides a unified abstraction over CPU/GPU memory and storage types like file, block, and object store.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++ library with Python API bindings, docs (architecture, Python API, backend guide, telemetry, Doxygen diagrams), benchmark suites (nixlbench, kvbench), and optional UCX/GDRCopy backend integrations.
en.stack: Primarily C++20 (GCC>=11 or Clang>=14), built with CMake, Meson/Ninja, and pybind11; communication layer relies on UCX 1.23.x with optional GDRCopy for peak performance; Linux only (Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, Fedora).
en.hot: As the low-level transfer component of the NVIDIA Dynamo ecosystem, NIXL addresses the critical need for efficient cross-node and cross-storage movement of KV caches and tensors in inference; it ranks 4th on GitHub's daily C++ trending list with 1,249 stars.
uses: AI inference framework developers optimizing cross-node tensor/KV cache transfers
Integration and ops engineers working with NVIDIA Dynamo and similar inference platforms
Researchers studying distributed inference and storage offloading (object store, block devices)
Systems engineers building custom backend plug-ins for NIXL

zh.tag: 跨平台 AI 文件整理与重命名桌面工具
zh.what: AI File Sorter 是一款跨平台桌面应用，利用 AI 分析图片、文档及音视频内容，为文件生成更清晰一致的名称并整理归类。它支持本地与远程 LLM，所有改动都需用户预览确认后才生效，避免误操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的桌面应用源码、资源文件（图标、截图、平台 logo）以及构建脚本，覆盖 Windows、macOS、Linux 三大平台。README 提供功能说明、下载徽章与界面截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，集成 Vulkan、CUDA、Apple Metal 等 GPU 后端以加速本地视觉 LLM 推理，并支持远程 LLM API。依赖跨平台 GUI 与文件处理库。
zh.hot: 项目已获 1713 颗星，今日新增 14 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 5 名。它切中文件整理这一高频痛点，且强调本地推理与用户可控，吸引大量关注。
uses: 需要整理下载文件夹、外接硬盘或 NAS 的普通用户
希望用 AI 自动重命名图片、文档和音视频的创作者
注重隐私、倾向本地 LLM 推理的进阶用户
想研究 C++ 跨平台 AI 桌面应用开发的开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform AI desktop app for content-aware file organization and renaming
en.what: AI File Sorter is a cross-platform desktop app that uses AI to analyze images, documents, and media files, suggesting cleaner names and organizing them into groups. It supports local and remote LLMs, and every change is preview-based and fully user-controlled.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ desktop app source, resource assets (icons, screenshots, platform logos), and build scripts targeting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The README offers feature docs, download badges, and UI screenshots.
en.stack: Built primarily in C++, integrating Vulkan, CUDA, and Apple Metal GPU backends for local visual LLM inference, plus remote LLM APIs. It relies on cross-platform GUI and file-handling libraries.
en.hot: With 1,713 stars and 14 added today, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list. It hits the high-frequency pain point of file organization while emphasizing local inference and user control, drawing wide attention.
uses: Everyday users tidying Downloads, external drives, or NAS storage
Creators wanting AI-assisted renaming of images, documents, and media
Privacy-conscious users preferring local LLM inference
Developers studying cross-platform AI desktop apps in C++

zh.tag: 开源无人机与无人车自动驾驶固件，覆盖多类载具
zh.what: ArduPilot 是一套成熟的开源自动驾驶系统，为多旋翼、固定翼、无人车、水下机器人等提供统一的飞行/行驶控制固件。它支持从手动遥控到全自主任务、编队与返航等完整功能。
zh.content: 仓库按载具拆分为 ArduCopter、ArduPlane、ArduRover、ArduSub、ArduTracker 等目录，并共享 AP_ 系列库（传感器、导航、通信、参数系统）与 SITL 仿真、单元测试和 CI 工作流。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，采用 ChibiOS 实时系统，支持 Pixhawk 等硬件，依赖 MAVLink 协议，并配有 Python 构建脚本与 SITL 仿真环境。
zh.hot: 作为无人机与机器人领域最老牌的开源飞控之一，已积累 15847 颗星；今日虽仅新增 5 星，但凭借 C++ 日榜第 6 名持续吸引嵌入式与机器人开发者关注。
uses: 无人机与机器人开发者，用于二次开发飞控与自主导航
科研与教育机构，用于多载具编队、仿真与算法验证
创客与 FPV 爱好者，用于搭建多旋翼、固定翼或无人车
行业应用团队，用于农业、测绘、巡检等自主任务部署

en.tag: Open-source autopilot firmware for drones, planes, rovers and subs
en.what: ArduPilot is a mature open-source autopilot system providing unified flight and driving control firmware for multicopters, fixed-wing aircraft, rovers and underwater vehicles. It supports everything from manual RC control to fully autonomous missions, swarming and return-to-home.
en.content: The repo splits by vehicle into ArduCopter, ArduPlane, ArduRover, ArduSub and ArduTracker directories, sharing AP_ libraries for sensors, navigation, comms and parameters, plus SITL simulation, unit tests and CI workflows.
en.stack: Primarily C++ on the ChibiOS RTOS, supporting Pixhawk-class hardware, relying on the MAVLink protocol, with Python build scripts and a SITL simulation environment.
en.hot: As one of the oldest open-source flight controllers in drones and robotics, it has accumulated 15,847 stars; though it gained only 5 today, ranking 6th on the C++ daily trending list keeps it visible to embedded and robotics developers.
uses: Drone and robotics developers doing secondary development of flight control and autonomous navigation
Research and education institutions for multi-vehicle swarming, simulation and algorithm validation
Makers and FPV hobbyists building multicopters, fixed-wing planes or rovers
Industry teams deploying autonomous missions in agriculture, surveying and inspection

zh.tag: 通用卫星数据处理软件，支持实时接收与离线解码
zh.what: SatDump 是一款开源的通用卫星数据处理工具，能够从 SDR 设备实时接收或从文件离线处理卫星信号，并解码成图像和科学数据。它支持多种卫星和协议，如 Meteor、NOAA、MetOp 等，覆盖从基带到最终产品的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的核心处理库、图形界面（GUI）和命令行工具（CLI），以及丰富的卫星管线配置和文档。还提供了示例图片和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 CMake 构建，并集成多种 SDR 驱动（如 Airspy、RTL-SDR）和信号处理库（如 VOLK、FFTW）。
zh.hot: SatDump 因其强大的通用性和易用性受到卫星爱好者和研究者的欢迎，目前获得 2185 颗星，今日新增 5 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 7 名。
uses: 卫星信号接收与解码爱好者，用于接收气象卫星图像
科研人员和教育工作者，用于卫星数据分析和教学演示
SDR 硬件玩家，希望将原始 IQ 数据转换为有用信息
应急通信与灾害监测人员，快速获取卫星云图等数据

en.tag: A generic satellite data processing software for live and offline decoding
en.what: SatDump is an open-source generic satellite data processing tool that can receive signals in real-time from SDR devices or process recorded files offline, decoding them into images and scientific data. It supports a wide range of satellites and protocols, such as Meteor, NOAA, and MetOp, covering the full pipeline from baseband to final products.
en.content: The repository contains a C++ core processing library, a graphical user interface (GUI), and a command-line tool (CLI), along with extensive satellite pipeline configurations and documentation. It also includes sample images and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++ with CMake as the build system, integrating various SDR drivers (e.g., Airspy, RTL-SDR) and signal processing libraries (e.g., VOLK, FFTW).
en.hot: SatDump is popular among satellite enthusiasts and researchers for its versatility and ease of use, currently with 2,185 stars and 5 new stars today, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++.
uses: Satellite signal reception and decoding enthusiasts for receiving weather satellite images
Researchers and educators for satellite data analysis and teaching demonstrations
SDR hardware hobbyists wanting to convert raw IQ data into useful information
Emergency communication and disaster monitoring personnel for quickly obtaining satellite cloud images and other data

zh.tag: 面向鸿蒙与安卓的 AI 辅助逆向工程分析工具
zh.what: ReArk 是一款桌面端逆向工程与 AI 辅助分析工具，专注于鸿蒙（HAP/APP/ABC）和安卓（APK/AAB）应用。它能在统一工作区中检查代码、资源、元数据和应用行为，结合静态分析与连接设备检查，并借助 ReArk Agent 调查应用逻辑、审查安全性及解决 CTF 挑战。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Windows 和 macOS 安装包，Linux 版本即将推出。功能模块涵盖包与静态分析、鸿蒙签名与打包、以及 ReArk Agent 智能分析。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 C++ 为核心，可能结合 Qt 等跨平台框架，支持 OpenAI 兼容接口和本地 Ollama 模型，依赖包括反汇编/反编译引擎和文件解析库。
zh.hot: ReArk 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 29 星，总星数达 279，位列 C++ 日榜第 8 名。其独特之处在于同时支持鸿蒙和安卓逆向，并集成 AI 代理，满足了移动安全研究的新兴需求。
uses: 移动安全研究人员 —— 分析鸿蒙和安卓应用的安全漏洞与恶意行为
逆向工程爱好者 —— 学习鸿蒙 ABC 字节码和安卓 DEX 的反编译技术
CTF 参赛者 —— 利用 AI 代理快速解决逆向工程挑战
应用开发者 —— 检查自己应用的签名、权限和打包配置

en.tag: AI-assisted reverse engineering analysis tool for HarmonyOS and Android
en.what: ReArk is a desktop reverse engineering and AI-assisted analysis tool for HarmonyOS and Android applications. It inspects code, resources, metadata, and app behavior in one workspace, combining static analysis with connected-device inspection and ReArk Agent to investigate app logic, review security, and tackle CTF challenges.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop application source code, primarily written in C++, with installers for Windows and macOS, and Linux coming soon. Feature modules include package and static analysis, HarmonyOS signing and packaging, and the ReArk Agent for intelligent analysis.
en.stack: The tech stack is centered on C++, likely with cross-platform frameworks like Qt, and supports OpenAI-compatible endpoints and local Ollama models, depending on disassembly/decompilation engines and file parsing libraries.
en.hot: ReArk is gaining rapid traction on GitHub, with 29 new stars today and 279 total, ranking 8th on the C++ daily trending list. Its uniqueness lies in supporting both HarmonyOS and Android reverse engineering with an integrated AI agent, addressing emerging needs in mobile security research.

Reverse engineering enthusiasts — learn decompilation techniques for HarmonyOS ABC bytecode and Android DEX
CTF players — leverage the AI agent to quickly solve reverse engineering challenges
App developers — inspect their own app's signing, permissions, and packaging configuration

zh.tag: 开源列式实时分析数据库，海量数据亚秒级查询
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为在线分析处理（OLAP）设计，能在海量数据上实时生成分析报表。它以极致的查询速度和写入吞吐著称，支持 SQL 与多种集成方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的数据库内核源码（C++）、构建脚本、测试套件与文档入口，并附有安装命令、官方教程、文档、Slack/Telegram 社区及月度发布说明等链接。
zh.stack: 核心以 C++ 编写，采用列式存储与向量化执行引擎，支持 SQL；提供 Linux/macOS/FreeBSD 一键安装脚本，并有云服务 ClickHouse Cloud。
zh.hot: 作为 OLAP 领域标杆项目，已积累 49835 颗星，今日仍新增 31 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 9，说明其在实时分析场景中的长期热度与活跃社区。
uses: 数据分析师与数据工程师，用于构建实时报表与 BI 看板
后端/平台团队，为日志、埋点、指标等海量时序数据提供查询引擎
需要替换传统数仓或加速 OLAP 查询的架构师与 SRE
学习列式存储与高性能数据库实现的开源爱好者与研究者

en.tag: Open-source column-oriented database for real-time analytics at scale
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system built for online analytical processing (OLAP), generating analytical reports in real time over massive datasets. It is known for extreme query speed and write throughput, with SQL support and broad integrations.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ database engine source, build scripts, test suites and docs entry points, plus install commands, official tutorials, documentation, Slack/Telegram community links and monthly release notes.
en.stack: Core is written in C++ with columnar storage and a vectorized execution engine, SQL support, one-line install scripts for Linux/macOS/FreeBSD, and the managed ClickHouse Cloud service.
en.hot: As a benchmark OLAP project it has amassed 49,835 stars, still gaining 31 today and ranking 9th on the C++ daily trending list, reflecting lasting demand and an active community.
uses: Data analysts and engineers building real-time reports and BI dashboards
Backend/platform teams needing a query engine for logs, events and metrics at scale
Architects and SREs replacing legacy warehouses or accelerating OLAP queries
Open-source learners and researchers studying columnar storage and high-performance databases

zh.tag: 昇腾 NPU 上的 vLLM 硬件插件，让大模型推理跑在华为昇腾上
