需要为昇腾平台做算子适配与性能调优的开发者
关注国产 AI 芯片生态与推理框架集成的技术研究者

en.tag: Community-maintained vLLM hardware plugin for running LLM inference on Ascend NPUs
en.what: This is the community-maintained Ascend hardware plugin for vLLM, adapting vLLM's inference engine to Huawei Ascend NPUs. It lets users deploy and serve large language models on Ascend hardware without changing their upper-layer inference code.
en.content: The repo contains the plugin's core C++/Python implementation, operator adaptation layers, build scripts, and full documentation (support matrix, user guide, DeepWiki entry), along with bilingual READMEs and release notes.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Python bindings, built on vLLM's plugin mechanism and depending on the Ascend CANN stack and torch-npu components.
en.hot: As a rare Ascend hardware adaptation in the vLLM ecosystem, it fills the gap for efficient LLM inference on Ascend, reaching 2,803 stars and ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Engineers deploying LLM inference services on Huawei Ascend NPU clusters
AI infrastructure teams wanting to run vLLM on domestic accelerators
Developers doing operator adaptation and performance tuning for Ascend
Researchers tracking domestic AI chip ecosystems and inference framework integration

zh.tag: 微软 AirSim 进化版，高保真自主系统仿真平台
zh.what: Project AirSim 是微软 AirSim 的进化版，一个开源、可扩展、引擎无关的仿真平台，用于在虚拟环境中构建、训练和测试自主系统。它支持无人机、固定翼飞机、无人地面车辆等多种平台，可在轻量级 Runtime 或 Unreal Engine 5 中运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含仿真核心、API、Python/C++ 客户端、ROS 2 集成、示例场景和详细文档，以及用于 CI 的测试工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Unreal Engine 5.2/5.7、ROS 2 Humble、Python 3.10+，支持 Linux 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 作为微软 AirSim 的官方进化版，它继承了 AirSim 的知名度，并提供了更模块化、引擎无关的架构，今日登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 11 名，获得 847 颗星。
uses: 无人机/自动驾驶研发者 —— 在虚拟环境中快速测试控制算法和感知系统
机器人研究者 —— 利用 ROS 2 集成进行多机器人仿真和算法验证
AI 训练工程师 —— 生成合成数据训练视觉和导航模型
教育与爱好者 —— 学习自主系统仿真和 Unreal Engine 集成

en.tag: Microsoft's AirSim evolution: high-fidelity simulation platform for autonomous systems
en.what: Project AirSim is Microsoft's evolution of AirSim, an open-source, extensible, engine-independent simulation platform for building, training, and testing autonomous systems in virtual environments. It supports drones, fixed-wing aircraft, UGVs, and more, running either in a lightweight Runtime or with Unreal Engine 5.
en.content: The repository contains the simulation core, APIs, Python/C++ clients, ROS 2 integration, sample scenes, comprehensive documentation, and CI test workflows.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on Unreal Engine 5.2/5.7, ROS 2 Humble, and Python 3.10+, supporting Linux and Windows.
en.hot: As the official evolution of Microsoft's AirSim, it inherits AirSim's popularity and offers a more modular, engine-independent architecture. It trended at #11 on GitHub Trending (C++) today with 847 stars.
uses: Drone/autonomous driving developers — quickly test control algorithms and perception systems in virtual environments
Robotics researchers — leverage ROS 2 integration for multi-robot simulation and algorithm validation
AI training engineers — generate synthetic data to train vision and navigation models
Educators and hobbyists — learn autonomous system simulation and Unreal Engine integration

zh.tag: 现代C++原生单元测试与微基准框架
zh.what: Catch2 是一个主要面向 C++ 的单元测试框架，同时提供基础的微基准测试功能和简单的 BDD 宏。其核心优势是使用简单自然：测试名无需是合法标识符，断言看起来就像普通的 C++ 布尔表达式，并且用 section 在测试内局部共享 setup/teardown 代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Catch2 的完整源码、构建脚本、测试用例和文档。v3 版本已发布，不再是单头文件库，而是像普通库一样由多个头文件和单独编译的源文件组成。
zh.stack: 基于 C++14/17 及更高标准，C++11 支持在 v2.x 分支，C++03 支持在 Catch1.x 分支。依赖 CMake 构建，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 等平台。
zh.hot: Catch2 拥有 21469 个 Star，今日新增 0，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜（C++）第 12 名。作为 C++ 社区广泛采用的测试框架，其稳定性和易用性持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: C++ 开发者进行单元测试、TDD 或 BDD 开发 —— 需要简洁自然的测试编写体验。
需要微基准测试的 C++ 项目 —— 可直接使用内置的 BENCHMARK 宏。
跨平台 C++ 项目 —— 支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 等多种环境。
从 v2.x 或 Catch1.x 迁移的项目 —— 可升级到 v3 获得更现代的库结构。

en.tag: A modern, C++-native test framework for unit tests, TDD and BDD
en.what: Catch2 is mainly a unit testing framework for C++, but it also provides basic micro-benchmarking features and simple BDD macros. Its main advantage is that using it is both simple and natural: test names do not have to be valid identifiers, assertions look like normal C++ boolean expressions, and sections provide a nice and local way to share set-up and tear-down code in tests.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build scripts, test cases, and documentation for Catch2. With v3 released, it is no longer a single-header library but behaves as a normal library with multiple headers and separately compiled sources.
en.stack: Built on C++14/17 and later, with C++11 support in the v2.x branch and C++03 in the Catch1.x branch. It uses CMake for building and supports Linux, macOS, Windows, and more.
en.hot: Catch2 has 21,469 stars, with 0 new today, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending daily (C++). As a widely adopted test framework in the C++ community, its stability and ease of use continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ developers doing unit testing, TDD, or BDD — need a simple and natural testing experience.
C++ projects needing micro-benchmarking — can use the built-in BENCHMARK macros directly.
Cross-platform C++ projects — supports Linux, macOS, Windows, and more.
Projects migrating from v2.x or Catch1.x — can upgrade to v3 for a more modern library structure.

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的端到端机器学习框架，人人可用
zh.what: TensorFlow 是一个端到端的开源机器学习平台，提供完整的工具、库和社区资源，帮助研究人员推动 ML 前沿，并让开发者轻松构建和部署 ML 应用。它最初由 Google Brain 团队开发，用于机器学习和神经网络研究，如今已广泛应用于各个领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TensorFlow 的核心 C++ 与 Python 实现、稳定的 Python 和 C++ API、丰富的工具与库（如 Keras、TensorBoard、TF Lite、TF.js 等），以及大量文档、示例和社区资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python 和 C++ 稳定 API，并支持多种其他语言；依赖包括 CUDA/cuDNN（GPU 支持）、Bazel 构建系统、NumPy 等。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的机器学习框架之一，TensorFlow 拥有近 20 万 Star，今日新增 391 Star，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 13 名，持续受到广泛关注。
uses: 机器学习研究人员和工程师，用于快速实验和部署模型
数据科学家和 AI 开发者，构建从研究到生产的 ML 应用
学生和教师，用于学习和教授深度学习与神经网络
企业团队，利用 TensorFlow 生态进行大规模 ML 部署

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open source machine learning framework for everyone
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning, offering a comprehensive ecosystem of tools, libraries, and community resources that lets researchers push the state-of-the-art in ML and developers easily build and deploy ML-powered applications. Originally developed by the Google Brain team for machine learning and neural network research, it is now used in many other areas as well.
en.content: The repository contains TensorFlow's core C++ and Python implementation, stable Python and C++ APIs, a rich set of tools and libraries (such as Keras, TensorBoard, TF Lite, TF.js), along with extensive documentation, examples, and community resources.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it provides stable Python and C++ APIs and supports other languages; dependencies include CUDA/cuDNN (for GPU support), Bazel build system, NumPy, and more.
en.hot: As one of the most popular machine learning frameworks, TensorFlow has nearly 200k stars, with 391 new stars today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++, maintaining widespread attention.
uses: Machine learning researchers and engineers for rapid experimentation and model deployment
Data scientists and AI developers building ML applications from research to production
Students and educators for learning and teaching deep learning and neural networks
Enterprise teams leveraging the TensorFlow ecosystem for large-scale ML deployment

zh.tag: 腾讯开源的高性能移动端神经网络推理框架
zh.what: ncnn 是一个面向移动端、嵌入式和桌面端部署优化的高性能神经网络推理框架。它无第三方运行时依赖，支持 CPU 与 Vulkan GPU 后端，并提供 pnnx 工具把 PyTorch/ONNX 模型转换为 ncnn 模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 推理核心、Python 绑定、pnnx 模型转换工具、examples 示例以及完整的构建与测试脚本。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 实现，依赖 CMake 构建，可选 Vulkan、OpenMP、Vulkan GPU 等后端，并提供 Python API 与 pnnx（基于 PyTorch）转换链路。
zh.hot: 作为腾讯内部 QQ、微信等应用长期使用的推理引擎，ncnn 以零依赖、跨平台和高性能著称，累计 23804 star，今日仍登上 C++ 日榜第 14 名。
uses: 移动端/嵌入式 AI 应用开发者，需要在手机或边缘设备上部署模型
算法工程师，希望把 PyTorch/ONNX 模型快速转换为端侧可用的推理格式
对高性能 C++ 推理框架感兴趣、想学习 Vulkan GPU 加速的研究者

en.tag: Tencent's high-performance neural network inference framework for mobile and edge
en.what: ncnn is a high-performance neural network inference framework optimized for mobile, embedded, and desktop deployment. It has no third-party runtime dependencies, supports CPU and Vulkan GPU backends, and ships pnnx to convert PyTorch and ONNX models into ncnn models.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ inference core, Python bindings, the pnnx model converter, examples, and full build/test scripts.
en.stack: Written in C++ with CMake, optional Vulkan/OpenMP backends, plus a Python API and the PyTorch-based pnnx conversion pipeline.
en.hot: Long used inside Tencent apps like QQ and WeChat, ncnn is known for zero dependencies, cross-platform support, and high performance, with 23,804 stars and a #14 spot on today's C++ trending list.
uses: Mobile/embedded AI developers who need to deploy models on phones or edge devices
Algorithm engineers converting PyTorch/ONNX models into on-device inference formats
Researchers interested in high-performance C++ inference and Vulkan GPU acceleration

zh.tag: 把 ESP32 变成多协议硬件黑客工具，带网页 CLI
zh.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate 是一款开源固件，把 ESP32 设备变成多协议开发与分析工具，灵感来自经典的 Bus Pirate。它支持通过串口终端或网页 CLI 对 I2C、UART、1-Wire、SPI 等数字协议进行嗅探、发送、脚本化和交互，同时还能处理蓝牙、Wi-Fi、Sub-GHz 和 RFID 等无线协议。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、硬件指南、网页烧录工具、Web 工具集、配方示例和 Wiki 文档，覆盖从 HiZ、I2C、SPI 到蓝牙、Wi-Fi、JTAG、CAN 等二十余种工作模式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 ESP32 平台，依赖 ESP-IDF 或 Arduino 框架，并集成 LittleFS 文件系统与 Web 服务器。
zh.hot: 凭借 5779 颗星和今日新增 15 星登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 15 名，它把昂贵的专业硬件黑客工具功能浓缩到廉价的 ESP32 上，并提供便捷的网页 CLI，吸引了大量硬件爱好者和安全研究者。
uses: 硬件爱好者与创客，用于快速原型开发和协议调试
安全研究人员，用于嵌入式设备的安全评估与渗透测试
嵌入式工程师，用于 I2C、SPI、UART 等总线分析与故障排查
教育场景，用于学习数字与无线通信协议的工作原理

en.tag: Turn an ESP32 into a multi-protocol hardware hacking tool with a web CLI
en.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate is open-source firmware that turns an ESP32 device into a multi-protocol development and analysis tool, inspired by the legendary Bus Pirate. It supports sniffing, sending, scripting, and interacting with digital protocols (I2C, UART, 1-Wire, SPI, etc.) via a serial terminal or web-based CLI, and also handles radio protocols like Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Sub-GHz, and RFID.
en.content: The repo contains firmware source code, hardware guides, a web flasher, web tools, recipes, and wiki documentation, covering over twenty modes from HiZ, I2C, and SPI to Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, JTAG, and CAN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ for the ESP32 platform, built on ESP-IDF or Arduino framework, and integrates LittleFS file system and a web server.
en.hot: With 5,779 stars and 15 added today, it ranks 15th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, condensing expensive professional hardware hacking tools into a cheap ESP32 with a convenient web CLI, attracting hardware hobbyists and security researchers.
uses: Hardware hobbyists and makers for rapid prototyping and protocol debugging
Security researchers for embedded device security assessment and penetration testing
Embedded engineers for I2C, SPI, UART bus analysis and troubleshooting
Educational settings for learning how digital and wireless communication protocols work

zh.tag: 微软官方 WSL 仓库，在 Windows 上原生运行 Linux 工具链
zh.what: WSL 让开发者无需传统虚拟机或双系统，就能在 Windows 上直接运行未经修改的 Linux 命令行工具、实用程序和应用程序。只需在 Windows 命令行执行 wsl --install 即可完成安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSL 的源码、开发者文档（doc/docs/dev-loop.md）、贡献指南、行为准则、数据与隐私说明，以及配套的 WSL2-Linux-Kernel、WSLg 和文档仓库链接。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主要语言，深度集成 Windows 系统与 Hyper-V 虚拟化平台，并配套自研的 Linux 内核与 GUI 支持组件。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方维护的核心开发基础设施，累计收获 33677 颗星，今日新增 12 星并登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 16 名，热度长期稳定。
uses: Windows 平台开发者，希望在本地无缝使用 Linux 命令行工具链
需要在 Windows 上运行 Linux 服务或脚本的运维与后端工程师
想避免双系统或重型虚拟机开销、追求轻量开发环境的技术爱好者
为 WSL 贡献代码、文档或设计提案的开源贡献者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WSL repo: run Linux tooling natively on Windows
en.what: WSL lets developers run unmodified Linux command-line tools, utilities and apps directly on Windows without the overhead of a traditional VM or dual boot. Installation is as simple as running wsl --install in a Windows command line.
en.content: The repo holds WSL source code, developer docs (doc/docs/dev-loop.md), contribution guidelines, a code of conduct, data and privacy notes, plus links to the companion WSL2-Linux-Kernel, WSLg and docs repositories.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, deeply integrated with Windows and the Hyper-V virtualization platform, with companion custom Linux kernel and GUI support components.
en.hot: As Microsoft's officially maintained core developer infrastructure, it has accumulated 33,677 stars, gaining 12 today and ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, showing sustained popularity.
uses: Windows developers who want a seamless local Linux command-line toolchain
DevOps and backend engineers running Linux services or scripts on Windows
Enthusiasts seeking a lightweight dev environment without dual boot or heavy VMs
Open-source contributors adding code, docs or design proposals to WSL

zh.tag: 以太坊智能合约语言 Solidity 官方编译器与工具链
zh.what: Solidity 是面向合约、静态类型的高级编程语言，用于在以太坊虚拟机上编写智能合约。该仓库是 Solidity 语言的官方实现，包含编译器 solc 及配套开发工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含编译器源码（libsolidity、libyul 等）、命令行工具 solc、测试套件、文档与示例合约，以及构建脚本和 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Boost、JSONCPP 等库，通过 CMake 构建，可编译为原生二进制或 Emscripten WASM。
zh.hot: 作为以太坊生态最核心的语言实现，累计收获 25,736 颗星；今日新增 4 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 17 名，反映其持续的基础设施地位。
uses: 区块链开发者：用于编写和编译部署在以太坊上的智能合约
安全审计人员：分析 Solidity 编译器行为与合约字节码
编译器研究者：学习静态类型语言与 EVM 后端实现
Web3 项目团队：集成 solc 到构建流程与 CI 中

en.tag: The official compiler and toolchain for the Solidity smart contract language
en.what: Solidity is a statically-typed, contract-oriented high-level language for writing smart contracts on the Ethereum Virtual Machine. This repository is the official implementation, including the solc compiler and related developer tooling.
en.content: The repo contains compiler source (libsolidity, libyul, etc.), the solc CLI, test suites, documentation and example contracts, plus build scripts and CI configuration.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depending on Boost, JSONCPP and other libraries, built with CMake and compilable to native binaries or Emscripten WASM.
en.hot: As the core language implementation of the Ethereum ecosystem, it has accumulated 25,736 stars; with 4 new stars today and ranking 17th on the C++ daily trending list, reflecting its enduring infrastructure status.
uses: Blockchain developers: write and compile smart contracts deployed on Ethereum
Security auditors: analyze Solidity compiler behavior and contract bytecode
Compiler researchers: study statically-typed language and EVM backend implementation
Web3 project teams: integrate solc into build pipelines and CI

zh.tag: 由 MySQL 原班人马打造的开源关系型数据库，兼容 MySQL 并自带向量检索
zh.what: MariaDB Server 是由 MySQL 原始核心团队发起的开源关系型数据库，与 MySQL 保持高度兼容，可直接迁移。它在兼容之外发展出自己的能力，包括原生向量搜索、多种可插拔存储引擎、同步集群和分析型特性。
zh.content: 仓库是完整的数据库服务端源码，包含存储引擎、复制与集群、SQL 解析执行、安全与加密等模块，以及测试框架和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主实现，构建依赖 CMake、Boost 等；支持 InnoDB、Aria、MyRocks、ColumnStore、Spider、S3 等多种存储引擎。
zh.hot: 作为最广泛部署的开源关系型数据库之一，它已积累 8206 颗星，今日新增 6 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 18 名，11.8 引入的原生向量搜索让它在 AI 时代重新受到关注。
uses: 需要从 MySQL 平滑迁移、又想要更开放许可的团队与运维工程师
在数据库内直接做向量检索、构建 RAG 或语义搜索应用的 AI 开发者
需要分析型、分片或同步多主集群架构的数据平台与架构师

en.tag: Community-developed MySQL fork with native vector search and pluggable engines
en.what: MariaDB Server is an open-source relational database forked from MySQL by its original core developers, keeping a high degree of MySQL compatibility so existing deployments can migrate easily. Beyond compatibility it adds its own capabilities such as native vector search, pluggable storage engines, synchronous clustering, and analytical features.
en.content: The repo holds the full database server source, covering storage engines, replication and clustering, SQL parsing and execution, security and encryption, plus the test framework and build scripts.
en.stack: Implemented mainly in C++, built with CMake and Boost; supports many storage engines including InnoDB, Aria, MyRocks, ColumnStore, Spider, and S3.
en.hot: As one of the most widely deployed open-source relational databases, it has gathered 8,206 stars, adding 6 today to rank 18th on the C++ daily trending list, with the native vector search added in 11.8 renewing interest in the AI era.
uses: Teams and DBAs wanting a smooth migration from MySQL with a more open license
AI developers building RAG or semantic search who want vector search inside the database
Data platform teams and architects needing analytics, sharding, or synchronous multi-primary clustering

zh.tag: 统一加载40多种3D文件格式的C++库
zh.what: Assimp 是一个开源库，用于将各种 3D 文件格式（如 FBX、OBJ、glTF 等）加载到统一的内存数据结构中。它支持超过 40 种格式的导入和多种格式的导出，并提供网格后处理工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C/C++ 源代码、CMake 构建脚本、测试用例、文档和示例。主要目录有 code（核心实现）、include（头文件）、test（单元测试）、tools（辅助工具）等。
zh.stack: 使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 C 和 C++ API，并有 C#、Java、Python 等语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 图形领域的标准工具库，Assimp 拥有超过 13k stars，今日新增 6 星，登上 C++ 日榜第 19 名，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 游戏开发者：需要导入多种 3D 模型格式到自研引擎中。
3D 工具开发者：构建模型查看器、转换器或处理管线。
研究人员：在机器学习或计算机视觉中处理 3D 数据。
跨平台应用开发者：在 Android、iOS 或桌面端集成 3D 资源加载。

en.tag: A C++ library that loads 40+ 3D file formats into one unified structure
en.what: Assimp is an open-source library that loads various 3D file formats (e.g., FBX, OBJ, glTF) into a unified in-memory data structure. It supports importing over 40 formats and exporting a growing selection, with mesh post-processing tools.
en.content: The repository contains C/C++ source code, CMake build scripts, test cases, documentation, and examples. Main directories include code (core implementation), include (headers), test (unit tests), tools (utilities), etc.
en.stack: Written in C++, uses CMake build system, provides C and C++ APIs, with bindings for C#, Java, Python, and more.
en.hot: As a standard utility library in 3D graphics, Assimp has over 13k stars, with 6 new stars today, ranking 19th on the C++ daily trending list, consistently attracting developer attention.
uses: Game developers: need to import various 3D model formats into custom engines.
3D tool developers: building model viewers, converters, or processing pipelines.
Researchers: processing 3D data in machine learning or computer vision.
Cross-platform app developers: integrating 3D asset loading on Android, iOS, or desktop.

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: Claude Code 技能集，提升指令遵循与开发效率
zh.what: 这是 HumanLayer 提供的 Claude Code 技能集合，通过 npx 命令安装后，可在项目中以斜杠命令调用。技能包括改进 CLAUDE.md、收窄 React 属性类型、构建迭代式代理循环等，旨在增强 Claude Code 在真实项目中的实用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能目录，每个技能有独立的安装说明和用法示例，如 /improve-claude-md、/narrow-react-prop-types 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Claude Code 的 skills 机制和 npx 进行分发。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1141 星，总星数达 2309，说明开发者对提升 Claude Code 工作流的实用技能需求旺盛。
uses: 希望优化 CLAUDE.md 指令遵循的 Claude Code 用户
需要收窄 React 组件属性类型以匹配实际代码路径的开发者
想构建自动化代理循环或设计控制循环的工程师
需要快速可视化理解代码主题的学习者

en.tag: A collection of Claude Code skills to boost instruction adherence and dev efficiency
en.what: This is a collection of Claude Code skills from HumanLayer, installable via npx and invoked as slash commands in projects. Skills include improving CLAUDE.md, narrowing React prop types, and building iterative agentic loops, aiming to enhance Claude Code's utility in real projects.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill directories, each with installation instructions and usage examples, such as /improve-claude-md and /narrow-react-prop-types.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, leveraging Claude Code's skills mechanism and distributed via npx.
en.hot: With 1,141 stars added today and 2,309 total, there's strong demand for practical skills that enhance Claude Code workflows.
uses: Claude Code users looking to optimize instruction adherence in CLAUDE.md
Developers needing to narrow React prop types to match live code paths
Engineers aiming to build automated agentic loops or design control loops
Learners who want quick visual explanations of code topics

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 面向真实工程实践的轻量可组合 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是 Matt Pocock 日常使用的 AI 代理技能（skills）集合，面向真实软件开发而非“氛围编程”。它刻意保持小而可改、可组合，兼容任意模型，并基于多年工程经验沉淀。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本形式的技能文件为主，放在 .agents 目录下，包含安装说明、ADR 决策记录，以及通过 Claude Code 插件或 skills.sh 分发的技能集合。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 脚本为核心，依赖 Claude Code 插件市场与 npx skills 安装器，可搭配 Codex 等任意编码代理使用。
zh.hot: 本周新增 13143 星、总数超 25 万，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 5；在 AI 代理技能热潮中，它以“反框架、可掌控”的定位吸引大量工程师关注。
uses: 希望用 AI 代理做真实工程而非氛围编程的开发者
想按自己需求改造、组合代理技能的高级工程师
在 Claude Code、Codex 等代理间切换、追求模型无关方案的用户

en.tag: Small, composable agent skills for real engineering, not vibe coding
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills Matt Pocock uses daily for real software engineering rather than vibe coding. They are intentionally small, easy to adapt, composable, model-agnostic, and grounded in decades of engineering experience.
en.content: The repo mainly contains Shell-based skill files under the .agents directory, plus installation docs, ADR decision records, and skills distributed via the Claude Code plugin or skills.sh.
en.stack: Built around Shell scripts, relying on the Claude Code plugin marketplace and the npx skills installer, and usable with any coding agent such as Codex.
en.hot: It gained 13,143 stars this week, surpassing 257k total and ranking 5th on GitHub Trending weekly; amid the AI agent skills boom, its anti-framework, stay-in-control positioning draws heavy engineer interest.
uses: Developers who want AI agents for real engineering, not vibe coding
Senior engineers who want to fork, adapt, and compose agent skills themselves
Users switching between Claude Code, Codex, and other agents who need a model-agnostic setup

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，可通过 skills CLI 或手动安装到任何支持技能指令的代理框架中。支持全局或项目级安装，并可作为 Claude Code 插件使用。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 技能文件，无外部依赖，可在任何支持技能指令的代理框架中运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1504 星，总星数 31573，排名 Python 周榜第 16。因其解决了 AI 写作“一眼假”的痛点，且安装使用极其简单，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 将 AI 草稿润色为自然的人类风格，避免被检测
开发者 —— 集成到代理工作流中，自动优化 AI 生成的文本输出
学术写作者 —— 确保论文或报告中的 AI 辅助内容更符合人类写作习惯

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.
en.content: The repo contains a single SKILL.md file that can be installed via skills CLI or manually into any agent harness supporting skill-style instructions. Supports global or project-local install and can be used as a Claude Code plugin.
en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: Codex 技能目录，已弃用，迁移至 OpenAI Plugins
zh.what: 这是一个为 Codex 等 AI 代理提供技能（Skills）的目录仓库，技能是包含指令、脚本和资源的文件夹，代理可发现并使用它们来执行特定任务。该仓库已弃用，当前推荐使用 OpenAI Plugins 仓库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 .system、.curated 和 .experimental 三个技能分类目录，每个技能目录内包含指令文件和可选的 LICENSE.txt。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，但技能本身是跨语言的指令和脚本集合，依赖 Codex 环境。
zh.hot: 尽管已弃用，但作为 OpenAI 官方仓库仍获得 25621 星，说明开发者对 Agent Skills 标准和高星仓库的关注度极高。
uses: Codex 用户：安装和使用官方策划的技能，如 gh-address-comments。
技能开发者：参考技能目录结构，学习如何创建自定义技能。
研究 Agent 技能标准：了解 Agent Skills 开放标准及其应用。

en.tag: Deprecated skills catalog for Codex; moved to OpenAI Plugins
en.what: This is a catalog repository of skills for AI agents like Codex. Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and use to perform specific tasks. The repository is deprecated; users are directed to the OpenAI Plugins repository.
en.content: The repository contains three skill categories: .system, .curated, and .experimental. Each skill folder includes instruction files and an optional LICENSE.txt.
en.stack: Primarily Python, but skills are cross-language instruction and script collections, depending on the Codex environment.
en.hot: Despite being deprecated, it has 25,621 stars, showing high developer interest in Agent Skills standards and official OpenAI repositories.
uses: Codex users: install and use curated skills like gh-address-comments.
Skill developers: reference the catalog structure to create custom skills.
Researchers of agent skill standards: learn about the Agent Skills open standard.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的 HTML 转视频渲染框架
zh.what: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，可将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可定位动画转换为确定性的 MP4 视频。它支持本地 CLI 使用，也可作为 AI 编码代理的技能，或作为托管创作流程的渲染核心。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、CLI 工具、技能包（SKILL.md）、文档、示例和展示页面。核心是让代理通过编写 HTML 来生成视频，并支持可定位动画。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，要求 Node.js >= 22，通过 npm 分发，并集成了 AI 代理技能系统（如 Claude 和 Agents skills）。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.4 万+ Star 和每日新增 220 的热度，它精准切中 AI 代理自动生成视频的需求，将 HTML 编写与视频渲染无缝结合，成为 GitHub Trending 上的明星项目。
uses: AI 代理开发者：希望让代理自动生成视频内容，如产品介绍、教程等。
视频创作者：通过编写 HTML 快速生成可定制、确定性的视频，无需传统编辑软件。
自动化工作流：在 CI/CD 或内容管道中集成视频渲染，实现批量生成。
前端开发者：利用熟悉的 HTML/CSS 技能创建动画和视频效果。

en.tag: Open-source framework turning HTML/CSS into deterministic MP4 videos, built for AI agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, as skills for AI coding agents, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, CLI tools, skill packages (SKILL.md), documentation, examples, and showcase pages. The core enables agents to generate videos by writing HTML, with support for seekable animations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 22, distributed via npm, and integrates AI agent skill systems (e.g., Claude and Agents skills).
en.hot: With over 44k stars and 220 daily additions, it precisely meets the demand for AI-agent-driven video generation, seamlessly combining HTML authoring with video rendering, making it a star on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers: enable agents to automatically generate video content like product intros or tutorials.
Video creators: quickly produce customizable, deterministic videos by writing HTML, without traditional editing software.
Automation workflows: integrate video rendering into CI/CD or content pipelines for batch generation.
Frontend developers: leverage familiar HTML/CSS skills to create animations and video effects.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手提供 38 种编辑级图表模板
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi）设计的技能包，提供 38 种编辑级质量的图表类型。它生成自包含的 HTML+SVG 文件，无需构建步骤或外部依赖，并强调无阴影、无 Mermaid 风格的设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 38 种图表类型的定义，每种都有浅色、深色和全编辑三种静态变体，以及文档和截图。还包含语义模式系统，可将行为与布局分离，并支持从 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源重绘图表。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript 或外部图像依赖。设计为与 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 AI 代理兼容，并支持 Agent Skills 标准。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得超过 30.9k 星标，今日新增 437 星。它解决了 AI 生成图表质量差的痛点，提供了设计师认可的高质量模板，并持续更新新图表类型。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成架构图、流程图等，避免手动调整样式
内容创作者需要快速制作编辑级图表，用于博客、文档或演示
团队希望统一图表风格，通过读取网站自动匹配品牌视觉

en.tag: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi
en.what: A skill pack for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, offering 38 editorial-quality diagram types. It generates self-contained HTML+SVG files with no build step or external dependencies, emphasizing a clean design without shadows or Mermaid-style output.
en.content: The repo contains definitions for 38 diagram types, each with minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial static variants, plus docs and screenshots. It also includes a semantic pattern system that separates behavior from layout, and can redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, with no JavaScript or external image dependencies. Designed to work with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and compatible with Agent Skills.
en.hot: The repo has gone viral on GitHub with over 30.9k stars and 437 stars today. It addresses the pain point of low-quality AI-generated diagrams by offering designer-approved templates, and it continuously adds new diagram types.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Codex to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, etc., without manual styling
Content creators needing quick editorial-quality diagrams for blogs, docs, or presentations
Teams wanting consistent diagram styling, with automatic brand matching by reading a website

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，快速安全的 printf/iostream 替代品
zh.what: {fmt} 是一个开源格式化库，提供快速且安全的 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 替代方案。它实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print，并支持类似 Python 的格式字符串语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、示例和测试，核心文件包括 base.h、format.h 等，支持用户自定义类型和可移植的 Unicode。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖少，支持 C++11 及以上标准，使用 Dragonbox 算法进行快速浮点格式化。
zh.hot: 今日新增 963 星，总星数达 25081，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。作为 C++ 标准库格式化功能的基础，其高性能和安全性备受开发者青睐。
uses: C++ 开发者需要比 printf 或 iostream 更安全、更快速的格式化输出时使用
库作者希望实现或扩展 C++20/23 格式化功能，或为自定义类型提供格式化支持
需要高精度浮点格式化且要求正确舍入和往返保证的数值计算场景

en.tag: A modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. It implements C++20's std::format and C++23's std::print, with a format string syntax similar to Python's.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, examples, and tests, with core files like base.h and format.h, supporting user-defined types and portable Unicode.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with minimal dependencies, supports C++11 and later, uses the Dragonbox algorithm for fast floating-point formatting.
en.hot: With 963 stars added today and 25,081 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. As the foundation for C++ standard formatting, its high performance and safety are widely appreciated.
uses: For C++ developers needing safer and faster formatting than printf or iostreams
For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types
For numerical computing scenarios requiring high-precision floating-point formatting with correct rounding and round-trip guarantees

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的市场营销技能库
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）设计的营销技能集合，涵盖转化率优化、文案写作、SEO、分析和增长工程。它帮助技术营销人员和创始人利用 AI 编码代理自动执行营销任务，并遵循 Agent Skills 规范。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 Markdown 格式的技能文件，每个技能提供特定营销任务的框架和最佳实践。技能之间相互引用，以 product-marketing 为基础，其他技能先读取它来了解产品、受众和定位。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，但核心是 Markdown 技能文件。兼容支持 Agent Skills 规范的代理，如 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Cursor 等。
zh.hot: 星标数达 4.6 万，今日新增 154，登上 JavaScript 日榜。它填补了 AI 代理在营销领域的空白，将营销专业知识结构化，让 AI 代理能直接应用，因此受到技术营销者和创始人的追捧。
uses: 技术营销人员：希望利用 AI 代理自动执行营销任务，提升效率。
创始人：需要 AI 辅助进行转化优化、文案和 SEO，以驱动增长。
AI 代理开发者：希望集成营销技能到自己的代理中，扩展功能。

en.tag: Marketing skills library for AI agents
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills for marketing tasks, including CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. It enables technical marketers and founders to leverage AI coding agents for marketing automation, following the Agent Skills spec.
en.content: The repo contains multiple Markdown skill files, each providing frameworks and best practices for specific marketing tasks. Skills reference each other, with product-marketing as the foundation that others read first to understand product, audience, and positioning.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, but the core is Markdown skill files. Compatible with agents supporting the Agent Skills spec, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and others.
en.hot: With 46k stars and 154 new today, it hit the JavaScript daily trending. It fills a gap by structuring marketing expertise for AI agents, making it directly applicable, thus attracting technical marketers and founders.
uses: Technical marketers: want to automate marketing tasks with AI agents for efficiency.
Founders: need AI assistance for CRO, copywriting, and SEO to drive growth.
AI agent developers: integrate marketing skills into their agents to extend capabilities.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程助手直接操控 Chrome 的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: chrome-devtools-mcp 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，允许 AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor、Copilot）实时控制并检查 Chrome 浏览器。它提供性能洞察、高级调试和可靠自动化能力，并附带 CLI 供非 MCP 场景使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器实现、CLI 工具、文档（工具参考、故障排除、设计原则等）以及贡献指南。核心功能包括性能追踪、网络请求分析、截图和 console 消息检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 puppeteer 实现浏览器自动化，依赖 Chrome DevTools 前端进行性能追踪，并集成 Google CrUX API 获取真实用户体验数据。
zh.hot: 凭借 5 万+ star 成为 AI 代理工具链的明星项目，本周新增 738 star 登上 TypeScript 周榜。它让 AI 编程助手获得浏览器级调试能力，极大提升自动化与排错效率。
uses: AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor）需要自动化浏览器操作或调试前端代码的开发者
需要分析网页性能、网络请求和 console 错误的 QA 或性能工程师
希望为自定义 AI 工作流集成浏览器控制能力的 MCP 用户
对 Chrome DevTools 自动化感兴趣，想扩展其能力的开发者

en.tag: MCP server that lets coding agents control and inspect Chrome
en.what: chrome-devtools-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets coding agents (like Claude, Cursor, Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It provides performance insights, advanced debugging, and reliable automation, with a CLI for non-MCP use.
en.content: The repo contains the MCP server implementation, a CLI, docs (tool reference, troubleshooting, design principles), and contributing guidelines. Key features include performance tracing, network analysis, screenshots, and console message inspection.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses puppeteer for browser automation, leverages Chrome DevTools frontend for performance tracing, and integrates Google CrUX API for real-user experience data.
en.hot: With 50k+ stars, it's a star in the AI agent toolchain, gaining 738 stars this week and ranking #18 on TypeScript weekly. It gives coding agents browser-level debugging, boosting automation and troubleshooting efficiency.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to automate browser tasks or debug frontend code
QA or performance engineers needing to analyze page performance, network requests, and console errors
MCP users who want to integrate browser control into custom AI workflows
Developers interested in extending Chrome DevTools automation capabilities

zh.tag: 微软出品的文件转 Markdown 工具，为 LLM 喂料而生
zh.what: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，能把 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML、ZIP、YouTube 链接等多种格式统一转换成 Markdown。它重点保留标题、列表、表格、链接等文档结构，输出主要面向 LLM 与文本分析管线，而非高保真的人用排版。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式组织，核心是 markitdown 包及其各类格式转换器，另含 CLI 入口、可选依赖分组（如 [all]）与安全注意事项文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，通过 pip 安装，支持 uv/venv/conda 环境，按需引入 PDF、OCR、语音转写等可选依赖。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，它精准踩中 LLM 数据预处理刚需，已积累约 18.2 万 star，本周再增 4579 并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 需要把大量异构文档转成 Markdown 再喂给 LLM 的 RAG 与数据工程开发者
想快速把 PDF、Word、PPT 转成纯文本做检索或摘要的研究与内容团队
在命令行或脚本里批量处理 Office 文档、图片 OCR、音频转写的自动化用户

en.tag: Microsoft's file-to-Markdown converter built to feed LLMs
en.what: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts PDFs, Office documents, images, audio, HTML, ZIP files, YouTube URLs and more into Markdown. It focuses on preserving document structure like headings, lists, tables and links, targeting LLM and text-analysis pipelines rather than high-fidelity human-facing output.
en.content: The repo is organized as a Python package, with the core markitdown package and per-format converters, plus a CLI entry point, optional dependency groups (e.g. [all]) and security documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, installed via pip, compatible with uv/venv/conda, and pulls in optional dependencies for PDF, OCR and speech transcription as needed.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it hits the sweet spot of LLM data preprocessing, racking up about 182k stars, adding 4,579 this week and ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's weekly chart.
uses: RAG and data engineers who need to turn heterogeneous documents into Markdown for LLMs
Research and content teams wanting to convert PDFs, Word and PPT into plain text for search or summarization
Automation users batch-processing Office docs, image OCR and audio transcription from CLI or scripts

zh.tag: 自我进化的 AI 代理，跨平台、跨会话持续学习
zh.what: Hermes Agent 是一款由 Nous Research 构建的自我进化 AI 代理，内置学习循环，能从经验中创建技能、在应用中改进技能，并持续构建用户模型。它支持在多种平台（Telegram、Discord、Slack 等）和多种模型提供商之间无缝运行，且不锁定特定环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的代理代码库、终端 TUI 界面、跨平台网关、技能创建与改进机制、记忆管理、定时自动化（cron）、以及多语言 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖包括 FTS5 搜索、LLM 集成（支持 Nous Portal、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等）、以及 Honcho 用户建模库。
zh.hot: 凭借 24 万+ 星标和日增 774 星，其独特的自我改进学习循环和跨平台、跨会话的持久记忆能力引发了广泛关注，成为 AI 代理领域的热门项目。
uses: 开发者和 AI 爱好者希望部署一个能自主学习和适应用户行为的个人 AI 代理。
需要跨平台（如 Telegram、Discord）与 AI 交互并保持对话连续性的团队或个人。
研究者探索代理记忆、技能自动化和用户建模等前沿方向。

en.tag: Self-improving AI agent that learns from experience across sessions and platforms
en.what: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research, featuring a built-in learning loop that creates skills from experience, improves them during use, and builds a deepening model of the user. It runs seamlessly across platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc.) and model providers without lock-in.
en.content: The repository contains the full agent codebase, a terminal TUI, cross-platform gateway, skill creation and improvement mechanisms, memory management, scheduled automations (cron), and multilingual READMEs and docs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with dependencies on FTS5 search, LLM integrations (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.), and the Honcho user modeling library.
en.hot: With over 240K stars and 774 stars added today, its unique self-improving learning loop and persistent cross-session memory have captured attention, making it a trending project in the AI agent space.
uses: Developers and AI enthusiasts seeking a personal AI agent that autonomously learns and adapts to user behavior.
Teams or individuals needing cross-platform AI interaction (e.g., Telegram, Discord) with conversation continuity.
Researchers exploring cutting-edge topics like agent memory, skill automation, and user modeling.

zh.tag: 智能体元框架：编排多智能体、自适应记忆与 RAG
zh.what: Ruflo 是一个用于构建和编排智能体系统的元框架，支持部署多智能体群、协调自主工作流，并构建对话式 AI。它集成了自适应记忆、自学习智能、RAG 检索增强生成，并原生支持 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes 等多种模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、CLI 工具（npx ruflo）、UI Beta 入口（flo.ruv.io），以及相关的生态组件如 Goal Planner、RuVector Agentic DB 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Node.js/npm 生态，集成 Claude Code、Codex 等插件，并依赖 Svelte 构建 UI。
zh.hot: 凭借 7 万+ star 和 8.1M+ 生态下载量，Ruflo 成为智能体编排领域的热门选择，今日新增 136 star，位列日榜第 9。
uses: 开发者快速构建多智能体协作应用，如自动化工作流、对话机器人。
需要自适应记忆和 RAG 能力的 AI 应用，如知识库问答、个性化助手。
希望集成 Claude Code、Codex 等模型的团队，统一管理智能体行为。
研究智能体自学习与元认知的 AI 工程师，探索前沿范式。

en.tag: Agent meta-harness for multi-agent swarms, adaptive memory, RAG, and Claude/Codex integration
en.what: Ruflo is a meta-harness for building and orchestrating agentic systems, enabling deployment of multi-agent swarms, coordination of autonomous workflows, and creation of conversational AI. It features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG integration, and native support for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and more.
en.content: The repo includes core framework code, CLI tool (npx ruflo), UI Beta entry (flo.ruv.io), and related ecosystem components like Goal Planner and RuVector Agentic DB.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Node.js/npm ecosystem, integrates Claude Code and Codex plugins, and uses Svelte for UI.
en.hot: With 70k+ stars and 8.1M+ ecosystem downloads, Ruflo is a popular choice for agent orchestration, gaining 136 stars today and ranking #9 on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers building multi-agent collaborative apps like automated workflows and chatbots.
AI applications needing adaptive memory and RAG, such as knowledge-base Q&A and personalized assistants.
Teams integrating Claude Code, Codex, etc., to unify agent behavior management.
AI engineers researching self-learning and metacognition in agents for cutting-edge paradigms.

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的界面设计技能合集，覆盖 UI、排版、配色与无障碍
zh.what: 这是一套给 AI 编码代理使用的技能包，把界面设计经验拆成可调用的 SKILL.md 模块。代理可以按需加载 better-ui、better-typography、better-colors 等技能，来改进项目里的视觉与交互细节。
zh.content: 仓库以 Markdown 为主，核心是 skills/ 目录下的十余个技能文件，如 better-interface、better-ui、better-typography、better-colors、better-accessibility、better-layout、better-writing，以及 interface-review、explain-interface、break、variant 等用户主动调用的技能。
zh.stack: 主体是 Markdown 编写的技能定义，通过 npx skills add 安装，也可作为 Claude Code 插件（marketplace add / plugin install）接入。
zh.hot: 本周新增 691 star、总数 6278，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 22 名；它把设计工程经验直接变成代理可执行的技能，正好踩中 AI 编码代理与前端质量提升的热点。
uses: 前端与设计工程师，用 AI 代理批量改进现有项目的 UI 细节
使用 Claude Code 等代理工具的开发者，希望代理产出更符合设计规范
设计系统或组件库维护者，需要统一排版、配色与无障碍标准
产品与内容团队，借助 better-writing 统一产品文案风格

en.tag: A collection of agent skills for building great interfaces: UI, typography, color, a11y
en.what: This is a set of skills for AI coding agents, packaging interface design expertise into callable SKILL.md modules. Agents can load skills like better-ui, better-typography and better-colors on demand to improve the visual and interaction details of a project.
en.content: The repo is mostly Markdown, centered on a skills/ directory with a dozen-plus skill files such as better-interface, better-ui, better-typography, better-colors, better-accessibility, better-layout and better-writing, plus user-invoked skills like interface-review, explain-interface, break and variant.
en.stack: The core is Markdown-based skill definitions, installed via npx skills add, and also usable as a Claude Code plugin through marketplace add / plugin install.
en.hot: It gained 691 stars this week for a total of 6,278, ranking 22nd on GitHub Trending weekly; by turning design engineering know-how into agent-executable skills, it rides the wave of AI coding agents and front-end quality improvement.
uses: Front-end and design engineers using AI agents to improve UI details across an existing project
Developers on agent tools like Claude Code who want more design-compliant output
Design system or component library maintainers needing consistent typography, color and a11y standards
Product and content teams using better-writing to keep product copy consistent

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 打造的全流程学术研究技能套件
zh.what: 这是一套为 Claude Code 设计的学术研究技能包，覆盖从研究到发表的完整流程，包括文献检索、写作、评审、修订和定稿。它强调人机协作，AI 作为副驾驶，帮助处理引用格式化、数据验证等繁琐工作，而研究者专注于核心思考。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块，如研究规划、写作质量检查、风格校准、评审等，并提供了详细的文档和参考材料，包括 AI 研究失败模式清单。安装简单，支持 CLI、VS Code 和 JetBrains。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python，作为 Claude Code 的插件使用，依赖 Claude Code 的插件系统。
zh.hot: 凭借近 4.5 万星标和日增 193 星，它精准切中学术写作痛点，提供人机协作而非全自动的方案，受到研究者和 AI 工具用户的广泛关注。
uses: 学术研究者：希望利用 AI 辅助论文写作，但保持对研究过程和内容的掌控。
学生和学者：需要高效管理参考文献、检查逻辑一致性，并提升写作质量。
AI 工具爱好者：探索 Claude Code 在专业领域的深度应用，学习如何构建技能插件。

en.tag: A comprehensive suite of Claude Code skills for the full academic research pipeline
en.what: This is a suite of skills for Claude Code covering the full academic research pipeline from research to publication, including literature search, writing, review, revision, and finalization. It emphasizes human-AI collaboration, with AI as a copilot handling grunt work like citation formatting and data verification, while researchers focus on core thinking.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill modules such as research planning, writing quality check, style calibration, and review, along with detailed documentation and reference materials including a list of AI research failure modes. Installation is simple, supporting CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains.
en.stack: Primarily based on Python, used as a plugin for Claude Code, relying on Claude Code's plugin system.
en.hot: With nearly 45k stars and 193 new stars today, it precisely addresses academic writing pain points, offering a human-in-the-loop rather than fully automated approach, gaining wide attention from researchers and AI tool users.
uses: Academic researchers who want AI assistance in paper writing while maintaining control over the research process and content.
Students and scholars needing efficient reference management, logical consistency checks, and writing quality improvement.
AI tool enthusiasts exploring deep applications of Claude Code in professional domains and learning to build skill plugins.

zh.tag: 清除 20+ 种 AI 味套路的写作编辑技能
zh.what: No AI Slop 是一个可安装到 ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理中的写作技能，用于识别并删除「It's not X. It's Y.」这类典型 AI 腔调。它在去套路的同时尽量保留作者原有的用词、节奏与个人语气。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md（编辑规则与流程）和 eval.md（自检清单），另有 .codex-plugin/plugin.json 插件元数据与 build_plugin.py 打包校验脚本。
zh.stack: 以 Python 编写构建与校验脚本，技能本身以 Markdown 规则文件形式分发，通过 npx skills 或直接粘贴提示词安装，依赖宿主代理运行。

en.tag: A writing skill that strips 20+ patterns of AI slop
en.what: No AI Slop is a skill you install into ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, or other coding agents to detect and remove telltale AI writing patterns like "It's not X. It's Y." It cleans up the slop while trying to preserve your own vocabulary, cadence, and voice.
en.content: The core is skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md (editing rules and workflow) plus eval.md (self-check list), alongside .codex-plugin/plugin.json plugin metadata and build_plugin.py for packaging and validation.
en.stack: Python powers the build and validation scripts, while the skill itself ships as Markdown rule files installed via npx skills or a pasted prompt, running inside a host agent.
en.hot: It gained 1,056 stars this week for 7,851 total and hit #20 on GitHub Trending, showing how many writers are fed up with same-sounding AI prose.

Writers who edit with ChatGPT or coding agents but want to keep their own voice
Editors and reviewers who need to quickly flag AI-slop patterns in a text
Users who want to satirically generate the cringiest possible AI slop

zh.tag: 让 AI 像人一样操作浏览器的开源智能体框架
zh.what: Browser Use 是一个开源工具，允许 AI 代理像人类一样使用浏览器，自动执行打开网页、点击按钮、输入文本、填写表单等任务。用户只需描述任务，代理即可完成，例如自动填写求职申请。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、示例代码、文档和演示，支持与主流 LLM 集成，并提供云服务（Browser Use Cloud）用于托管和扩展。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Playwright 控制浏览器，可接入 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 LLM API，并支持 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 11 万，今日新增 231，因其将 AI 代理与真实浏览器操作结合，极大扩展了自动化边界，成为开发者热门选择。

个人用户自动化日常重复性网页任务，如填写表单、管理日程或购物。
企业集成到 RPA 流程，实现智能客服或后台系统的无头浏览器操作。

en.tag: Open-source framework enabling AI agents to control browsers like humans
en.what: Browser Use is an open-source tool that enables AI agents to use a web browser like a human, automating tasks such as opening pages, clicking buttons, typing, and filling forms. Users describe a task, and the agent completes it, e.g., auto-filling job applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, examples, docs, and demos, with integrations for major LLMs, plus a cloud service for hosting and scaling.
en.stack: Built on Python, uses Playwright for browser control, integrates with LLM APIs like OpenAI and Anthropic, and supports MCP protocol.
en.hot: With over 112k stars and 231 new today, it's hot for bridging AI agents with real browser actions, expanding automation possibilities and gaining rapid developer adoption.
uses: Developers building automated testing or web scraping tools that leverage AI agents to mimic user actions.
Individuals automating repetitive web tasks like form filling, scheduling, or online shopping.
Enterprises integrating into RPA workflows for headless browser operations in customer service or back-office systems.

zh.tag: 用群体智能和AI代理，几分钟搭建自主对冲基金
zh.what: AutoHedge 是一个企业级的自主代理对冲基金，能够自动执行市场分析、风险管理和交易执行，减少人工干预。目前支持 Solana 上的全自动交易，未来将支持 Coinbase 等更多交易所。
zh.content: 仓库包含多代理架构（总监、量化、风险、执行代理）、实时市场分析、风险优先设计、结构化输出和企业级日志。提供快速安装和基本使用说明，以及架构图。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Jupiter API 获取代币价格和搜索工具，以及 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 API 用于实验性代理。
zh.hot: 结合群体智能和 AI 代理的自主交易概念吸引关注，今日新增 142 星，总星数达 4725，登上 GitHub 趋势榜第 17 名。

对 AI 代理和群体智能在金融领域应用感兴趣的研究者
需要风险优先和结构化输出的机构级交易系统开发者

en.tag: Build an autonomous hedge fund in minutes with swarm intelligence and AI agents
en.what: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous agent hedge fund that automates market analysis, risk management, and trade execution with minimal human intervention. It currently supports full autonomous trading on Solana, with Coinbase and other venues coming soon.
en.content: The repo includes a multi-agent architecture (Director, Quant, Risk, Execution agents), real-time market analysis, risk-first design, structured output, and enterprise logging. It provides quick start installation and usage, plus an architecture diagram.
en.stack: Built with Python, relies on Jupiter API for token price and search tools, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs for experimental agents.
en.hot: The concept of autonomous trading with swarm intelligence and AI agents is captivating, gaining 142 stars today and reaching 4,725 total, ranking #17 on GitHub Trending.

Researchers interested in AI agents and swarm intelligence applications in finance
Developers needing institutional-grade trading systems with risk-first and structured output

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。

隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.
en.content: The repository includes full application code, docs, installation guides, architecture, and API docs, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, offering both GUI and CLI tools.

Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.

zh.tag: 公开漏洞 PoC 与漏洞研究写作合集，含 AI 辅助模糊测试流程
zh.what: 这是一个公开漏洞利用 PoC 与漏洞研究文章的合集仓库，作者把过去分散的独立 PoC 仓库整合到一起，并持续以独立文件夹形式新增研究条目。作者表示这些漏洞在发布时均未上报，欢迎他人自行上报并领取 CVE 署名。
zh.content: 仓库按漏洞目标分文件夹组织，每个文件夹保留原始 README 与跟踪文件，覆盖 7-Zip、AnyDesk、c-ares、curl、Discord、Docker、Firefox、FFmpeg 等众多软件。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主要语言，PoC 多为手工编写，部分借助 AI 辅助；作者称使用 GPT-5.3 自动化模糊测试工作流，RustDesk 相关 PoC 借助 AI 完成。
zh.hot: 本周新增 707 star，总 star 达 5091，登上 GitHub Trending Python 周榜第 12 名；AI 辅助漏洞挖掘与大量未上报 CVE 的话题性引发广泛关注。

渗透测试人员，用于在授权环境中复现和验证漏洞
想进入漏洞研究领域的新人，作为入门参考与思路启发
关注 AI 辅助模糊测试工作流的人，了解如何用 AI 提升漏洞发现效率

en.tag: A consolidated archive of public exploit PoCs and vulnerability research writeups, with an AI-assisted fuzzing workflow
en.what: This is a consolidated archive of public exploit PoCs and vulnerability research writeups, merging the author's former standalone PoC repos into one place and adding new self-contained research folders over time. The author notes none of the issues were reported at posting time and invites others to report them and take CVE credit.

Penetration testers reproducing and validating vulnerabilities in authorized environments
Newcomers to vulnerability research seeking entry-level references and inspiration
Those interested in AI-assisted fuzzing workflows and how AI can speed up bug discovery

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 面向实战的 AI 工程项目合集，覆盖 OCR、RAG 与智能体

关注多智能体协作与多模型集成方案的技术团队

en.tag: A hands-on collection of production-ready AI projects spanning OCR, RAG, and agents
en.what: This is a curated collection of practical, production-ready AI projects covering language models, multimodal models, OCR systems, RAG pipelines, and AI agents. Each project ships with complete code, setup instructions, and documentation so you can learn, experiment, and build real-world AI applications.

en.stack: Primarily Python, with projects supporting multiple model providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models, and leveraging components such as Ollama, BGE embeddings, Actian VectorAI DB, Landing AI, and MiniMax M2.7, under the MIT license.
en.hot: With 3,365 stars and 73 added today, it ranks 16th on GitHub Trending's daily Python list, reflecting strong demand for hands-on, production-ready AI projects developers can immediately use.
uses: Students and career switchers who want to learn AI engineering through complete hands-on projects
Developers who need to quickly prototype RAG, OCR, or agent systems
Engineers looking for production-grade best practices to ship AI applications
Technical teams interested in multi-agent collaboration and multi-model integration patterns

zh.tag: AI 代理技能安全扫描器，安装前检测漏洞与恶意模式
zh.what: SkillSpector 是一个安全扫描器，用于检测 AI 代理技能中的漏洞、恶意模式和风险。它支持扫描 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 技能，帮助用户判断技能是否安全可安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包、命令行工具、文档和扩展指南，提供多格式输入扫描、两阶段分析（静态+LLM）、实时漏洞查询、多种输出格式和风险评分等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，使用 AST 分析、YARA 签名、OSV.dev API 等，可选集成 LLM 进行语义评估，支持 SARIF 报告输出。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理技能生态爆发，安全问题凸显，SkillSpector 填补了技能安全扫描的空白，由 NVIDIA 背书，star 数迅速增长至 1.6 万。
uses: 开发者在安装第三方 AI 技能前，快速验证其安全性
安全团队集成到 CI/CD 流程，自动扫描技能仓库
AI 代理用户评估 Claude Code、Codex 等技能的可信度

en.tag: Security scanner for AI agent skills, detecting vulnerabilities before install
en.what: SkillSpector is a security scanner that detects vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, and risks in AI agent skills. It supports scanning skills for Claude Code, Codex, and MCP, helping users decide if a skill is safe to install.
en.content: The repository contains a Python package, CLI tool, documentation, and extension guides, offering multi-format input scanning, two-stage analysis (static + LLM), live vulnerability lookups, multiple output formats, and risk scoring.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, uses AST analysis, YARA signatures, OSV.dev API, optional LLM semantic evaluation, and supports SARIF report output.
en.hot: As the AI agent skill ecosystem explodes, security concerns rise; SkillSpector fills the gap for skill scanning, backed by NVIDIA, with stars quickly growing to 16k.
uses: Developers quickly verify safety before installing third-party AI skills
Security teams integrate into CI/CD to automatically scan skill repos
AI agent users assess trustworthiness of skills for Claude Code, Codex, etc.

zh.tag: 用任意大模型语音/文字操控 Blender 3D 的社区插件
zh.what: 这是一个 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，将 Blender 3D 与任意大语言模型连接起来。通过自然语言提示，用户可以创建、修改和操作 3D 场景，实现 AI 辅助的 3D 建模。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Python 编写的 MCP 服务器（通过 uvx 运行）、一个 Blender 插件（用于在 Blender 内启动服务器）以及详细的文档和教程。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 和 MCP 协议，使用 uv 进行包管理，支持 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor 等多种 MCP 客户端。

Blender 初学者：无需精通复杂操作，即可实现创意想法。

en.tag: Community plugin to control Blender 3D with any LLM of your choice
en.what: This is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects Blender 3D to any large language model. Users can create, modify, and manipulate 3D scenes through natural language prompts, enabling AI-assisted 3D modeling.
en.content: The repository includes a Python-based MCP server (run via uvx), a Blender addon (to start the server within Blender), and comprehensive documentation and tutorials.
en.stack: Built on Python and the MCP protocol, uses uv for package management, and supports various MCP clients like Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and Cursor.
en.hot: With 27k stars and 200+ daily additions, it dramatically lowers the barrier to 3D modeling, attracting AI enthusiasts and Blender users.
uses: 3D designers and artists: Quickly generate or modify models using natural language, boosting productivity.
AI developers: Explore MCP applications in creative tools and build custom workflows.
Educators: Demonstrate AI-assisted design in teaching to inspire students.
Blender beginners: Realize creative ideas without mastering complex operations.

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
