zh.hot: 今日新增 161 星，总星数达 1950，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了 AI 代理依赖云端 API 的痛点，提供免费、私密、离线的本地推理方案，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者希望让 Claude Code、Codex 等代理完全本地运行，保护代码隐私并节省 API 成本。
硬件配置不高的用户，需要自动推荐并优化适合自己设备的本地模型。
追求离线工作的场景，如无网络环境或对数据安全要求高的团队。

en.tag: Open-source inference server to run local models with your existing AI agents
en.what: Magnitude is an open-source inference server that profiles your hardware, recommends and runs the best local models, and plugs into the AI agents you already use (e.g., Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code). It enables fully offline, private, and free agent operation without API keys or token costs.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool (@magnitudedev/cli), the inference server core, model management (download, tune, run), and integrations for multiple agents. It offers an interactive setup wizard and documentation for quick configuration.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, distributed via npm. Supports macOS and Linux (Windows via WSL), leverages local hardware for inference, and integrates with various agent frameworks.
en.hot: Gained 161 stars today, reaching 1,950 total, and hit #14 on GitHub Trending. It addresses the pain point of cloud-dependent AI agents by offering free, private, offline local inference, attracting many developers.
uses: Developers who want agents like Claude Code or Codex to run fully locally, protecting code privacy and saving API costs.
Users with modest hardware who need automatic recommendations and tuning of local models for their devices.
Offline-first scenarios, such as no-network environments or teams with strict data security requirements.

zh.tag: 免费开源的跨平台系统清理与安全扫描工具
zh.what: Kudu 是一款面向 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的免费开源系统清理与安全扫描工具，可清理临时文件、缓存、日志和残留应用数据，并扫描恶意软件。它主打无广告、无捆绑、扫描与清理全程本地进行，帮助用户释放磁盘空间并保护隐私。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码（TypeScript 主语言）、CLI 文档（CLI.md）、各平台安装包构建配置，以及系统清理、浏览器清理、应用清理、游戏清理、注册表清理、启动项管理、网络清理和磁盘分析等模块。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，采用跨平台桌面应用框架构建，支持 Windows（.exe/便携版）、macOS（.dmg，Intel 与 Apple Silicon）和 Linux（.AppImage/.deb）发布，并配有 GitHub Actions 自动构建发布流程。
zh.hot: 本周新增 942 星、总星数 3343，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 14 名。它切中了用户对闭源清理软件广告多、捆绑多甚至暗藏恶意软件的痛点，以开源透明、免费无广告的定位迅速获得关注。
uses: 普通用户想免费清理电脑垃圾、释放磁盘空间又不想装广告软件
开发者或运维需要 CLI 方式批量清理多台 Windows/macOS/Linux 机器
注重隐私、希望审计清理逻辑是否安全的开源爱好者
被 CCleaner 等闭源工具困扰、想找透明替代品的人

en.tag: Free, open-source cross-platform system cleaner and security scanner
en.what: Kudu is a free, open-source system cleaner and security scanner for Windows, macOS, and Linux that removes temp files, caches, logs, and leftover app data while scanning for malware. It is ad-free, bundle-free, and keeps scanning and cleaning local to reclaim disk space and protect privacy.
en.content: The repo contains the desktop app source (primarily TypeScript), CLI docs (CLI.md), build configs for each platform's installers, and modules for system, browser, app, gaming, registry, startup, network, and disk cleanup.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on a cross-platform desktop app framework, shipping Windows (.exe/portable), macOS (.dmg, Intel & Apple Silicon), and Linux (.AppImage/.deb) releases with GitHub Actions automated builds.
en.hot: It gained 942 stars this week for a total of 3,343, ranking 14th on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript list. It taps into frustration with closed-source cleaners full of ads, bundles, and even malware, gaining traction through its open, transparent, free, and ad-free positioning.
uses: Everyday users who want free disk cleanup without adware or bundled software
Developers or ops staff needing CLI-based batch cleanup across Windows/macOS/Linux machines
Privacy-conscious open-source fans who want to audit what the cleaner actually does
Anyone tired of closed-source tools like CCleaner seeking a transparent alternative

zh.tag: Proxmox 环境的开源版 vCenter 管理面板
zh.what: ProxCenter 是面向 Proxmox VE 的现代化 Web 管理平台，定位为 VMware vCenter 的替代品。它通过单一控制台统一管理多个 Proxmox VE 集群与 Proxmox Backup Server 实例，支持监控、运维与优化。
zh.content: 仓库为前端 UI 主体（TypeScript），包含多集群清单、跨虚拟化迁移、负载均衡等界面，并配有 docs 截图、banner 与官网/演示/文档链接。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主，采用 Docker Compose 部署，后端依赖 PostgreSQL 与持久化卷，安装脚本位于 /opt/proxcenter。
zh.hot: 本周新增 306 star、总数 1599，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 18 名；在 Broadcom 收购 VMware 后，Proxmox 迁移需求激增，社区急需 vCenter 式统一管理界面。
uses: 从 VMware 迁移到 Proxmox 的企业 IT 运维团队
需要统一管理多个 Proxmox 集群与备份服务器的管理员
希望用开源方案替代 vCenter 的中小机房与自建云用户

en.tag: An open-source vCenter alternative for Proxmox environments
en.what: ProxCenter is a modern web management platform for Proxmox VE, positioned as an alternative to VMware vCenter. It manages multiple Proxmox VE clusters and Proxmox Backup Server instances from a single pane of glass, covering monitoring, operations and optimization.
en.content: The repo is the TypeScript front-end UI, including multi-cluster inventory, cross-hypervisor migration and workload balancing screens, plus docs screenshots, a banner and links to the website, live demo and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, deployed via Docker Compose with PostgreSQL and persistent volumes under /opt/proxcenter, installed through a shell script.
en.hot: It gained 306 stars this week for a total of 1,599, ranking 18th on the GitHub Trending TypeScript weekly chart; with Broadcom's VMware acquisition driving Proxmox migrations, demand for a vCenter-like unified UI is surging.
uses: Enterprise IT ops teams migrating from VMware to Proxmox
Admins managing multiple Proxmox clusters and backup servers
Small data centers and self-hosted cloud users seeking an open-source vCenter alternative

zh.tag: 本地优先、模型无关的 AI 科研工作台
zh.what: Open Science 是一个开源、本地优先、模型无关的 AI 研究平台，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它让科学家和研究人员能够通过科学智能体、Python/R 笔记本和数据连接器，以可复现、可检查的方式开展研究。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、科学智能体框架、Python/R 执行环境、数据连接器以及可复现的溯源记录，并提供多语言文档（含简体中文）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，依赖 Python/R 运行时，支持跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux），并集成 Hugging Face 数据集（如 BiomniBench-DA）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 146 星，总星数达 3857，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 14 名。其本地优先、模型无关的设计契合科研可复现性需求，吸引大量关注。
uses: 科研人员：在本地进行可复现的 AI 驱动研究，保护数据隐私
数据科学家：利用 Python/R 笔记本和科学智能体加速分析流程
跨学科团队：通过数据连接器和溯源记录协作，确保研究透明

en.tag: Local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench for reproducible science
en.what: Open Science is an open-source, local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux. It enables scientists and researchers to conduct reproducible, inspectable research with scientific AI agents, Python/R notebooks, and data connectors.
en.content: The repository contains the desktop app source, scientific agent framework, Python/R execution environment, data connectors, and reproducible provenance tracking, with multi-language docs (including Simplified Chinese).
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript, relies on Python/R runtimes, supports cross-platform (macOS/Windows/Linux), and integrates Hugging Face datasets (e.g., BiomniBench-DA).
en.hot: Gained 146 stars today, reaching 3,857 total and ranking #14 on GitHub Trending daily. Its local-first, model-agnostic design meets reproducibility needs in research, drawing significant attention.
uses: Researchers: conduct reproducible AI-driven research locally with data privacy
Data scientists: accelerate analysis workflows with Python/R notebooks and scientific agents
Interdisciplinary teams: collaborate via data connectors and provenance tracking for transparency

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的隐身无头浏览器，绕过反爬检测
zh.what: camofox-browser 是一个基于 Camoufox（Firefox 分支）的防检测浏览器服务器，专为 AI 代理设计。它通过 C++ 级别的指纹伪装绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬机制，提供 REST API 供代理使用，可作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的浏览器服务器实现，提供 REST API、元素引用、会话隔离、Cookie 导入、文件上传、代理支持等功能。附带启动脚本和 npm 包，易于集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 Node.js，核心引擎是 Camoufox（Firefox 的 C++ 级补丁），通过 REST API 暴露功能。依赖 npm 生态，支持跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 在 AI 代理需要访问真实网页但常被反爬拦截的背景下，该仓库提供了有效的解决方案，今日新增 117 星，总星数达 9236，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第六。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理访问受保护网站（如搜索、社交媒体）时，可集成此浏览器绕过检测。
数据采集工程师：用于爬取 Cloudflare 保护的网站，替代易被识别的无头浏览器。
自动化测试人员：作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的替代，进行需要真实浏览器指纹的测试。
个人 AI 助手项目：如 jo，需要稳定、低内存的浏览器后端。

en.tag: Stealth headless browser for AI agents, bypassing bot detection
en.what: camofox-browser is an anti-detection browser server for AI agents, built on Camoufox (a Firefox fork). It bypasses Cloudflare and bot detection via C++-level fingerprint spoofing, and offers a REST API for agents, serving as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright.
en.content: The repository contains a full browser server implementation with REST API, element refs, session isolation, cookie import, file upload, proxy support, and more. It includes startup scripts and an npm package for easy integration.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript and Node.js, powered by Camoufox (a C++-patched Firefox fork), exposing functionality via REST API. Leverages npm ecosystem and runs cross-platform.
en.hot: With AI agents needing to browse real websites but often blocked by anti-bot measures, this repo offers a working solution, gaining 117 stars today and reaching 9236 total, ranking #6 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate this browser to access protected sites (e.g., search, social media) while bypassing detection.
Data scraping engineers: use it to crawl Cloudflare-protected websites, replacing easily fingerprintable headless browsers.
Automation testers: as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright for tests requiring real browser fingerprints.
Personal AI assistant projects: like jo, needing a stable, low-memory browser backend.

zh.tag: Stremio 官方 Web UI，自由流媒体一站式媒体中心
zh.what: Stremio Web 是 Stremio 的官方网页界面，提供自由流媒体体验。它允许用户通过插件发现电影、剧集和频道，并同步跨设备的媒体库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 React 前端应用，与 Rust 核心（stremio-core）通过 WebAssembly 通信，并集成 stremio-video 处理播放。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/React，依赖 Node.js 22+ 和 pnpm。核心逻辑在 Rust 编译为 WASM 的 stremio-core 中。
zh.hot: Stremio 作为流行的媒体中心，其 Web UI 因开源和易用性而备受关注，今日新增 122 星，总星数达 13477。
uses: 希望在一个界面中整合多个流媒体服务的用户。
开发者想要学习如何构建基于 WASM 的复杂前端应用。
喜欢通过插件扩展功能的媒体爱好者。

en.tag: Official web UI of Stremio, a one-stop media center for video entertainment
en.what: Stremio Web is the official web UI of Stremio, offering freedom to stream. It lets users discover movies, series, and channels via addons, and syncs library and progress across devices.
en.content: The repo contains a React frontend app that communicates with the Rust core (stremio-core) via WebAssembly, and integrates stremio-video for playback.
en.stack: Mainly JavaScript/React, requires Node.js 22+ and pnpm. Core logic is in stremio-core, a Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly.
en.hot: As a popular media center, Stremio's web UI gains attention for being open-source and user-friendly, with 122 stars added today, totaling 13477.
uses: Users who want to consolidate multiple streaming services into one interface.
Developers interested in building complex frontend apps with WebAssembly.
Media enthusiasts who enjoy extending functionality via addons.

zh.tag: Claude Code 全家桶：代理、技能、钩子、规则与 MCP 配置
zh.what: 这是一个由 Anthropic 黑客松获奖者开发的 Claude Code 配置集合，包含生产级的代理、技能、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置。这些配置经过 10 多个月的日常使用打磨，用于构建真实产品。
zh.content: 仓库包含代理、技能、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置等目录，以及配套的速查指南和长文指南，涵盖令牌优化、记忆持久化、持续学习、验证循环、并行化等主题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/Node.js 编写，支持 TypeScript、Shell 和 Markdown。跨平台支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，自动检测包管理器（npm、pnpm、yarn、bun）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 154 颗星，总星数突破 1000，登上 JavaScript 周榜第 9 名。作为黑客松获奖者的实战配置，吸引了大量 Claude Code 用户寻求高效开发工作流。
uses: Claude Code 用户：希望优化令牌使用、提升开发效率的开发者。
AI 辅助开发团队：需要标准化代理、技能和钩子配置的团队。
学习 AI 编程实践：想了解如何构建高效 AI 开发工作流的学习者。

en.tag: Complete Claude Code toolkit: agents, skills, hooks, rules, and MCP configs
en.what: A collection of Claude Code configurations from an Anthropic hackathon winner, including production-ready agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs. Evolved over 10+ months of intensive daily use building real products.
en.content: Includes directories for agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs, along with shorthand and longform guides covering token optimization, memory persistence, continuous learning, verification loops, and parallelization.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript/Node.js, with TypeScript, Shell, and Markdown. Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with automatic package manager detection (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun).
en.hot: Gained 154 stars this week, surpassing 1000 total, ranking #9 on the JavaScript weekly trending. As a hackathon winner's real-world config, it attracts many Claude Code users seeking efficient dev workflows.
uses: Claude Code users: developers looking to optimize token usage and boost productivity.
AI-assisted dev teams: teams needing standardized agents, skills, and hooks.
Learners of AI coding practices: those wanting to build efficient AI dev workflows.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的跨平台语音转文字听写应用
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的语音转文字听写应用，支持本地离线模型（如 Whisper、NVIDIA Parakeet）和云端模型（自带密钥），确保音频数据不离开设备。它提供热键唤起、光标处插入文本、会议转录和笔记功能，是 WisprFlow 和 Granola 的免费替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，覆盖 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台，提供安装包（DMG、EXE、AppImage 等）。项目包含前端界面、语音引擎集成、系统托盘、热键监听等模块，并配有文档和 API 参考。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，可能基于 Electron 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用。语音识别依赖本地引擎（如 Whisper、NVIDIA Parakeet）和 ONNX Runtime，支持云端 API 集成。
zh.hot: 凭借隐私优先和跨平台特性，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获近 6000 星，今日新增 50 星，位列 JavaScript 日榜第五。作为商业产品的开源替代，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要高效语音输入的文字工作者，如记者、作家、程序员，可用热键快速听写。
注重隐私的用户，希望在本地完成语音转文字，避免音频上传云端。
经常开会的人士，利用会议转录功能自动生成笔记和行动项。
开发者或技术爱好者，可自定义模型或集成自有 API 密钥。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation app
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source voice-to-text dictation app supporting local offline models (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) and cloud models (bring your own key), ensuring audio data never leaves the device. It offers hotkey activation, text insertion at cursor, meeting transcription, and note-taking, serving as a free alternative to WisprFlow and Granola.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop app, covering macOS, Windows, and Linux, with installers (DMG, EXE, AppImage, etc.). It includes frontend UI, speech engine integration, system tray, hotkey listener, and is accompanied by docs and API reference.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely built with Electron or similar cross-platform framework. Speech recognition relies on local engines (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) and ONNX Runtime, with cloud API integration.
en.hot: Rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub due to privacy-first and cross-platform features, amassing nearly 6k stars with 50 new stars today, ranking 5th on the JavaScript daily trending. As an open-source alternative to commercial products, it attracts significant attention.
uses: For writers, journalists, and programmers who need efficient voice input with hotkey dictation.
For privacy-conscious users who want on-device speech-to-text without uploading audio to the cloud.
For frequent meeting attendees who use transcription to auto-generate notes and action items.
For developers and tech enthusiasts who can customize models or integrate their own API keys.

zh.tag: 把各类 AI 编程工具接到 40+ 免费/廉价模型上的智能路由与省 token 网关
zh.what: 9Router 是一个本地运行的 AI 路由网关，把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cline、Copilot 等编程工具统一接到 40+ 家供应商、100+ 模型上。它通过订阅→廉价→免费的自动降级、多账号轮询和 RTK token 压缩，让开发者尽量不撞限额、少花钱。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 JavaScript 项目，核心是本地路由服务（默认 http://localhost:20128/v1）与 Web 仪表盘，包含 RTK token 压缩、格式转换（OpenAI ↔ Claude）、配额追踪与自动刷新等模块，并提供 npm 包、Docker 镜像与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 JavaScript，以 npm 包和 Docker/ GHCR 镜像分发，对外暴露 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 接口，依赖各 AI 供应商的 API 与订阅凭证。
zh.hot: 它以“无限免费 AI 编程”和 20-40% token 节省直击开发者成本痛点，已积累 28k+ star，今日再涨 186，冲上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 4。
uses: 日常用 Claude Code、Cursor、Cline 等工具但担心额度与费用的个人开发者
需要统一管理多家 AI 供应商、做成本与配额控制的小团队
希望用免费或廉价模型替代高价 API 的独立开发者与创业者
想自建本地 AI 网关、避免供应商锁定的技术用户

en.tag: Smart router that connects AI coding tools to 40+ free/cheap model providers while saving tokens
en.what: 9Router is a locally-run AI routing gateway that connects coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline and Copilot to 40+ providers and 100+ models. It uses subscription→cheap→free auto-fallback, multi-account round-robin and RTK token compression so developers rarely hit limits or overspend.
en.content: It's a JavaScript project centered on a local routing server (default http://localhost:20128/v1) plus a web dashboard, with modules for RTK token compression, OpenAI↔Claude format translation, quota tracking and auto token refresh, shipped via npm, Docker and multi-language READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript, distributed as an npm package and Docker/GHCR image, exposing an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint and relying on various provider APIs and subscription credentials.
en.hot: It hits developers' cost pain with "unlimited free AI coding" and 20-40% token savings, racking up 28k+ stars and another 186 today to rank #4 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript).
uses: Individual developers using Claude Code, Cursor or Cline who worry about quotas and costs
Small teams needing unified multi-provider management with cost and quota control
Indie developers and founders wanting free or cheap models instead of pricey APIs
Technical users who want a self-hosted local AI gateway to avoid vendor lock-in

zh.tag: AI 标书编写与投标管理一体化工具箱
zh.what: 易标是一款开箱即用的 AI 标书编写工具，提供标书 AI 生成、投标工具箱、知识库、标书查重和废标项检查等功能。它旨在帮助用户快速生成高质量的投标文件，并降低废标风险。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Electron 桌面应用源码，基于 React 和 TypeScript 构建，提供图形界面和多种投标辅助功能。项目还包含截图目录和 README 文档，方便用户了解和使用。
zh.stack: 主要技术栈为 Electron、React 19、TypeScript 5.9 和 Vite 7，支持跨平台桌面应用开发。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 68 星，总星数达 2834，位列 JavaScript 日榜第 11 名。其开源免费的特性吸引了大量需要高效编写标书的用户。
uses: 企业投标人员：快速生成规范标书，提高投标效率。
标书编写新手：借助 AI 和模板降低编写门槛。
