zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎、多个后端模块（如 llama.cpp、vLLM、whisper.cpp、stable-diffusion 等），以及用于 API 兼容、多用户认证、内置 AI 代理和文档的组件。后端按需拉取，保持核心轻量。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，后端集成 C++ 和 Python 的推理引擎（如 llama.cpp、vLLM、whisper.cpp 等），支持多种硬件加速（CUDA、ROCm、Vulkan、Apple Silicon 等）。
zh.hot: LocalAI 在 GitHub 上拥有近 5 万星标，今日新增 40 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第二。其吸引力在于无需 GPU 即可运行任意模型，同时提供与主流 API 的即插即用兼容性，满足了用户对数据隐私和本地部署的需求。
uses: 希望在本地或私有云中运行 AI 模型，避免数据外泄的企业和开发者
没有高端 GPU 硬件，但仍需运行 LLM 或多模态模型的个人开发者
需要兼容 OpenAI API 的本地替代方案，以降低成本和延迟的团队
对 AI 代理、RAG 和工具调用感兴趣，希望自主控制 AI 工作流的用户

en.tag: Open-source, local-first AI engine to run any model on any hardware without GPU
en.what: LocalAI is an open-source AI inference engine that lets you run various models—LLMs, vision, voice, image, and video—on your own hardware without needing a GPU. It offers drop-in API compatibility with OpenAI, Anthropic, and ElevenLabs, making it a privacy-preserving alternative to cloud AI services.
en.content: The repository includes the core engine, multiple backend modules (e.g., llama.cpp, vLLM, whisper.cpp, stable-diffusion), and components for API compatibility, multi-user auth, built-in AI agents, and documentation. Backends are pulled on demand to keep the core lightweight.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with backends integrating C++ and Python inference engines like llama.cpp, vLLM, and whisper.cpp. Supports various hardware accelerations including CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, and Apple Silicon.
en.hot: With nearly 49k stars and 40 added today, LocalAI ranks #2 on the Go trending list. Its appeal lies in running any model without a GPU while offering drop-in API compatibility, addressing the growing demand for privacy and on-premises AI deployment.
uses: Enterprises and developers who want to run AI models locally or in private clouds to avoid data leakage
Individual developers without high-end GPUs who still need to run LLMs or multimodal models
Teams needing a local drop-in replacement for OpenAI API to reduce costs and latency
Users interested in AI agents, RAG, and tool use who want full control over their AI workflows

zh.tag: 轻量级容器实时日志查看器，支持 Docker、Swarm 与 K8s
zh.what: Dozzle 是一个基于 Web 的轻量级应用，用于实时监控 Docker 容器日志。它不存储任何日志文件，只做实时查看，镜像压缩后仅约 7MB。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端与前端资源，提供模糊搜索、正则与 SQL 查询日志、分屏查看、实时 CPU/内存统计、多用户认证、Swarm 模式与 Agent 模式等。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，前端打包为静态资源，以 Docker 镜像形式发布到 Docker Hub 与 ghcr.io，依赖 Docker socket 或远程 Agent 采集日志。
zh.hot: 凭借极小的体积、零日志存储和开箱即用的实时查看体验，Dozzle 已积累 14332 颗星，本周新增 82 星并登上 Go 周榜第 14 名。
uses: 运维与 DevOps 工程师快速排查容器运行日志
个人开发者或小团队在单机 Docker 上做实时日志监控
需要跨多台 Docker 主机集中查看日志的 Swarm/K8s 用户
希望用轻量方案替代 Kibana 等重型日志平台的人群

en.tag: Lightweight realtime log viewer for Docker, Swarm and K8s containers
en.what: Dozzle is a lightweight web-based application for monitoring Docker container logs in real time. It stores no log files and is designed purely for live log viewing, shipping as a tiny ~7MB image.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend plus frontend assets, offering fuzzy container search, regex and SQL log queries, split-screen viewing, live CPU/memory stats, multi-user auth, Swarm mode and an agent mode for multiple hosts.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go with bundled static frontend assets, distributed as a Docker image on Docker Hub and ghcr.io, and relies on the Docker socket or remote agents to collect logs.
en.hot: With its tiny footprint, zero log storage and plug-and-play live viewing, Dozzle has reached 14,332 stars, adding 82 this week and ranking 14th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: DevOps and SRE engineers quickly triaging container runtime logs
Solo developers or small teams monitoring realtime logs on a single Docker host
Swarm/K8s users who need to view logs across multiple Docker hosts
Anyone wanting a lightweight alternative to heavy log platforms like Kibana

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供持久记忆的 Go 单文件方案
zh.what: Engram 是一个面向 AI 编码代理的持久记忆系统，让代理在会话结束后仍能记住项目上下文与历史决策。它通过 SQLite + FTS5 存储与检索记忆，并以 MCP 服务器、HTTP API、CLI 和 TUI 多种形态对外提供能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的单一二进制程序，以及 docs 目录下的安装、架构、代理接入、插件、团队使用等文档，另有品牌素材与 Engram Cloud 相关说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，存储层使用 SQLite 配合 FTS5 全文检索，对外提供 MCP server、HTTP API、CLI 与 TUI，并强调零依赖、单二进制部署。
zh.hot: 它切中了 AI 编码代理「会话即失忆」的痛点，加上代理无关、单二进制零依赖的轻量设计，本周新增约 195 star，累计 6508 star，登上 GitHub Go 周榜第 18 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码代理、希望跨会话保留上下文的开发者
需要在本地或云端为团队统一管理代理记忆的工程团队
想通过 MCP/HTTP API 把记忆能力接入自研代理工具的开发者

en.tag: Persistent memory for AI coding agents in a single Go binary
en.what: Engram is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents, letting them retain project context and past decisions across sessions. It stores and retrieves memories with SQLite + FTS5 and exposes them through an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI, and TUI.
en.content: The repo ships a single Go binary plus a docs folder covering installation, architecture, agent setup, plugins, and team usage, along with branding assets and Engram Cloud docs.
en.stack: Written in Go with SQLite + FTS5 for storage and full-text search, exposing an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI, and TUI, with an emphasis on zero dependencies and single-binary deployment.
en.hot: It targets the 'amnesia between sessions' pain of AI coding agents, and its agent-agnostic, single-binary, zero-dependency design helped it gain ~195 stars this week to reach 6,508, ranking 18th on GitHub's weekly Go trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want context to survive across sessions
Engineering teams needing local or cloud-shared memory management for their agents
Developers integrating memory into custom agent tooling via MCP or HTTP API

zh.tag: 让 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理用「原始人语」输出，省下 65% token
zh.what: Caveman 是一个 AI 编码代理技能（skill），通过强制代理用极简的「原始人式」表达来压缩输出，从而减少 token 消耗。它保留代码、命令、文件路径和报错原文，只砍掉啰嗦的解释性废话，官方称可节省约 65% 的 token。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 本体、一个代理（proxy）实现，以及可包裹 10 种原生代理的 wrap 配置，另有文档、安装说明和 logo 等资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，作为技能/代理层接入 Claude Code 等 30+ 种代理，采用 MIT + BSL 双许可。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2195 star、总数突破 10 万，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 3；直击 AI 编码按 token 计费的痛点，加上原始人梗的传播力，让它迅速走红。
uses: 重度使用 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理、在意 token 账单的开发者
希望代理输出更简洁、减少阅读噪音的工程团队
想研究代理输出压缩与 prompt 技巧的 AI 工具开发者

en.tag: A Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by making agents talk like cavemen
en.what: Caveman is a skill for AI coding agents that forces them to answer in terse, caveman-style prose, cutting token usage by roughly 65%. Code, commands, file paths and exact error messages stay untouched — only the throat-clearing gets deleted.
en.content: The repo ships the installable skill itself, a proxy implementation, and wrap profiles for 10 native agents, plus docs, install instructions and branding assets.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it plugs into Claude Code and 30+ other agents as a skill/proxy layer, dual-licensed under MIT + BSL.
en.hot: It gained 2,195 stars this week to pass 100k total and hit #3 on GitHub's weekly Go trending list, riding both the real pain of token-based billing and a very shareable caveman meme.
uses: Developers who heavily use Claude Code and other coding agents and care about token bills
Engineering teams that want terser, lower-noise agent output
AI tooling builders studying output compression and prompt tricks

zh.tag: 自动生成的 Google API Go 客户端库
zh.what: 这是 Google 官方提供的 Go 语言客户端库，用于访问各种 Google API（如 Tasks、Sheets、Drive 等）。这些库根据 Google Discovery Service 的 JSON 描述文件自动生成，覆盖了数百个 Google 服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含大量按 API 和版本组织的 Go 包（如 tasks/v1、sheets/v4），以及示例代码和生成工具。每个包提供 NewService 函数用于创建客户端。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言，依赖 Google API 基础设施，使用 Application Default Credentials 进行认证，并支持服务账号密钥文件。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方维护的 Go 客户端库，它被广泛用于 Go 生态中集成 Google 服务，尽管本周仅新增 5 星，但总星数达 4473，且因 Go 语言在云原生领域的流行而持续受到关注。
uses: Go 开发者需要调用 Google API（如 Google Sheets、Drive、Tasks）时使用。
在云原生应用中集成 Google 服务，如使用服务账号进行认证。
学习 Google API 的 Go 客户端实现方式，参考自动生成的代码结构。
快速原型开发，利用现成的客户端库减少手动编写 HTTP 请求的工作。

en.tag: Auto-generated Go client libraries for Google APIs
en.what: This is the official Go client library for accessing various Google APIs (such as Tasks, Sheets, Drive, etc.). These libraries are auto-generated from Google Discovery Service's JSON description files, covering hundreds of Google services.
en.content: The repository contains numerous Go packages organized by API and version (e.g., tasks/v1, sheets/v4), along with examples and generation tools. Each package provides a NewService function to create a client.
en.stack: Built in Go, relies on Google API infrastructure, uses Application Default Credentials for authentication, and supports service account key files.
en.hot: As an officially maintained Go client library by Google, it is widely used for integrating Google services in the Go ecosystem. Although it gained only 5 stars this week, its total of 4,473 stars and the popularity of Go in cloud-native development keep it relevant.
uses: Go developers who need to call Google APIs (e.g., Google Sheets, Drive, Tasks).
Integrating Google services in cloud-native applications, such as using service accounts for authentication.
Learning how Google API Go clients are implemented by examining auto-generated code structure.
Rapid prototyping, leveraging existing client libraries to reduce manual HTTP request coding.

zh.tag: 开源像素画与动画精灵编辑器，跨三大桌面平台
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款用于制作动画精灵（sprite）的像素画编辑器，把图层与帧作为独立概念管理，支持实时预览与洋葱皮等动画辅助功能。它面向像素艺术家与独立游戏开发者，可导入导出精灵表、GIF 与 PNG 序列等多种格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的编辑器核心源码、构建脚本与 CI 配置，以及文档、翻译和脚本扩展相关目录，可自行编译出 Windows、macOS、Linux 版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 CMake 构建，并集成 Lua 脚本引擎与 Skia 等图形库，通过 GitHub Actions 做多平台构建。
zh.hot: 作为像素画领域的经典开源工具，它已积累近 3.94 万 star，本周再增 191 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 4，说明像素风游戏与独立开发热度持续。
uses: 像素艺术家与独立游戏开发者制作角色动画和精灵图
游戏美术需要导出精灵表、GIF 或 PNG 序列接入引擎
想用 Lua 脚本和 CLI 自动化批量处理素材的技术美术
在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上寻找免费开源像素编辑器的用户

en.tag: Open-source animated sprite editor & pixel art tool for Windows, macOS and Linux
en.what: Aseprite is a pixel art editor for creating animated sprites, treating layers and frames as separate concepts with real-time preview and onion skinning. Aimed at pixel artists and indie game developers, it imports and exports sprite sheets, GIFs and PNG sequences among other formats.
en.content: The repo holds the C++ editor core source, build scripts and CI configs, plus docs, translations and scripting-related directories, letting you compile builds for Windows, macOS and Linux.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with CMake builds, integrating a Lua scripting engine and graphics libraries such as Skia, with multi-platform builds via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: A classic open-source tool in the pixel art space, it has nearly 39.4k stars and gained 191 more this week, ranking 4th on the C++ weekly trending list, reflecting the ongoing popularity of pixel-art games and indie development.
uses: Pixel artists and indie game developers creating character animations and sprites
Game artists who need to export sprite sheets, GIFs or PNG sequences into engines
Technical artists automating asset pipelines with Lua scripting and the CLI
Users on Windows, macOS or Linux looking for a free open-source pixel editor

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适合播客、音乐制作和音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑器、音频引擎、效果插件、UI 资源等。当前正在开发 Audacity 4，采用全新 UI 并进行大规模重构，同时保留 3.x 分支供维护。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets（UI）、PortAudio（音频 I/O）等库。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供针对不同平台的构建脚本。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音频工具，Audacity 长期拥有稳定用户群。近期因 Audacity 4 的 UI 重构和功能更新引发关注，今日新增 272 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。
uses: 播客制作者：录制和编辑多轨音频，添加效果和导出播客节目。
音乐爱好者：进行简单的录音、剪辑和混音，或修复老旧录音。
教育场景：用于音频教学、学生录音作业或声音实验。
音频修复：去除噪音、剪辑对话或恢复历史录音。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder
en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasting, music production, and audio restoration.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Audacity, including the core editor, audio engine, effects plugins, and UI resources. It is currently undergoing major structural change for Audacity 4, with a brand-new UI and refactorings, while maintaining the 3.x branch.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on wxWidgets for UI, PortAudio for audio I/O, and other libraries. The build system uses CMake, with platform-specific build scripts.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source audio tool, Audacity has a stable user base. Recent attention is driven by the UI overhaul and updates for Audacity 4, gaining 272 stars today and ranking #2 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Podcasters: record and edit multi-track audio, add effects, and export episodes.
Music enthusiasts: perform simple recording, editing, and mixing, or restore old recordings.
Educational settings: use for audio teaching, student recording assignments, or sound experiments.
Audio restoration: remove noise, edit dialogue, or recover historical recordings.

zh.tag: Facebook 出品的高性能嵌入式持久化键值存储库
zh.what: RocksDB 是 Facebook 数据库工程团队开发维护的嵌入式持久化键值存储库，基于 Google LevelDB 的早期工作演进而来。它采用 LSM-Tree 设计，可在写放大、读放大和空间放大之间灵活权衡，特别适合在闪存上存储数据。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 源码为主体，公共接口位于 include/ 目录，examples/ 提供用法示例，另有完整的 GitHub Wiki 文档、构建脚本与测试套件。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake/Make 构建，支持多线程 compaction，采用 GPLv2 与 Apache 2.0 双许可证。
zh.hot: 作为 MyRocks、TiKV、CockroachDB 等众多数据库的底层存储引擎，RocksDB 长期保持高关注度，已积累 32075 颗星，本周新增 45 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 6。
uses: 数据库与存储引擎开发者，需要为自研数据库选型底层 KV 存储
后端工程师在闪存/SSD 场景下构建高吞吐持久化服务
需要单库存储数 TB 级数据并调优读写放大的系统架构师

en.tag: Facebook's embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage
en.what: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store library developed and maintained by Facebook's Database Engineering Team, building on earlier work on Google's LevelDB. It uses an LSM-Tree design with flexible tradeoffs between write, read, and space amplification, making it especially suited for storing data on flash drives.
en.content: The repo is primarily C++ source code, with the public interface in include/, usage examples in examples/, plus a full GitHub Wiki, build scripts, and test suites.
en.stack: Core is written in C++, built with CMake/Make, supports multi-threaded compaction, and is dual-licensed under GPLv2 and Apache 2.0.
en.hot: As the storage engine behind MyRocks, TiKV, CockroachDB and many others, RocksDB enjoys lasting attention with 32,075 stars, gaining 45 this week to rank 6th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Database and storage engine developers choosing a low-level KV store for their own database
Backend engineers building high-throughput persistent services on flash/SSD
System architects needing single-database storage of multiple terabytes with tunable read/write amplification

zh.tag: 为 Wayland 打造的原生桌面外壳，一体化定制 Linux 桌面
zh.what: Noctalia 是一个原生的 Wayland 桌面外壳，旨在替代由多个独立小工具拼凑而成的桌面环境。它提供统一的栏、部件、dock、启动器、控制中心、通知、壁纸、锁屏等功能，并直接构建于 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES 之上，无 Qt 或 GTK 依赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面外壳实现，涵盖多显示器栏、任务栏、工作区、系统托盘、dock、启动器、控制中心、通知、壁纸、锁屏、剪贴板历史、OSD 等组件。项目提供安装文档、用户指南和 ethos 理念说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，直接基于 Wayland 协议和 OpenGL ES 进行渲染，无 Qt/GTK 依赖。配置和 IPC 模型为一体化设计，支持脚本扩展部件。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 上表现强劲，月增 1089 星，总星数破万，反映出用户对一体化、可定制 Wayland 桌面外壳的强烈需求。其无 Qt/GTK 依赖的原生实现和统一设计理念吸引了大量关注。
uses: 希望摆脱零散工具、追求视觉统一和稳定体验的 Wayland 桌面用户
喜欢深度定制桌面外观和行为的 Linux 爱好者与开发者
需要多显示器支持和丰富部件（如天气、剪贴板历史）的生产力用户

en.tag: A native Wayland desktop shell for a cohesive, customizable Linux desktop
en.what: Noctalia is a native Wayland desktop shell that replaces the patchwork of separate tools for a cohesive desktop experience. It provides bars, widgets, dock, launcher, control center, notifications, wallpaper, lock screen, and more, built directly on Wayland and OpenGL ES without Qt or GTK dependencies.
en.content: The repository contains a full desktop shell implementation, including multi-monitor bars, taskbar, workspaces, system tray, dock, launcher, control center, notifications, wallpaper, lock screen, clipboard history, OSDs, and more. It includes installation docs, user guides, and an ethos page.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it renders directly via Wayland and OpenGL ES with no Qt/GTK dependencies. Configuration and IPC are designed cohesively, with support for script-backed widgets.
en.hot: With over 10k stars and a monthly gain of 1089, it's trending strongly, indicating high demand for a cohesive, customizable Wayland shell. Its native implementation without Qt/GTK and unified design philosophy are key attractions.
uses: Wayland desktop users seeking a unified, stable experience instead of scattered tools
Linux enthusiasts and developers who enjoy deep customization of desktop appearance and behavior
Productivity users needing multi-monitor support and rich widgets like weather and clipboard history

zh.tag: 隐私优先的 Chromium 浏览器，无广告无噪音
zh.what: Helium 是一款基于 Chromium 的网页浏览器，强调隐私保护和无偏见广告拦截。它去除了 Google 相关服务，提供简洁、快速的上网体验，目前处于测试阶段。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器核心代码、补丁集（来自 ungoogled-chromium 等）以及品牌资源。平台打包和工具链分别存放在独立的仓库中。
zh.stack: 基于 Chromium 和 ungoogled-chromium，使用 C++ 开发，集成 uBlock Origin 的修改版用于广告拦截。
zh.hot: 隐私浏览器需求旺盛，Helium 以无偏见广告拦截和简洁设计吸引用户，star 数已超 2 万，今日新增 111，登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 注重隐私、希望摆脱 Google 追踪的普通用户
开发者可参与贡献，基于 Chromium 的浏览器定制开发
寻求无广告干扰、简洁快速浏览体验的用户

en.tag: Privacy-first Chromium browser with unbiased ad-blocking, no bloat
en.what: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy and unbiased ad-blocking. It removes Google services, offering a clean, fast browsing experience, currently in beta.
en.content: The repo contains the browser core, patchset (from ungoogled-chromium etc.), and branding assets. Platform packaging and tooling are in separate repos.
en.stack: Built on Chromium and ungoogled-chromium, developed in C++, integrates a modified uBlock Origin for ad-blocking.
en.hot: High demand for privacy browsers, Helium attracts users with unbiased ad-blocking and clean design, stars exceed 20k with 111 added today, trending in C++.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to avoid Google tracking
Developers interested in contributing to Chromium-based browser customization
Users seeking an ad-free, clean, and fast browsing experience

zh.tag: Google DeepMind 开源的高性能通用物理仿真引擎
zh.what: MuJoCo 全称 Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact，是一个面向机器人、生物力学、图形动画与机器学习研究的通用物理引擎，专注于快速且精确地仿真关节结构与环境的接触交互。它提供 C API、Python 绑定以及 Unity 插件，由 Google DeepMind 维护。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C 语言核心仿真运行时、内置 XML 模型编译器、OpenGL 原生 GUI 交互查看器 simulate，以及 Python 绑定、Unity 插件和多个 Colab 教程笔记本（入门、模型编辑、rollout、LQR）。
zh.stack: 以 C++/C 实现核心引擎，依赖 OpenGL 做可视化，提供 Python 绑定（含 multithreaded rollout 模块）与 Unity 插件，构建走 GitHub Actions + CMake。
zh.hot: 作为强化学习与机器人仿真的事实标准之一，MuJoCo 长期被 Gym/Gymnasium 等生态广泛采用，15k+ star 且本周仍新增 134，稳居 C++ 周榜第 9。
uses: 强化学习研究者：用 MuJoCo 搭建机器人控制与 locomotion 训练环境
机器人/生物力学工程师：做关节结构与接触动力学的高保真仿真
图形与动画开发者：借助 Unity 插件和物理引擎做交互式动画
Python 学习者：通过官方 Colab 教程快速上手建模与 rollout

en.tag: Google DeepMind's high-performance general-purpose physics simulator
en.what: MuJoCo (Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact) is a general-purpose physics engine for robotics, biomechanics, graphics/animation, and machine learning, focused on fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment. It ships a C API, Python bindings, and a Unity plug-in, and is maintained by Google DeepMind.
en.content: The repo contains the C core simulation runtime, a built-in XML model compiler, the native OpenGL GUI viewer `simulate`, plus Python bindings, a Unity plug-in, and several Colab tutorial notebooks (intro, model editing, rollout, LQR).
en.stack: Core engine written in C++/C, using OpenGL for visualization, with Python bindings (including a multithreaded rollout module) and a Unity plug-in; built via GitHub Actions and CMake.
en.hot: As a de-facto standard for RL and robotics simulation, MuJoCo is widely used across Gym/Gymnasium ecosystems; with 15k+ stars and 134 added this week, it ranks 9th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: RL researchers building robot control and locomotion training environments
Robotics/biomechanics engineers needing high-fidelity articulated contact dynamics
Graphics and animation developers using the Unity plug-in for interactive animation
Python learners following the official Colab tutorials for modeling and rollout

zh.tag: 开源跨平台参数化 3D 建模软件 FreeCAD 官方源码
zh.what: FreeCAD 是一款免费开源的参数化 3D 建模软件，主要用于设计任意尺寸的真实物体。参数化建模让用户可以回溯模型历史、修改参数来调整设计，并支持从 2D 草图构建 3D 模型、再反向生成工程图纸。
zh.content: 仓库是 FreeCAD 的官方源代码，包含核心几何内核、GUI 界面、各功能工作台（如 PartDesign）以及大量 Python API 绑定，并配有图标、文档与构建脚本。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，依赖 OpenCASCADE 几何内核、Coin3D 场景库与 Qt 界面框架，并提供广泛的 Python API 用于脚本扩展。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源 CAD 项目，FreeCAD 本周新增约 197 star、总量突破 3.3 万，登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 12 名，反映出开源替代商业 CAD 的持续热度。
uses: 机械工程师与产品设计师，用参数化建模做零件与装配设计
建筑师与土木从业者，用于建筑信息建模与结构草图
学生和教师，作为免费教学工具学习 CAD 与工程制图
开发者与爱好者，通过 Python API 扩展自定义工作台

en.tag: Official source of FreeCAD, the open-source cross-platform parametric 3D modeler
en.what: FreeCAD is a free, open-source parametric 3D modeler for designing real-life objects of any size. Parametric modeling lets users go back into model history to change parameters, and it supports building 3D from constrained 2D sketches and producing production-ready drawings.
en.content: The repo holds FreeCAD's official source code, including the geometry core, Qt-based GUI, feature workbenches such as PartDesign, and extensive Python API bindings, plus icons, docs and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built on the OpenCASCADE geometry kernel, Coin3D scene library and Qt GUI framework, with a broad Python API for scripting and extensions.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source CAD project, FreeCAD gained about 197 stars this week, passing 33k total and ranking 12th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list, reflecting steady demand for open-source CAD alternatives.
uses: Mechanical engineers and product designers doing parametric part and assembly design
Architects and civil professionals for building modeling and structural sketches
Students and teachers seeking a free tool to learn CAD and engineering drawing
Developers and hobbyists extending custom workbenches via the Python API

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和应用串流到其他设备，支持低延迟和高画质。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档和图标资源。提供多种安装方式，如 Docker、Flatpak、Windows 安装包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA 等编解码库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 4 万星标，本月新增 1103 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其受欢迎程度源于对 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代需求，以及开源社区对自托管串流方案的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到局域网内的其他设备，如笔记本、手机或电视。
远程办公或学习：远程访问高性能 PC 上的应用，实现移动办公。
开源爱好者：自建串流服务，摆脱对商业服务的依赖，保障隐私和自由度。

en.tag: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games and applications from their PC to other devices with low latency and high quality.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, and icon assets. Multiple installation methods are available, including Docker, Flatpak, Windows installers, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on FFmpeg, CUDA, and other codec libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: With over 40,000 stars and 1,103 new stars this month, ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list, its popularity stems from the need for a replacement for NVIDIA GameStream and the community's preference for self-hosted streaming solutions.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to other devices on the local network, such as laptops, phones, or TVs.
Remote work or study: remotely access applications on a high-performance PC for mobile productivity.
Open-source enthusiasts: self-host streaming services to avoid commercial dependencies, ensuring privacy and freedom.

zh.tag: 开源软件 KVM：一套键鼠无缝控制多台电脑
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键盘鼠标共享工具，让你用一台电脑的键鼠或触控板去控制旁边的其他电脑，在它们之间无缝切换工作。它相当于不带视频功能的软件 KVM，默认启用 TLS 加密，并支持 Wayland 与剪贴板共享。
zh.content: 仓库是完整的跨平台桌面应用源码，包含核心共享逻辑、各平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）构建与打包配置，并提供稳定版、持续构建版以及 Flathub 与 Homebrew 等分发渠道。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主语言，面向 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 多平台构建，依赖系统图形与输入层（含 Wayland 支持），并内置 TLS 加密通信。
zh.hot: 作为 Synergy 的开源继任者，它解决了多机办公的刚需，累计已获约 2.87 万 star，本周再增 201，稳居 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 11 名。
uses: 同时使用笔记本与台式机的开发者，用一套键鼠跨屏操作
多系统办公用户（Windows/macOS/Linux 混用）需要无缝切换
想替代硬件 KVM 或 Synergy 的团队与个人，追求开源免费方案
注重隐私安全、希望默认加密并共享剪贴板的用户

en.tag: Open-source software KVM: share one keyboard and mouse across computers
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control nearby computers with one computer's keyboard, mouse, or trackpad and work seamlessly between them. It works like a software KVM without the video, with TLS encryption on by default, plus Wayland and clipboard sharing support.
en.content: The repo holds the full cross-platform desktop app source, including the core sharing logic, per-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) build and packaging configs, and distribution channels such as stable, continuous builds, Flathub, and Homebrew.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and built for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it relies on platform graphics/input layers (including Wayland) and uses TLS-encrypted communication.
en.hot: As the open-source successor to Synergy, it scratches a real multi-machine workflow itch, with roughly 28.7k stars total and 201 added this week, ranking 11th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list.
uses: Developers juggling a laptop and desktop who want one keyboard and mouse across screens
Multi-OS office users (Windows/macOS/Linux mix) needing seamless switching
Teams and individuals replacing hardware KVMs or Synergy with a free open-source option
Privacy-conscious users who want encryption by default plus clipboard sharing

zh.tag: 3D打印切片与G代码生成工具
zh.what: PrusaSlicer 是一款将 3D 模型转换为 3D 打印指令（G-code）的软件，支持 FDM 和 mSLA 打印机。它由 Prusa Research 开发，兼容多种品牌打印机，并提供丰富的打印参数设置和模型编辑功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建文档（doc/Build.md）、资源文件（如图标）以及贡献指南。主要功能包括精确的打印参数设置、模型编辑（如涂色、切割、排列）、多项目多平台支持、多材料打印、3D 预览和命令行接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Slic3r 构建，依赖常见的图形和几何库。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台，Linux 通过 Flathub 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 打印领域的知名开源切片软件，PrusaSlicer 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 9296，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。其强大的功能和活跃的社区是热度来源。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：使用 PrusaSlicer 将模型切片并生成打印指令，支持多种打印机。
专业用户：需要精细控制打印参数和进行多材料打印的工程师或设计师。
自动化工作流：通过命令行接口在无 GUI 环境下集成切片功能。

en.tag: 3D printing slicer and G-code generator
en.what: PrusaSlicer is a software that converts 3D models into 3D printing instructions (G-code), supporting FDM and mSLA printers. Developed by Prusa Research, it is compatible with a wide range of printer brands and offers extensive printing parameter settings and model editing features.
en.content: The repository contains the complete C++ source code, build documentation (doc/Build.md), resource files (e.g., icons), and contribution guidelines. Key features include precise printing parameter settings, model editing (painting, cutting, arranging), multi-project and multi-bed support, multi-material printing, 3D preview, and a command-line interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, built on Slic3r, and relies on common graphics and geometry libraries. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux; Linux is distributed via Flathub.
en.hot: As a well-known open-source slicer in 3D printing, PrusaSlicer continues to gain attention, adding 13 stars today, reaching 9296 total, ranking third on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and active community drive its popularity.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use PrusaSlicer to slice models and generate print instructions for various printers.
Professional users: engineers or designers needing precise control over print parameters and multi-material printing.
Automation workflows: integrate slicing via command-line interface in headless environments.

zh.tag: 基于 Qt 与 MLT 的跨平台开源视频剪辑器
zh.what: Shotcut 是一款免费、开源、跨平台的视频编辑器，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux。它基于 MLT 多媒体框架构建，提供多轨时间线、格式转换、滤镜与音频处理等完整剪辑能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/QML 源码、CMake 构建脚本、各平台 CI 工作流，以及依赖 MLT、Qt6、FFmpeg、FFTW、Frei0r、SDL 的集成代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 6（QML 界面），依赖 MLT 框架、FFmpeg 编解码库、FFTW、Frei0r 插件与 SDL 音频，通过 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源剪辑工具，它已积累 15155 颗星，本周新增 79 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 14 名，说明轻量免费的本地剪辑方案持续受到关注。
uses: 预算有限、希望免费本地剪辑的独立创作者与爱好者
需要跨 Windows/macOS/Linux 统一工作流的视频工作者
想基于 MLT/Qt 二次开发或学习多媒体框架的开发者

en.tag: A cross-platform open-source video editor built on Qt and MLT
en.what: Shotcut is a free, open-source, cross-platform video editor for Windows, macOS and Linux. Built on the MLT multimedia framework, it offers multi-track timeline editing, format conversion, filters and audio processing.
en.content: The repo holds C++/QML sources, CMake build scripts, per-platform CI workflows, and integration code for MLT, Qt6, FFmpeg, FFTW, Frei0r and SDL.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt 6 (QML UI), depending on the MLT framework, FFmpeg codecs, FFTW, Frei0r plugins and SDL audio, built via CMake.
en.hot: As a veteran open-source editing tool it has reached 15,155 stars, adding 79 this week and ranking 14th on the C++ weekly trending list, showing steady demand for lightweight free local editing.
uses: Independent creators and hobbyists wanting free local editing on a budget
Video workers needing a consistent workflow across Windows/macOS/Linux
Developers learning or extending multimedia frameworks via MLT/Qt

zh.tag: 拓竹 3D 打印机官方切片软件，功能丰富的开源切片器
zh.what: Bambu Studio 是拓竹科技推出的切片软件，用于把 3D 模型转换为打印机可执行的 GCode。它支持多盘管理、远程控制与监控、多材料打印等，兼容拓竹及其他品牌 3D 打印机。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源码、编译指南、文档目录和 wiki 链接，并提供 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 的预编译版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 PrusaSlicer（源自 Slic3r），采用 GNU AGPL v3 许可证，依赖各平台图形与构建工具链。
zh.hot: 作为拓竹生态的核心软件，它随硬件销量增长持续获得关注，目前约 5 千 star，本周新增 44，登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 15 名。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：用直观界面完成模型切片与打印准备
拓竹打印机用户：远程监控、多材料打印与设备管理
开发者与研究者：基于开源代码定制切片算法或集成工作流

en.tag: BambuLab's official open-source slicing software for 3D printers
en.what: Bambu Studio is a slicing application from BambuLab that converts 3D models into printer-ready GCode. It offers multi-plate management, remote control and monitoring, multi-material printing, and works with BambuLab and other 3D printers.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, compile guides, a documentation directory and wiki links, plus prebuilt releases for Windows, macOS and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, based on PrusaSlicer (itself derived from Slic3r), licensed under GNU AGPL v3, and relies on platform-specific graphics and build toolchains.
en.hot: As the core software of the BambuLab ecosystem, it keeps gaining attention alongside hardware sales, with about 5k stars, +44 this week, ranking 15th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: slice models and prepare prints via an intuitive UI
BambuLab printer owners: remote monitoring, multi-material printing and device management
Developers and researchers: customize slicing algorithms or integrate workflows on top of the open-source code

zh.tag: 明日方舟全自动日常助手，一键长草
zh.what: MAA 是一款基于图像识别的《明日方舟》游戏辅助工具，能自动完成游戏内的日常任务，如刷图、基建换班、公招等。它通过模拟操作和图像识别，让玩家实现“一键长草”，省时省力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档（支持多语言）、以及用于构建和发布的配置。主要模块涵盖战斗、基建、公招、肉鸽等自动化功能，并提供多种编程语言的接口。
zh.stack: 基于 C++20 开发，使用图像识别技术，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。项目还集成了多种语言的接口，如 C、Python、Java、Rust 和 Golang。
zh.hot: 作为热门游戏《明日方舟》的辅助工具，MAA 凭借其高度自动化和活跃的社区更新，在 GitHub 上获得了 2.3 万星标，本月新增 762 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 21 名。
uses: 《明日方舟》玩家：希望自动完成日常任务，节省时间，实现一键长草。
游戏自动化爱好者：对图像识别和模拟操作技术感兴趣，可学习其实现。
开发者：需要集成游戏辅助功能，可通过提供的多种语言接口进行二次开发。

en.tag: One-click Arknights daily task assistant, auto-grind all clients
en.what: MAA is an image-recognition-based assistant for Arknights that automates daily tasks like auto-battles, base management, and recruitment. It simulates user operations to enable one-click idle farming, saving time and effort.
en.content: The repo contains full C++ source code, multi-language docs, and build/release configs. Main modules cover battle, base, recruitment, and roguelike automation, with APIs in multiple languages.
en.stack: Built with C++20, leveraging image recognition, and supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It also provides APIs for C, Python, Java, Rust, and Golang.
en.hot: As a popular Arknights assistant, MAA's high automation and active community updates have earned 22,988 stars, with 762 added this month, ranking #21 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Arknights players who want to automate daily tasks and save time with one-click farming.
Game automation enthusiasts interested in image recognition and simulated input techniques.
Developers seeking to integrate game assist features via provided multi-language APIs.

zh.tag: 轻量极速的进程内向量数据库，为 AI 应用而生
zh.what: Zvec 是一个开源的进程内向量数据库，专为嵌入式应用设计，提供低延迟、可扩展的相似性搜索。它已在阿里巴巴集团内部经过实战检验，支持生产级使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 引擎、Python 和 Node.js 客户端库，以及 CLI 工具 zvec-grep，统一了 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜索。还集成了 ReMe 代理记忆管理工具，并支持 DiskANN 和 IVF-RaBit 等索引优化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python（3.10~3.14）和 npm 包，支持 Linux/macOS ARM64，采用 io_uring 异步 I/O，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 凭借 15,840 颗星（本周新增 301）登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因其轻量级、高性能和阿里背书而备受关注。最新版本引入了 zvec-grep 和 ReMe 集成，扩展了 AI 代理场景。
uses: 开发者需要在应用中嵌入向量数据库，实现低延迟相似性搜索。
AI 代理开发者需要本地优先的工作区搜索工具，结合关键词与向量检索。
需要轻量级、免运维的向量存储方案，用于原型验证或生产环境。

en.tag: A lightweight, lightning-fast, in-process vector database for AI applications
en.what: Zvec is an open-source, in-process vector database designed for embedding directly into applications, offering low-latency, scalable similarity search. It is battle-tested within Alibaba Group and production-ready.
en.content: The repository includes the core C++ engine, Python and Node.js client libraries, and a CLI tool zvec-grep that unifies ripgrep, BM25, and vector search. It also integrates with ReMe agent memory management and supports DiskANN and IVF-RaBit index optimizations.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with Python (3.10~3.14) and npm packages, supports Linux/macOS ARM64, uses io_uring async I/O, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: With 15,840 stars (301 added this week) and trending on GitHub, it gains attention for its lightweight, high-performance design and Alibaba backing. The latest release introduces zvec-grep and ReMe integration, expanding AI agent use cases.
uses: Developers needing an embedded vector database for low-latency similarity search in their applications.
AI agent developers requiring local-first workspace search combining keyword and vector retrieval.
Teams seeking a lightweight, zero-ops vector storage solution for prototyping or production.

zh.tag: 极致追求速度的小型构建系统
zh.what: Ninja 是一个专注于速度的小型构建系统，通过极简的构建描述文件实现快速增量编译。它通常由 CMake、Meson 等上层工具生成 build.ninja 文件，再负责高效执行构建任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的核心源码、Python 编写的 configure.py 引导脚本、doc/manual.asciidoc 手册文档，以及 misc/ 下的 Bash 补全和 Vim/Emacs 编辑模式配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，构建自身可依赖 Python 脚本或 CMake，文档由 asciidoc/xsltproc 生成，测试可选依赖 GoogleTest。
zh.hot: 作为 Chromium、LLVM 等大型项目的默认构建后端，Ninja 长期是 C++ 生态的基石；本周新增 32 star 登上 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 18 名，累计 13,217 star 印证其持久影响力。
uses: 使用 CMake/Meson 等生成器的大型 C++ 项目开发者，需要极速增量构建
希望理解构建系统底层原理或参与 Ninja 源码贡献的工程师
在 CI/CD 中追求最短编译时间的团队与 DevOps 人员

en.tag: A small build system with a focus on speed
en.what: Ninja is a small build system focused on speed, using a minimal build description file to achieve fast incremental builds. It is typically driven by higher-level tools like CMake or Meson that generate build.ninja files, then executes the build tasks efficiently.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++ source, a Python-based configure.py bootstrap script, the doc/manual.asciidoc manual, and misc/ files for Bash completion plus Vim/Emacs editing modes.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, it can bootstrap itself via a Python script or CMake, with docs generated by asciidoc/xsltproc and optional tests using GoogleTest.
en.hot: As the default build backend for large projects like Chromium and LLVM, Ninja is a long-standing cornerstone of the C++ ecosystem; 32 new stars this week landed it at #18 on GitHub Trending's C++ weekly chart, with 13,217 total stars proving its lasting impact.
uses: Developers of large C++ projects using CMake/Meson generators who need blazing-fast incremental builds
Engineers wanting to understand build system internals or contribute to Ninja's source
Teams and DevOps engineers optimizing CI/CD for the shortest compile times

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步
zh.what: 这是 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场仓库，包含可安装的插件列表。它由 Anthropic 内部审核流程同步，所有插件都经过安全扫描和批准。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 marketplace.json 文件，列出了所有社区插件及其元数据。此外还有 README 说明如何使用和提交插件。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，但仓库本身是静态 JSON 数据，由自动化流程同步。
zh.hot: 今日新增 190 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为 Claude 插件生态正在快速增长，开发者需要官方认可的插件来源。
uses: Claude Code 用户：通过命令行快速安装社区插件，扩展功能。
插件开发者：提交插件到官方市场，获得分发和曝光。
企业团队：在受控环境中使用经过安全审核的插件。

en.tag: Read-only mirror of Claude community plugin marketplace, synced nightly
en.what: This is the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, containing a list of installable plugins. It is synced from Anthropic's internal review pipeline, and all plugins have passed security scanning and approval.
en.content: The repository mainly contains a marketplace.json file listing all community plugins with their metadata, plus a README explaining how to use and submit plugins.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but the repo itself is static JSON data synced by automated processes.
en.hot: Gained 190 stars today and hit the trending list, as the Claude plugin ecosystem is rapidly growing and developers need an official source for plugins.
uses: Claude Code users: quickly install community plugins via CLI to extend functionality.
Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.
Enterprise teams: use security-reviewed plugins in controlled environments.

zh.tag: 时空可组合性的元框架，让模块随时间和空间动态组合
zh.what: Cordis 是一个元框架，旨在实现时空可组合性，让软件模块能够在不同时间和空间维度上动态组合与重组。它提供了一套编程范式，使系统能够灵活适应变化，支持模块的热插拔和上下文感知的组装。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架的核心 TypeScript 实现、相关论文（arXiv 链接）以及初步的文档（cordis-primer）。目前处于活跃开发阶段，API 尚未稳定。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 生态。具体依赖未在 README 中详细列出，但作为元框架，可能涉及模块加载、依赖注入等机制。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本月新增超过 8000 颗星，总星数达 8379，位列 Trending 月榜第 4 名。其创新的时空可组合性概念和论文的发布吸引了大量关注。
uses: 框架开发者与架构师 —— 探索新型模块化与动态组合范式
需要高度可扩展和自适应系统的团队 —— 构建能够随时间演化的应用
研究人员与学生 —— 研究编程语言与软件工程前沿课题

en.tag: A meta-framework for spatiotemporal composability, enabling dynamic module composition across time and space
en.what: Cordis is a meta-framework designed for spatiotemporal composability, allowing software modules to dynamically compose and recompose across time and space dimensions. It provides a programming paradigm that enables systems to adapt flexibly to changes, supporting hot-swapping and context-aware assembly of modules.
en.content: The repository contains the core TypeScript implementation of the framework, related papers (arXiv link), and preliminary documentation (cordis-primer). It is under active development with an unstable API.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, relying on the Node.js ecosystem. Specific dependencies are not detailed in the README, but as a meta-framework, it likely involves module loading, dependency injection, and similar mechanisms.
en.hot: The project has gained rapid popularity on GitHub, adding over 8,000 stars this month to reach 8,379 total, ranking 4th on the monthly Trending list. Its innovative concept of spatiotemporal composability and the release of its paper have attracted significant attention.
uses: Framework developers and architects — exploring new modularization and dynamic composition paradigms
Teams needing highly scalable and adaptive systems — building applications that evolve over time
Researchers and students — studying cutting-edge topics in programming languages and software engineering

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: X 平台 For You 信息流核心算法开源
zh.what: 该仓库包含 X（原 Twitter）For You 信息流中决定用户看到哪些帖子的核心代码。它结合用户关注的内容（网络内）和通过机器学习检索发现的内容（网络外），经过过滤和排序后，使用 Transformer 模型对帖子进行排名。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统架构文档、请求路径和标注路径说明，以及多个组件目录，如 home-mixer（含评分器、过滤器、参数）、可见性过滤、模型训练代码和合成数据生成代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，涉及机器学习模型（如 Transformer）、参数配置、过滤逻辑和实验框架。依赖包括用于模型训练的 Phoenix 模型相关代码。
zh.hot: 作为 X 平台核心算法的开源实现，吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标超过 3.2 万，月榜第 11 名。其透明化举措和近期更新（如巴西选举过滤）引发热议。
uses: 对推荐系统、信息流排序感兴趣的开发者，可研究其架构和实现细节。
希望了解 X 平台内容过滤和排名机制的研究者或记者。
需要参考大规模生产级算法工程实践的工程师。

en.tag: Open-source core algorithm powering X's For You feed
en.what: This repository contains the core code that determines which posts a viewer sees in the For You feed on X. It combines in-network content from followed accounts with out-of-network content discovered via ML-based retrieval, filters based on various inputs, and ranks posts using a transformer model.
en.content: The repo includes system architecture docs, request and labeling path explanations, and component directories like home-mixer (with scorers, filters, params), visibility filtering, model training code, and synthetic data generation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, involving ML models (e.g., Transformer), parameter configuration, filtering logic, and experimentation frameworks. Dependencies include Phoenix model training code and synthetic data generation.
en.hot: As the open-source implementation of X's core algorithm, it has attracted significant attention with over 32k stars, ranking 11th on the monthly trending. Its transparency and recent updates (e.g., Brazil election filter) spark discussions.
uses: Developers interested in recommendation systems and feed ranking can study its architecture and implementation details.
Researchers or journalists wanting to understand X's content filtering and ranking mechanisms.
Engineers seeking reference for large-scale production-grade algorithm engineering practices.

zh.tag: 一个菜单栏图标，替代十几个付费 Mac 应用
zh.what: Vorssaint 是一个免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具包，将音量控制、系统监控、窗口管理等多种实用功能整合到一个菜单栏图标中。它旨在替代多个付费应用，提供简洁统一的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Swift 项目源码，包括菜单栏面板（如混音器、系统监控、窗口控制）、文档、CI 配置和发布资源。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，面向 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon，采用 GPL-3.0 许可证，并依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1.1 万星，总星数达 1.5 万，因其免费开源、功能强大且替代多个付费应用而广受欢迎，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 希望减少付费 Mac 应用数量、追求性价比的用户
需要快速访问音量、系统监控和窗口管理的效率工作者
对开源和隐私保护有要求的 macOS 用户

en.tag: One menu bar icon replacing a dozen paid Mac apps
en.what: Vorssaint is a free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume control, system monitoring, window management, and other utilities into a single menu bar icon. It aims to replace multiple paid apps with a clean, unified experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full Swift project source, including menu bar panels (mixer, system monitor, window controls), documentation, CI config, and release assets.
en.stack: Built with Swift, targeting macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon, licensed under GPL-3.0, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: Gained 11k stars this month, reaching 15k total, popular for being free, open-source, and replacing multiple paid apps, trending on GitHub.
uses: Users wanting to reduce paid Mac apps and seek cost-effectiveness
Productivity workers needing quick access to volume, system monitoring, and window controls
macOS users who value open-source and privacy

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源 Palantir，图原生上下文与可问责基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它支持企业数据接入、上下文图与知识图谱构建，并提供图分析与因果推理，内置完整的决策溯源，确保可解释、可追踪和可信赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档与示例，支持 RDF 和 LPG 多语言图存储，遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理与决策智能模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.8+，依赖图数据库（如 RDF 三元组存储和属性图数据库），集成知识图谱与因果推理库，遵循 W3C 标准，提供开放 API 与 PyPI 分发。
zh.hot: 本月新增超 1 万 star，位居趋势榜第二，因其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，切中高监管领域对可解释、可溯源 AI 的迫切需求，同时强调开放、治理与零厂商锁定。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统提供可靠上下文与决策溯源，满足合规审计要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用 RDF/LPG 标准构建可互操作的知识模型，并进行图分析与推理。
高监管行业（金融、医疗、政务）：要求 AI 决策可解释、可追踪，降低风险并提升信任。
AI 基础设施研究者：探索图原生架构与因果推理在 AI 系统中的应用，构建可问责的智能体。

en.tag: Open-source Palantir for AI agents: graph-native context & accountable AI infrastructure
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds context and knowledge graphs, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance baked in, making AI explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, and examples, supporting polyglot graph storage with RDF and LPG, W3C standards, ontology management, and decision intelligence modules.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.8+, leveraging graph databases (RDF triple stores and property graphs), integrating knowledge graph and causal reasoning libraries, following W3C standards, with open APIs and PyPI distribution.
en.hot: With over 10k stars added this month and ranking #2 on the trending list, it's hot because it positions as the 'open-source Palantir for AI agents', addressing the urgent need for explainable and traceable AI in regulated domains, while emphasizing openness, governance, and zero vendor lock-in.
uses: Enterprise AI teams needing reliable context and decision provenance for agent systems to meet compliance and audit requirements.
Knowledge graph developers looking to build interoperable knowledge models using RDF/LPG standards with graph analytics and reasoning.
Regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government) requiring explainable and traceable AI decisions to reduce risk and build trust.
AI infrastructure researchers exploring graph-native architectures and causal reasoning for accountable intelligent agents.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 跨 AI 编码代理的长期记忆与交接协议
zh.what: ai-memory 为 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆，支持在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20+ 代理间无缝切换，无需重新解释架构或未决问题。它通过 git 备份的 markdown 文件存储记忆，并内置多用户认证与审计日志，适合个人及团队使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的单一二进制文件，提供捕获、整合、召回和交接功能。包含生命周期钩子、隐私边界、审计日志，以及可重建的索引数据库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 1.95+，依赖 git 作为存储后端，支持 markdown 文件操作，无需向量数据库。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4490 星，总星数达 5887，因其解决了 AI 编码代理切换时的记忆丢失痛点，且零 LLM 调用即可工作，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 个人开发者：在不同 AI 编码代理间切换时保留上下文，避免重复解释项目细节。
团队协作：共享项目记忆，让团队成员的代理都能访问集体知识。
自托管用户：在自有服务器上运行，实现跨机器同步和隐私控制。

en.tag: Cross-agent long-term memory and handoff protocol for coding CLIs
en.what: ai-memory provides long-term memory for AI coding agents, enabling seamless switching between 20+ agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor without re-explaining architecture or open questions. It stores memory as git-backed markdown files and includes multi-user auth and audit logs for team use.
en.content: The repo contains a single Rust binary offering capture, consolidate, recall, and handoff features. It includes lifecycle hooks, privacy boundaries, audit logs, and a rebuildable index database.
en.stack: Primarily Rust 1.95+, uses git as storage backend, supports markdown file operations, no vector database required.
en.hot: Gained 4490 stars this month (total 5887), trending #18 on GitHub. It solves the pain of memory loss when switching AI coding agents and works with zero LLM calls, attracting developers.
uses: Individual developers: preserve context when switching between different AI coding agents, avoiding re-explaining project details.
Team collaboration: share project memory so all team members' agents can access collective knowledge.
Self-hosters: run on your own server for cross-machine sync and privacy control.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 出品的 LLM 智能路由层，按需把每次调用分发给最划算的模型
zh.what: Switchyard 为 LLM 应用提供模型路由能力，在保持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 原生 API 兼容的前提下，把每次请求分发到不同模型或供应商。它支持灵活选型、基准测试以及成本/性能优化，目标是让智能体在不改代码的情况下用上更便宜的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 库 nemo-switchyard、Rust 版 switchyard-libsy 与 switchyard-llm-client，以及独立代理 switchyard-server；还提供 LiteLLM、NeMo Relay 插件示例和 routes.toml 配置样例。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，同时提供 Rust 实现；依赖 LiteLLM、NeMo Relay 等网关生态，可通过 pip 或 cargo 安装，并兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic SDK 客户端。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2628 颗星、总数 2837，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 10 名；在 LLM 成本压力下，NVIDIA 背书且能无缝接入现有网关的省钱路由方案极具吸引力。
uses: 正在为 LLM 调用成本发愁、希望按任务难度自动降级的 AI 应用团队
已使用 LiteLLM 或 NeMo Relay 网关、想加入智能路由的工程团队
需要在多个模型/供应商之间做基准测试与选型对比的研究人员
想在不改代码的前提下让 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等智能体走更便宜模型的开发者

en.tag: NVIDIA's LLM routing layer that sends each call to the cheapest capable model
en.what: Switchyard routes LLM traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility. It enables flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization, aiming to serve each call with the cheapest model that can still do the job.
en.content: It ships the Python package nemo-switchyard, the Rust crates switchyard-libsy and switchyard-llm-client, and a standalone switchyard-server proxy, plus LiteLLM and NeMo Relay plugin examples with routes.toml configs.
en.stack: Primarily Python with Rust components; it integrates with LiteLLM and NeMo Relay gateways, installs via pip or cargo, and stays compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic SDK clients.
en.hot: It gained 2,628 stars this month (2,837 total), ranking 10th on GitHub Trending monthly; with LLM cost pressure high, an NVIDIA-backed drop-in router that plugs into existing gateways is compelling.
uses: AI application teams looking to cut LLM costs by auto-downgrading per task difficulty
Engineering teams already running LiteLLM or NeMo Relay gateways who want smart routing
Researchers benchmarking and comparing models/providers for selection
Developers wanting Claude Code, Codex CLI, or other agents to use cheaper models without code changes

zh.tag: 在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 利用 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施，在 macOS 上启动虚拟 iPhone。它自动化了从下载固件、修补引导链到 DFU 恢复和首次启动的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含命令行工具 vphone-cli、用于管理虚拟机的子命令（vm、fw、restore、cfw 等），以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 编写，依赖 Python、aria2、wget、openssl、libusb 等工具，通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 周榜排名第 8，本周新增近 2000 star，总 star 过万，因其能在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的突破性能力而备受关注。
uses: iOS 开发者和安全研究人员，希望在 Mac 上快速启动虚拟 iPhone 进行测试。
对 iOS 内部机制感兴趣的技术爱好者，想探索 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施。
需要多设备测试环境的人员，可通过克隆快速创建多个虚拟 iPhone。

en.tag: CLI tool to boot a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs
en.what: vphone-cli leverages Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure to boot a virtual iPhone on macOS. It automates the entire pipeline from firmware download, boot chain patching, DFU restore, to first boot.
en.content: The repository includes the vphone-cli command-line tool, subcommands for VM management (vm, fw, restore, cfw, etc.), build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Swift, with dependencies on Python, aria2, wget, openssl, libusb, etc., installed via Homebrew.
en.hot: Ranked #8 on GitHub Trending this week with ~2000 new stars, surpassing 10k total, it gains attention for its groundbreaking ability to run a virtual iPhone on a Mac.
uses: iOS developers and security researchers who want to spin up virtual iPhones on a Mac for testing.
Tech enthusiasts interested in iOS internals, exploring PCC research VM infrastructure.
Those needing multiple test devices, can quickly clone virtual iPhones for parallel testing.

zh.tag: 免费公共 API 大全，开发者资源宝库
zh.what: 这是一个由社区维护的免费公共 API 集合，涵盖动物、动漫、反恶意软件、艺术与设计、认证与授权、区块链、书籍、商业、日历、云存储与文件等众多领域。它为开发者提供了丰富的 API 资源，方便他们快速查找和集成到自己的项目中。
zh.content: 仓库以 README 为主，按类别列出所有 API，每个 API 包含名称、描述、认证方式、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS 等信息。此外，还包含贡献指南和 API 提交要求。
zh.stack: 仓库本身是纯文档，主要使用 Markdown 编写。主语言标记为 Python，但实际内容不涉及代码。
zh.hot: 该仓库拥有超过 46 万 star，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的资源列表之一。今日新增 2260 star，持续受到开发者关注，因为它提供了免费 API 的集中索引，节省了开发者搜索和筛选的时间。
uses: 开发者寻找免费 API 用于个人项目或原型开发
技术爱好者探索不同领域的 API，学习集成方法
产品经理或创业者调研可用的 API 服务，评估可行性
教育场景中作为教学资源，帮助学生了解 API 生态

en.tag: A curated list of free public APIs for developers
en.what: This is a community-maintained collection of free public APIs, covering a wide range of categories such as Animals, Anime, Anti-Malware, Art & Design, Authentication & Authorization, Blockchain, Books, Business, Calendar, Cloud Storage & File, and more. It provides developers with a rich resource of APIs to quickly find and integrate into their projects.
en.content: The repository is primarily a README that lists all APIs by category, with each API including name, description, auth, HTTPS, and CORS. It also includes contribution guidelines and API submission requirements.
en.stack: The repository is documentation-only, written in Markdown. The primary language is marked as Python, but there is no actual code.
en.hot: With over 460k stars, this is one of the most popular resource lists on GitHub. Today it gained 2260 stars, remaining a go-to for developers as it provides a centralized index of free APIs, saving time on searching and filtering.
uses: Developers looking for free APIs for personal projects or prototyping
Tech enthusiasts exploring APIs across domains to learn integration
Product managers or entrepreneurs researching available API services for feasibility
Educational use as a teaching resource to understand the API ecosystem

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 一键生成高清短视频的AI自动化工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个一站式 AI 短视频生成工具，用户只需提供主题或关键词，它就能自动完成脚本撰写、素材匹配、字幕生成、背景音乐合成，最终输出高清短视频。它支持 WebUI 和 API 两种交互方式，适合快速批量制作视频内容。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 项目源码，提供 WebUI 图形界面和 API 服务，内置视频生成工作流，支持多种素材源和 AI 模型接入，并附带详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案生成，使用自动化工作流处理素材下载、字幕生成和视频合成，支持跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux）。
zh.hot: 凭借 12 万+ Star 和月增近 2 万的热度，它精准切中短视频创作者对高效内容生产的需求，将复杂的视频制作流程简化为一次点击，极大降低了创作门槛。
uses: 短视频创作者：快速将热点话题或关键词转化为成片，提升内容产出效率。
自媒体运营者：批量生成不同主题的视频，用于多平台分发和测试。
营销人员：制作产品宣传或广告短视频，无需专业视频编辑技能。
开发者：通过 API 集成到自己的应用或流程中，实现自动化视频生成。

en.tag: One-click AI tool to auto-generate HD short videos
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI short video generator. Users only need to provide a topic or keyword, and it automatically handles script writing, footage matching, subtitle generation, background music synthesis, and outputs HD short videos. It offers both WebUI and API interfaces, enabling rapid batch video production.
en.content: The repository contains complete Python source code, offering a WebUI and API service with a built-in video generation workflow. It supports multiple footage sources and AI model integrations, along with detailed documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, leveraging AI LLMs (e.g., Kimi K3) for script generation, and using automated workflows for footage downloading, subtitle creation, and video composition. Cross-platform support for Windows/macOS/Linux.
en.hot: With over 120K stars and nearly 20K monthly additions, it addresses the high demand for efficient short-video creation, simplifying complex production into one click and drastically lowering the barrier for creators.
uses: Short-video creators: Quickly turn trending topics or keywords into finished videos to boost productivity.
Social media managers: Batch-generate videos on various themes for multi-platform distribution and testing.
Marketers: Create promotional or ad videos without professional editing skills.
Developers: Integrate the API into custom applications or workflows for automated video generation.

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率
需要灵活控制内存和 SSD 缓存、自动切换模型的高级用户
通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

zh.tag: 数学视频动画引擎，3Blue1Brown 出品
zh.what: Manim 是一个用于创建精确编程动画的引擎，专为制作解释性数学视频而设计。它由 3Blue1Brown 的作者开发，用于制作其 YouTube 视频中的动画。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ManimGL 的源代码，包括核心动画模块、场景类、图形对象和渲染器。还提供了示例场景和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，依赖 FFmpeg、OpenGL 和可选的 LaTeX。Linux 系统需要 Pango。
zh.hot: 作为 3Blue1Brown 官方工具，拥有近 9 万星标，今日新增 381 星，持续受到数学教育者和视频创作者的关注。
uses: 数学教育者：制作教学视频中的动画演示
视频创作者：为科普内容添加精确的数学动画
开发者：学习或扩展动画引擎，定制自己的数学可视化

en.tag: Animation engine for explanatory math videos by 3Blue1Brown
en.what: Manim is an engine for precise programmatic animations, designed for creating explanatory math videos. It was developed by the author of 3Blue1Brown for animating those videos.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for ManimGL, including core animation modules, scene classes, mobjects, and renderers. It also includes example scenes and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, with dependencies on FFmpeg, OpenGL, and optional LaTeX. Pango is required on Linux.
en.hot: As the official tool of 3Blue1Brown, it has nearly 90k stars, with 381 stars added today, continuing to attract math educators and video creators.
uses: Math educators: create animated demonstrations for teaching videos
Video creators: add precise math animations to science content
Developers: learn or extend the animation engine for custom math visualizations

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 全栈 AI 红队平台，守护 AI 生态安全
zh.what: AI-Infra-Guard 是一个全栈 AI 红队平台，用于扫描和评估 AI 生态系统的安全性。它支持 Agent 扫描、技能扫描、MCP 扫描、AI 基础设施扫描以及 LLM 越狱评估，帮助发现潜在漏洞。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台代码，包括扫描器、评估模块、文档和 Docker 镜像。提供多语言 README（中文、日文、西班牙文等），并集成了 ClawHub 和 OpenClaw 等工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，支持 Docker 部署，并可能涉及 LLM 评估框架和云原生技术。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 安全日益重要，该平台提供了全面的红队测试方案，本月新增近 1800 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，反映了社区对 AI 安全工具的高需求。

AI 开发者：在开发过程中集成安全测试，确保 AI 应用合规。
企业安全团队：部署平台以监控和保护 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems
en.what: AI-Infra-Guard is a full-stack AI red teaming platform that scans and evaluates the security of AI ecosystems. It supports agent scanning, skills scanning, MCP scanning, AI infrastructure scanning, and LLM jailbreak evaluation to uncover potential vulnerabilities.

en.hot: As AI security becomes increasingly critical, this platform offers comprehensive red teaming solutions. With nearly 1,800 stars added this month and trending on GitHub, it reflects the community's high demand for AI security tools.
uses: Security researchers: to evaluate the security of AI systems and uncover vulnerabilities.
AI developers: to integrate security testing during development and ensure compliance.
Enterprise security teams: to deploy the platform for monitoring and protecting AI infrastructure.

zh.tag: 本地运行与训练大模型和扩散模型的桌面应用
zh.what: Unsloth 是一个本地优先的 AI 工具，允许用户在个人电脑上运行和训练大型语言模型（LLM）和扩散模型。它支持包括 Qwen3.8、Kimi K3、MiniMax-H3、Gemma 4、DeepSeek-V4 和 FLUX 在内的多种模型，并提供桌面应用和命令行安装方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）、命令行安装脚本、文档和示例笔记本。核心功能是模型运行、训练和部署，并支持与 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 等代理工具集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构。桌面应用可能使用 Electron 或类似技术打包。

教育者与学生：学习模型训练和推理，无需昂贵硬件。
代理工具用户：将本地模型与 Claude Code、Codex 等集成，构建自动化工作流。

en.tag: Local desktop app to run and train LLMs and diffusion models

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。

产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码
教育场景中教学前端开发，通过示例直观展示代码生成

en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.

Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: 本地私有、自进化的跨平台 AI 内容发现 Agent
zh.what: OpenBiliClaw 是一个纯本地运行的开源个性化内容推荐 Agent，它先通过你的跨平台行为、反馈与对话构建心理画像，再主动去各平台与开放 Web 寻找你可能感兴趣的内容。它强调隐私与私有化，所有理解与推荐都在你自己的机器上完成。

en.tag: Local-first, self-evolving cross-platform AI content discovery agent
en.what: OpenBiliClaw is a fully local, open-source personalized content discovery agent that builds a psychological profile from your cross-platform behavior, feedback and conversations, then proactively hunts for content you may like. It emphasizes privacy and local-first operation, with all understanding and recommendation happening on your own machine.

en.stack: Main language is Python 3.11+ under MIT license, leveraging the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem, with a Chrome extension and Flutter mobile client.
en.hot: It gained 1,626 stars this month (3,278 total), ranking 23rd on GitHub Trending monthly for Python, reflecting strong demand for privacy-first, cross-platform personalized recommendation tools.

Privacy-conscious tech enthusiasts who require local data storage and processing
Developers who need to customize content discovery flows for specific domains (e.g., tech, anime)
Users who want to integrate personalized recommendation into agent workflows like DeepSeek Harness

zh.tag: 把人的思维方式蒸馏成 Agent 可复用的技能档案
zh.what: Distilly 是一个本地优先的工具，用于将一个人的原始材料、工作习惯、判断力和表达风格转化为带版本管理的“Agent 人物档案”。这些档案可以在运行期间临时调用，也可以作为长期的主机技能安装，存储权始终保留在本地，无需额外的模型 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、插件系统以及多个主机兼容层（如 Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes）。默认分支为 distilly-plugin，提供开发者预览版，包含五个 MCP 工具，并支持多语言文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，要求 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，构建后通过 CLI 与 MCP 协议集成到 Codex 等宿主。

对本地优先、数据自主可控的 AI 工具链感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: Distill how people think into reusable Skills for any Agent or Bot
en.what: Distilly is a local-first tool that turns a person's source material, working habits, judgment, and voice into a versioned 'Person Profile for Agents'. The profile can be recalled temporarily during a run or installed as a long-lived host Skill, with storage authority staying local and no extra model API key required.

en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js 22.19+ or 24, uses pnpm for dependencies, and integrates with hosts like Codex via CLI and MCP protocol.
en.hot: With 24k+ stars and 3,741 added this month, it's hot for its novel concept of distilling personal knowledge into Agent skills, plus local-first design and no extra API key needed.

AI application builders who need to create customized agent behavior profiles for teams or clients
Tech enthusiasts interested in local-first, data-sovereign AI toolchains

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关

自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.

en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.

Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 开源终端编码代理，兼容任意 LLM 后端

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
