zh.tag: 高性能响应式 UI 库，无虚拟 DOM
zh.what: Solid 是一个声明式 JavaScript 库，用于构建用户界面。它不使用虚拟 DOM，而是将模板编译为真实 DOM 节点，并通过细粒度的响应式更新来高效管理状态变化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 solid-js 的源代码、文档、示例和测试。主要提供响应式原语（如 createSignal）、渲染器以及 JSX 编译支持。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 JSX 和现代 JavaScript 特性，支持浏览器和服务器端渲染。
zh.hot: Solid 以其卓越的性能和细粒度响应式著称，star 数高达 35.9k，本月新增 208，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 适合追求极致性能、希望避免虚拟 DOM 开销的前端开发者
适用于需要高效更新复杂界面的单页应用或交互组件
适合喜欢响应式编程范式、熟悉 React 但想尝试新思路的团队

en.tag: High-performance reactive UI library without Virtual DOM
en.what: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Instead of using a Virtual DOM, it compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, docs, examples, and tests for the core library solid-js. It provides reactive primitives (like createSignal), a renderer, and JSX compilation support.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, relies on JSX and modern JavaScript features, supports browser and server-side rendering.
en.hot: Solid is renowned for its excellent performance and fine-grained reactivity, with 35.9k stars and 208 added this month, continuously attracting developers.
uses: For frontend developers seeking top performance and avoiding Virtual DOM overhead
For building single-page apps or interactive components with efficient updates
For teams familiar with React but interested in a reactive paradigm without Virtual DOM

zh.tag: 插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
zh.what: MusicFree 是一款插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，目前支持 Android 和 Harmony OS。它本身不集成任何音源，所有搜索、播放、歌单导入等功能均通过插件实现，用户可自由安装第三方插件来扩展功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含播放器的完整源代码，采用 TypeScript 编写，包含 UI 组件、播放核心、插件管理模块等。同时提供插件开发文档和示例插件，方便开发者二次开发。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源。依赖包括 React Native 或类似跨平台框架（根据项目结构推测），以及用于插件加载的 CommonJS 模块系统。
zh.hot: 凭借插件化设计实现高度定制和无广告体验，吸引了大量用户。本月新增 802 个 star，总 star 数达 26643，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（TypeScript）第 14 名，反映出社区对自由音乐播放器的强烈需求。
uses: 适合追求无广告、可定制音乐播放体验的 Android 或 Harmony OS 用户。
适合希望自行控制音源、通过插件扩展功能的音乐爱好者。
适合对音乐播放器开发感兴趣的开发者，可参考其插件架构。

en.tag: A plugin-based, ad-free, free music player
en.what: MusicFree is a plugin-based, customizable, ad-free free music player that currently supports Android and Harmony OS. It does not integrate any music sources itself; all functions like search, playback, and playlist import are implemented via plugins, allowing users to freely install third-party plugins to extend functionality.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the player, written in TypeScript, including UI components, playback core, plugin management modules, etc. It also provides plugin development documentation and example plugins for developers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, open-sourced under AGPL 3.0. Dependencies include a cross-platform framework like React Native (inferred from project structure), and CommonJS module system for plugin loading.
en.hot: With its plugin-based design enabling high customization and ad-free experience, it has attracted many users. Gaining 802 stars this month, reaching 26,643 total, and ranking 14th on GitHub Trending monthly (TypeScript), reflecting strong community demand for a free music player.
uses: Ideal for Android or Harmony OS users seeking an ad-free, customizable music playback experience.
Suitable for music enthusiasts who want to control their music sources and extend functionality via plugins.
Great for developers interested in music player development, offering insights into plugin architecture.

zh.tag: 浏览器内高性能 LLM 推理引擎，基于 WebGPU 硬件加速
zh.what: WebLLM 把大语言模型推理直接搬到浏览器里，全程无需服务器，依靠 WebGPU 做硬件加速。它完全兼容 OpenAI API，因此可以在本地用同一套接口调用任意开源模型，支持流式输出、JSON 模式和函数调用等能力。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现的 npm 包 @mlc-ai/web-llm 为核心，包含引擎源码、示例（examples）与文档，并配套 WebLLM Chat 演示站和 MLC LLM 底层项目。
zh.stack: 主要用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 WebGPU 做 GPU 加速，模型编译与 JSON 结构化生成由 WebAssembly 部分承担，并复用 MLC LLM 的编译产物。
zh.hot: 凭借“浏览器里跑大模型、数据不出本地”的隐私与零服务器成本卖点，加上 OpenAI API 兼容，本月新增 572 star，累计 19093，登上 TypeScript 月榜第 13 名。
uses: 想给网页应用加本地 AI 助手、又不想自建推理服务器的前端开发者
对数据隐私敏感、希望模型推理完全在用户设备上完成的团队
想用 OpenAI API 风格接口快速试验开源模型的工程师
研究 WebGPU 与浏览器端推理性能的开发者

en.tag: High-performance in-browser LLM inference engine powered by WebGPU
en.what: WebLLM brings LLM inference directly into the browser with no server support, accelerated by WebGPU. It is fully compatible with the OpenAI API, so you can run any open-source model locally with streaming, JSON mode, and function calling.
en.content: The repo centers on the TypeScript npm package @mlc-ai/web-llm, including engine source, examples, and docs, alongside the WebLLM Chat demo and the companion MLC LLM project.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript, it relies on WebGPU for GPU acceleration, uses WebAssembly for model compilation and structured JSON generation, and reuses MLC LLM build artifacts.
en.hot: Its pitch of running LLMs in-browser with local privacy and zero server cost, plus OpenAI API compatibility, drove 572 new stars this month to 19,093 total, ranking 13th on the TypeScript monthly trending list.
uses: Frontend developers adding local AI assistants to web apps without hosting inference servers
Teams with strict privacy needs who want inference to stay entirely on the user's device
Engineers prototyping open-source models with an OpenAI-style API
Developers studying WebGPU and in-browser inference performance

zh.tag: 用稳定命名本地URL替代端口号，面向开发者和AI代理
zh.what: Portless 是一个开发工具，让你用像 https://myapp.localhost 这样的稳定命名 URL 替代 localhost:3000 之类的端口号。它自动管理 HTTPS、端口分配和代理，简化本地开发体验，尤其适合人类和 AI 代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个命令行工具，通过全局或项目依赖安装。它生成本地 CA、绑定 443 端口并启动代理，自动将命名 URL 路由到分配的端口，支持多种框架和配置选项。
zh.stack: 主要用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 生态，通过 npm 分发。涉及 HTTPS/HTTP2、代理、进程管理等技术。
zh.hot: 今日新增 450 星，总星数 12052，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了开发中端口记忆和冲突的痛点，并迎合了 AI 代理对稳定 URL 的需求。
uses: 本地开发人员：告别端口号，使用易记的命名 URL 访问多个项目。
AI 代理开发者：为代理提供稳定的本地端点，便于自动化测试和交互。
团队协作：统一开发环境，减少端口冲突和配置问题。

en.tag: Replace port numbers with stable named local URLs for dev and agents
en.what: Portless is a dev tool that replaces port numbers with stable named URLs like https://myapp.localhost. It automatically handles HTTPS, port assignment, and proxying, simplifying local development for both humans and AI agents.
en.content: The repo contains a CLI tool installable globally or as a project dependency. It generates a local CA, binds port 443, and starts a proxy that routes named URLs to assigned ports, with support for many frameworks and configuration options.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, distributed via npm, leveraging Node.js ecosystem. Involves HTTPS/HTTP2, proxying, and process management.
en.hot: Gained 450 stars today, total 12052, trending on GitHub. It solves the pain of remembering and conflicting ports, and caters to AI agents needing stable URLs.
uses: Local developers: replace port numbers with memorable named URLs for multiple projects.
AI agent developers: provide stable local endpoints for agents to automate testing and interaction.
Team collaboration: unify dev environment, reduce port conflicts and configuration issues.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理轻松调用上万网页抓取工具的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: Apify MCP 服务器是一个中间层，将 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor）与 Apify Store 上数千个现成的爬虫和自动化工具连接起来。它支持通过 OAuth 从 Claude.ai 或 VS Code 等客户端直接连接，并支持流式 HTTP 传输。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器的 TypeScript 源码、文档、配置示例，以及指向托管服务 mcp.apify.com 的说明。还支持代理支付（agentic payments）和多种客户端集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK，支持 OAuth 和流式 HTTP。依赖 Apify 平台及其 Actor 生态系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3473 星，总星数达 6086，跻身 TypeScript 趋势榜第 16 名。AI 代理需要实时网页数据，而 Apify 提供了现成的抓取工具，正好满足需求。
uses: 开发者想要为 AI 代理添加网页数据抓取能力，无需自己编写爬虫。
使用 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端的用户，需要从社交媒体、电商等网站提取结构化数据。
需要自动化数据采集流程，并希望与 AI 工作流集成的团队。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI agents to use thousands of web scrapers via Apify
en.what: The Apify MCP server is a middleware that connects AI agents (like Claude, Cursor) to thousands of ready-made scrapers and automation tools on Apify Store. It supports OAuth for connecting from clients like Claude.ai or VS Code, and uses Streamable HTTP transport.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source code, docs, config examples, and instructions for the hosted service at mcp.apify.com. It also supports agentic payments and integration with various MCP clients.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK, supports OAuth and Streamable HTTP. Depends on the Apify platform and its Actor ecosystem.
en.hot: Gained 3473 stars this month, reaching 6086 total, ranking #16 on TypeScript trending. AI agents need real-time web data, and Apify offers ready-made scrapers, perfectly meeting the demand.
uses: Developers who want to add web scraping capabilities to AI agents without writing crawlers themselves.
Users of MCP clients like Claude or Cursor who need structured data from social media, e-commerce, etc.
Teams that need to automate data collection and integrate it with AI workflows.

zh.tag: 开源可自托管的互联网计算机，把文件、应用与游戏装进浏览器
zh.what: Puter 是一个开源、可自托管的「互联网计算机」，目标是让用户在任何设备、任何时间通过浏览器访问自己的文件、应用和游戏。它同时面向普通用户提供记事本、录音、表格、相机等一体化应用，也面向开发者提供 AI、云存储、数据库、无服务器 Worker 等能力。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 编写，包含前端界面、后端服务与自托管部署脚本，并提供本地开发与一键安装方式；同时配套 App Store、开发者文档与多个独立小应用站点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 与 Node.js，npm 管理依赖，支持 Linux/macOS/Windows 自托管部署，并集成 AI、对象存储、键值数据库与无服务器 Worker 等后端能力。
zh.hot: 凭借「开源版个人云电脑」的清晰定位和可自托管特性，Puter 已积累 43502 颗星，本月新增 567 星，位列 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 19 名，持续吸引关注隐私与数据自主的用户和开发者。
uses: 希望把文件、应用和游戏集中到浏览器、追求数据自主的个人用户
想自托管私有云桌面或内部应用门户的团队与运维人员
需要 AI、存储、数据库与无服务器能力来开发和发布 Web 应用的开发者
关注开源云操作系统与 AGPL 项目的技术研究者

en.tag: An open-source, self-hostable internet computer that puts files, apps, and games in your browser
en.what: Puter is an open-source, self-hostable "internet computer" that aims to give users access to their files, apps, and games from any device at any time through the browser. It serves everyday users with built-in apps like Notepad, Voice Recorder, Spreadsheet, and Camera, while offering developers AI, cloud storage, database, and serverless worker capabilities.
en.content: The repo is written in TypeScript and contains the frontend UI, backend services, and self-hosting scripts, with both local development and one-line install paths; it also links to an App Store, developer docs, and several standalone mini-app sites.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript and Node.js with npm for dependencies, supporting self-hosting on Linux/macOS/Windows, and integrating backend features such as AI, object storage, key-value database, and serverless workers.
en.hot: With its clear pitch as an open-source personal cloud computer and self-hostable design, Puter has reached 43,502 stars, adding 567 this month and ranking 19th on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list, drawing users and developers who care about privacy and data ownership.
uses: Individuals who want files, apps, and games in one browser-based space with data ownership
Teams and ops staff looking to self-host a private cloud desktop or internal app portal
Developers needing AI, storage, database, and serverless capabilities to build and publish web apps
Researchers interested in open-source cloud OS projects under AGPL

zh.tag: TypeScript 生产级应用的全能效应系统框架
zh.what: Effect 是一个用于构建健壮、可维护、类型安全且生产级 TypeScript 应用的库。它帮助开发者处理规模化场景下的难题：类型化错误、依赖注入、结构化并发、调度、追踪以及统一的 Schema 校验。
zh.content: 这是一个 monorepo，核心是 effect 包，并包含大量集成包：浏览器/Bun/Deno/Node 平台服务、ClickHouse 与 Cloudflare D1 等 SQL 客户端。目前 main 分支为 v4 开发版，v3 源码保留在 v3 分支。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，要求 TypeScript 5.9+（推荐 7）并开启 strict 严格模式，Node.js 18+ 为通用最低要求，部分集成包需要更新运行时。
zh.hot: 凭借对类型化错误、依赖注入、结构化并发等企业级痛点的系统性解法，Effect 已积累约 1.6 万 star，本月新增 771，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 需要构建大型、长期维护的 TypeScript 后端服务的团队
希望用统一范式处理错误、并发、依赖注入与可观测性的开发者
正在评估 Effect v4 RC 并计划迁移的现有 v3 用户

en.tag: A full-featured effect system for production-grade TypeScript apps
en.what: Effect is a library for building robust, maintainable, type-safe, and production-grade applications in TypeScript. It helps you handle hard problems at scale: typed errors, dependency injection, structured concurrency, scheduling, tracing, and unified schema validation.
en.content: This monorepo contains the core effect package plus many integration packages: platform services for browser/Bun/Deno/Node, and SQL clients such as ClickHouse and Cloudflare D1. The main branch hosts v4 development, while v3 source lives on the v3 branch.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, it requires TypeScript 5.9+ (7 recommended) with strict mode enabled, and Node.js 18+ as the general minimum; some integration packages need newer runtimes.
en.hot: With a systematic solution to enterprise pain points like typed errors, dependency injection, and structured concurrency, Effect has reached ~16k stars, adding 771 this month and ranking 18th on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list.
uses: Teams building large, long-lived TypeScript backend services
Developers wanting one unified paradigm for errors, concurrency, DI, and observability
Existing v3 users evaluating the Effect v4 RC and planning a migration

zh.tag: 人生进阶与英语学习开放指南
zh.what: 这是一份从英语学习出发，写给普通人持续成长、重新掌握人生主动权的开放指南。它涵盖了英语学习系统、AI学习方法以及人生复盘样本，帮助用户建立长期训练系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含英语学习主线（认知、单词、听力、阅读、口语、写作）、AI学习与能力升级方法、人生复盘与创业故事，以及长期主义资源如词表和英文材料。
zh.stack: 基于JavaScript，主要使用Markdown文档组织内容，依赖GitHub Pages或静态站点部署。
zh.hot: 拥有56318颗星，今日新增103颗，因其全面的英语学习指南和人生进阶内容吸引了大量学习者，长期占据GitHub热门榜。
uses: 英语学习者——系统提升听说读写能力，建立长期训练系统
AI工具使用者——学习如何将ChatGPT、Gemini等融入学习流程
人生复盘者——从创业、失败、低谷恢复的真实故事中获取启发
长期主义者——寻找可执行的成长路线图和资源库

en.tag: An open guide to life advancement and English learning
en.what: An open guide starting from English learning, aimed at helping ordinary people grow continuously and regain control of their lives. It covers an English learning system, AI learning methods, and a life review sample.
en.content: The repo includes an English learning thread (cognition, vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing), AI learning and skill upgrade methods, life review and entrepreneurship stories, and long-term resources like word lists and English materials.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, primarily organized as Markdown documents, deployable via GitHub Pages or static site generators.
en.hot: With 56,318 stars and 103 new stars today, it attracts learners with its comprehensive English learning guide and life advancement content, consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: English learners — systematically improve listening, speaking, reading, writing, and build a long-term training system
AI tool users — learn to integrate ChatGPT, Gemini, etc. into learning workflows
Life reviewers — gain inspiration from real stories of entrepreneurship, failure, and recovery
Long-termists — find actionable growth roadmaps and resource repositories

zh.tag: 为AI代理设计的极速共享浏览器，零配置
zh.what: ego lite 是一款专为 AI 代理设计的浏览器，允许用户和 AI 代理并行工作。代理可以在独立空间中运行多个浏览器任务，同时用户保留自己的标签页，且无需额外配置即可共享登录状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 macOS 应用安装包（Apple Silicon 和 Intel）、文档链接、Discord 社区、X 账号以及演示视频。核心功能是通过 `ego-browser` 技能让代理访问真实登录状态和标签页。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，基于浏览器技术构建，支持 macOS 平台，Windows 和 Linux 在路线图中。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2288 星，总星数 11863，因解决 AI 浏览器自动化中登录状态共享的痛点而迅速走红。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理执行浏览器任务并访问真实登录状态。
自动化测试工程师：希望在不干扰用户标签页的情况下并行运行测试。
个人用户：想用 AI 代理处理日常网页操作，同时保留自己的浏览会话。

en.tag: Fastest shared browser for AI agents, zero config
en.what: ego lite is a browser designed for AI agents to run browser automation in parallel with users. Agents operate in their own Spaces, while users keep their tabs, and logins are shared seamlessly without extra setup.
en.content: The repo provides macOS app downloads (Apple Silicon and Intel), docs, Discord, X handle, and demo video. Core feature is the `ego-browser` skill enabling agents to access real logins and tabs.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, leveraging browser technologies, currently supports macOS, with Windows and Linux on roadmap.
en.hot: Gained 2288 stars this week, total 11863, popular for solving login-sharing pain in AI browser automation.
uses: AI agent developers: need agents to run browser tasks with real logins.
Automation testers: want parallel test runs without disturbing user tabs.
Personal users: want AI agents to handle web tasks while keeping their own session.

zh.tag: 模块化 SenseNova 技能，构建 AI 办公助手与生产力工作流
zh.what: 该仓库提供一系列模块化的 SenseNova 技能，用于构建 AI 驱动的办公助手和生产力工作流。每个技能独立成目录，通过 SKILL.md 声明触发条件、能力和执行流程，遵循 Agent Skills 约定。技能涵盖图像生成与可视化、PPT 生成、Excel 数据分析、深度研究等，可单独使用或组合成端到端工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能目录，每个目录有 SKILL.md 定义元数据，还有文档示例（如 sn-infographic Gallery 展示近 100 个生成案例）和集成说明。技能可直接在 Raccoon 平台开箱使用。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，依赖 SenseNova 模型（如 SenseNova 6.7 Flash 和 U1），遵循 Agent Skills 标准，可接入 OpenClaw 和 hermes-agent 等代理运行时。
zh.hot: 本月新增 623 星，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）第 19 名。其模块化技能设计降低了构建 AI 办公助手的门槛，且提供免费试用的 Raccoon 平台，吸引开发者快速体验。
uses: 希望快速为办公场景（如 PPT、Excel、研究）集成 AI 能力的开发者
需要构建自定义 AI 助手或工作流的团队，可复用现成技能模块
对 SenseNova 模型感兴趣的 AI 应用开发者，可参考技能实现

en.tag: Modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows
en.what: This repository provides a set of modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows. Each skill lives in its own directory and declares triggers, capabilities, and execution flow via a SKILL.md file, following the Agent Skills convention. Skills cover image generation & visualization, slide-deck (PPT) generation, Excel data analysis, and deep research, usable standalone or composed into end-to-end workflows.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill directories, each with a SKILL.md defining metadata, plus documentation examples (like the sn-infographic Gallery showcasing nearly 100 generation cases) and integration guides. Skills are available out-of-the-box in the Raccoon platform.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, leveraging SenseNova models (e.g., SenseNova 6.7 Flash and U1), following the Agent Skills standard, and integrating with agent runtimes like OpenClaw and hermes-agent.
en.hot: Gained 623 stars this month, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). Its modular skill design lowers the barrier to building AI office assistants, and the free-trial Raccoon platform attracts developers to try it quickly.
uses: Developers who want to quickly integrate AI capabilities into office scenarios like PPT, Excel, and research
Teams building custom AI assistants or workflows, who can reuse ready-made skill modules
AI application developers interested in SenseNova models, who can reference the skill implementations

zh.tag: 跨平台全能终端与远程连接客户端
zh.what: electerm 是一个免费开源的终端与远程连接客户端，集成了 SSH、SFTP、FTP、Telnet、串口、RDP、VNC、Spice 等多种协议。它覆盖 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、HarmonyOS、iOS 等主流及国产操作系统，让用户用一个工具管理所有远程会话。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面与移动端应用源码、构建脚本、多语言文档（中/英/日）、主题系统，以及配套的 Web 版、Android 版、HarmonyOS 版和 Docker 部署方案。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Electron 构建，前端采用 React 等现代 Web 技术，依赖 Node.js 生态，并通过多平台打包工具发布到各应用商店。
zh.hot: 凭借 15082 颗星和本月 418 的新增，electerm 登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 JavaScript 第 9 名，其跨平台、多协议、支持国产系统的特性深受运维和开发者欢迎。
uses: 运维工程师和系统管理员，需要统一管理多台服务器的 SSH/SFTP 连接
开发者，希望在本地终端中快速切换远程会话和文件传输
使用国产操作系统（统信 UOS、麒麟、龙芯）的用户，寻找兼容的远程客户端
需要 RDP/VNC/串口等混合协议连接的网络与硬件工程师

en.tag: Cross-platform all-in-one terminal and remote connection client
en.what: electerm is a free, open-source terminal and remote connection client that bundles SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice protocols in one app. It runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, HarmonyOS, and iOS, letting users manage all remote sessions from a single tool.
en.content: The repo contains full desktop and mobile app source code, build scripts, multilingual docs (Chinese/English/Japanese), a theme system, plus companion web, Android, HarmonyOS, and Docker deployment options.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台
zh.what: NautilusTrader 是一个基于 Rust 的高性能量化交易平台，采用确定性事件驱动架构，专为生产环境设计。它提供低延迟、高吞吐量的交易执行和回测能力，同时支持 Python 接口，便于策略开发和集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心交易引擎、回测模块、市场数据适配器、策略框架以及多种交易所连接器。代码主要用 Rust 编写，同时提供 Python 绑定，包含完整的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.12-3.14，兼容 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。依赖包括 PyO3 用于 Python 绑定，以及 Arrow 等用于数据处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 25.9k 星标和今日新增 120 星，NautilusTrader 因其生产级 Rust 性能、确定性架构和活跃社区而备受关注，成为量化交易领域的热门选择。
uses: 量化交易员和算法工程师：用于构建低延迟交易策略和执行系统。
金融科技公司：作为交易基础设施的核心组件，支持回测和实盘交易。
研究人员：利用其高性能回测引擎进行策略研究和数据分析。
开发者：通过 Python API 快速原型设计，或使用 Rust 进行深度定制。

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading platform
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture, designed for production use. It offers low-latency, high-throughput execution and backtesting capabilities, with a Python API for strategy development and integration.
en.content: The repository contains the core trading engine, backtesting module, market data adapters, strategy framework, and various exchange connectors. The code is primarily in Rust with Python bindings, including comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings for 3.12-3.14, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Dependencies include PyO3 for Python bindings and Arrow for data handling.
en.hot: With 25.9k stars and 120 new stars today, NautilusTrader gains attention for its production-grade Rust performance, deterministic architecture, and active community, making it a popular choice in algorithmic trading.
uses: Quant traders and algo engineers: for building low-latency trading strategies and execution systems.
Fintech companies: as a core component of trading infrastructure for backtesting and live trading.
Researchers: leveraging its high-performance backtesting engine for strategy research and data analysis.
Developers: rapid prototyping via Python API or deep customization with Rust.

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全快速 microVM 虚拟化技术
zh.what: Firecracker 是 AWS 开源的轻量级虚拟化技术，用 microVM 运行容器与函数负载，兼具硬件虚拟化的安全隔离性和容器的速度与灵活性。它通过极简设计的 VMM 调用 Linux KVM 创建 microVM，大幅缩小内存占用与攻击面。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Rust 编写的 VMM 实现，另含设备模型、API 服务、测试框架与文档（如快速上手、生产主机配置、CHARTER 章程），并提供发布版二进制。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，依赖 Linux KVM 与内核特性，构建通过 Docker 开发容器和 bash 脚本（devtool）完成，支持 musl 静态链接。
zh.hot: 作为 AWS Lambda 与 Fargate 的底层虚拟化引擎，Firecracker 是 serverless 基础设施的关键组件，本月新增 705 star、总量 36662，稳居 Rust 月榜第 10。
uses: 云平台与 serverless 服务商，需要安全多租户的轻量隔离
容器运行时开发者，如 Kata Containers、Flintlock 集成场景
对启动速度与资源开销敏感的边缘计算或函数计算团队
研究虚拟化、VMM 与系统安全的 Rust 开发者

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs purpose-built for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology from AWS that runs container and function workloads inside lightweight microVMs, combining hardware-virtualization isolation with container-like speed. Its minimalist VMM uses Linux KVM to cut memory footprint and attack surface.
en.content: The repo centers on a Rust-based VMM implementation, plus device models, an API server, test frameworks, and docs (quickstart, production host setup, CHARTER), with release binaries published.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it relies on Linux KVM and kernel features, builds via a Docker dev container and bash devtool scripts, and supports musl static linking.
en.hot: As the virtualization engine behind AWS Lambda and Fargate, Firecracker is a cornerstone of serverless infrastructure; it gained 705 stars this month to reach 36,662, ranking 10th on the Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Cloud and serverless providers needing secure multi-tenant lightweight isolation
Container runtime developers integrating with Kata Containers or Flintlock
Edge or function-computing teams sensitive to startup time and resource overhead
Rust developers studying virtualization, VMMs, and system security

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖访问控制，并具有确定性的锁文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本，以及一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，并包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其卓越的性能和磁盘效率而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有 36,310 颗星，并持续获得关注。其 Rust 移植版本也吸引了开发者的兴趣。
uses: 适用于大型 monorepo 项目，可显著减少依赖安装时间和磁盘占用。
适合对包管理性能有严格要求的开发团队，尤其是 CI/CD 环境。
适合希望使用严格依赖隔离和确定性锁文件的 Node.js 开发者。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, enforces strict dependency access, and provides deterministic lockfiles.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmark scripts, and an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript/TypeScript with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on Node.js ecosystem, supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its superior performance and disk efficiency, with 36,310 stars on GitHub and ongoing attention. Its Rust port also attracts developers.
uses: Ideal for large monorepo projects, significantly reducing install time and disk usage.
Suitable for teams with strict performance requirements, especially in CI/CD environments.
Great for Node.js developers who want strict dependency isolation and deterministic lockfiles.

zh.tag: 友好且类型安全的可扩展系统编程语言
zh.what: Gleam 是一门静态类型编程语言，旨在构建类型安全且可扩展的系统。它编译到 Erlang 和 JavaScript，让开发者能利用 BEAM 虚拟机的并发与容错能力，或在前端/Node.js 环境中运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Gleam 编译器的 Rust 源代码、标准库、构建工具以及文档和示例。主要目录有 compiler-core（编译器核心）、compiler-cli（命令行工具）和 test 等。
zh.stack: Gleam 编译器使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Rust 生态的库如 serde、clap 等。运行时目标为 Erlang/OTP 和 JavaScript，因此需要相应的运行时环境。
zh.hot: Gleam 因其友好的错误信息、强大的类型系统和多目标编译能力而受到关注，本月新增 194 颗星，总星数达 21894，在 GitHub Trending 月榜（Rust）中排名第 15。
uses: 希望构建高并发、容错后端系统的开发者，可利用 Erlang 生态。
需要类型安全且能编译到 JavaScript 的前端或全栈开发者。
对函数式编程和静态类型语言感兴趣的学习者与研究者。
寻求替代 TypeScript 或 Elixir 等语言的团队，用于构建可扩展应用。

en.tag: A friendly language for building type-safe, scalable systems
en.what: Gleam is a statically typed programming language designed for building type-safe and scalable systems. It compiles to Erlang and JavaScript, allowing developers to leverage the concurrency and fault-tolerance of the BEAM virtual machine or run in frontend/Node.js environments.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for the Gleam compiler, standard library, build tool, and documentation/examples. Key directories include compiler-core (compiler core), compiler-cli (CLI tool), and test.
en.stack: The Gleam compiler is written in Rust, depending on Rust ecosystem crates like serde and clap. Runtime targets are Erlang/OTP and JavaScript, requiring corresponding runtime environments.
en.hot: Gleam gains attention for its friendly error messages, powerful type system, and multi-target compilation. It added 194 stars this month, reaching 21,894 total stars, ranking 15th on GitHub Trending monthly (Rust).
uses: Developers building highly concurrent, fault-tolerant backend systems leveraging the Erlang ecosystem.
Frontend or full-stack developers needing type safety with JavaScript compilation.
Learners and researchers interested in functional programming and statically typed languages.
Teams seeking alternatives to TypeScript or Elixir for building scalable applications.

zh.tag: 零配置的终端 IDE，融合 VS Code 与 Sublime 的体验
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能全面的终端文本编辑器，主打零配置，提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，无需学习曲线。它专为处理超大文件而优化，性能卓越。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器核心代码、安装脚本、文档和演示 GIF，涵盖命令面板、多光标编辑、主题定制、LSP 支持、Orchestrator 多任务等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 协议实现，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 607 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 榜第 14 名。其零配置、易用性和高性能吸引了大量开发者，尤其是对终端编辑器感兴趣的用户。
uses: 适合喜欢在终端中工作但不想学习复杂快捷键的开发者，如 Vim/Emacs 新手。
需要处理超大文件（如日志文件）的开发者，Fresh 能高效加载。
希望获得 IDE 级功能（如 LSP、多光标）但偏好轻量级工具的用户。
对 Rust 和终端 UI 开发感兴趣的贡献者。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE blending VS Code & Sublime UX
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor with zero configuration, offering familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features without a learning curve. It is optimized for handling huge files with high performance.
en.content: The repository includes the editor's core code, installation scripts, documentation, and demo GIFs, featuring command palette, multi-cursor editing, themes, LSP support, and the Orchestrator for multitasking.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP protocol, cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 607 stars this month, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending Rust. Its zero-config, ease of use, and high performance attract developers, especially terminal editor enthusiasts.
uses: Developers who prefer terminal work but dislike steep learning curves, e.g., Vim/Emacs beginners.
Those handling huge files (e.g., logs) that need efficient loading.
Users wanting IDE-level features (LSP, multi-cursor) in a lightweight tool.
Contributors interested in Rust and terminal UI development.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 漫画翻译工具
zh.what: Koharu 是一个基于机器学习的漫画翻译工具，完全在本地运行，保护隐私。它集成了目标检测、OCR、图像修复和 LLM，实现从识别到翻译再到嵌字的自动化流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用，支持多格式项目管理、选择性处理管道、多模态 OCR、本地 GGUF 推理和托管服务、生成式修复、校对、WebGPU 画布、多语言排版以及分层 PSD 导出。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 WebGPU 进行画布渲染，集成 GGUF 格式的本地模型和外部 LLM 提供商，支持多种视觉模型和 OCR 引擎。
zh.hot: 本月新增 510 星，总星数达 5494，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 7。其本地优先、注重隐私的 AI 翻译特性吸引了大量漫画爱好者和开发者。
uses: 漫画翻译爱好者：希望本地自动化翻译漫画，保护隐私且无需上传图片。
独立汉化组：需要高效工具处理批量图片、PDF 和压缩包，并支持校对和排版。
Rust 开发者：对 ML 应用、OCR 和图像处理感兴趣的开发者可学习其架构。

en.tag: Local-first AI manga translator with ML pipeline
en.what: Koharu is an ML-powered manga translator that runs locally for privacy. It combines object detection, OCR, inpainting, and LLMs to automate the translation workflow.
en.content: The repo contains a full desktop app with multi-format project management, selective pipelines, multimodal OCR, local GGUF inference and hosted providers, generative inpainting, proofreading, WebGPU canvas, multilingual typesetting, and layered PSD export.
en.stack: Written in Rust, uses WebGPU for canvas rendering, integrates local GGUF models and external LLM providers, supports various vision models and OCR engines.
en.hot: Gained 510 stars this month, reaching 5494 total, ranking #7 on Rust trending. Its local-first, privacy-focused AI translation appeals to manga fans and developers.
uses: Manga translation enthusiasts who want private, local automated translation without uploading images.
Independent scanlation groups needing efficient batch processing of images, PDFs, and archives with proofreading and typesetting.
Rust developers interested in ML applications, OCR, and image processing can learn from its architecture.

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编程工具的 AI 技能统一管理桌面应用
zh.what: Skills Manager 是一个轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 代理的技能（skills），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 多种编程工具。它提供一个集中的技能库，用户可以从 Git 仓库、本地文件夹、压缩包或 skills.sh 市场安装技能，并支持全局、代理、项目等多种工作区。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架，依赖 Git 和文件系统操作，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本周新增 228 星，总星数达 4283，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 13 名。AI 编程工具激增，跨工具管理技能的需求旺盛，该应用填补了这一空白。
uses: AI 编程工具用户：统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的技能，避免重复配置。
开发者团队：通过备份与多设备同步，确保团队成员技能配置一致。
技能开发者：在市场中发布技能，并利用工作区测试和部署。

en.tag: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified skill library, allowing users to install skills from Git repos, local folders, archives, or the skills.sh marketplace, with support for global, agent, and project workspaces.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based desktop app source code, featuring a unified skill library, marketplace browsing, global/agent/project workspaces, backup and multi-device sync, along with UI screenshots and a concept map.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar framework, with dependencies on Git and file system operations, supporting cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 228 stars this week, reaching 4,283 total, and ranked #13 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly. With the proliferation of AI coding tools, the need to manage skills across tools is high, and this app fills that gap.
uses: AI coding tool users: centrally manage skills for Claude Code, Cursor, etc., avoiding duplicate configurations.
Development teams: ensure consistent skill configurations across members via backup and multi-device sync.
Skill developers: publish skills to the marketplace and use workspaces for testing and deployment.

zh.tag: 本地优先的跨平台个人 AI 超级智能体
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一款面向 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 的开源个人 AI，强调本地优先的记忆能力、智能体编排与深度研究。它把「记住一切的大脑」、编排器和研究员三合一，让个人数据留在本地。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 实现核心，包含 GitBook 文档目录（gitbooks/）与演示截图，并配有 Discord、Reddit、X 等社区入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，提供跨平台桌面应用；文档基于 GitBook，社区与分发依托 GitHub Discussions、Discord 与 Product Hunt。
zh.hot: 上线即获 Product Hunt 日榜/周榜 Top Post，GitHub 星标已达 39586，本月新增 3715，位列 Rust 月榜第 20 名，本地优先隐私叙事正好踩中当下热点。
uses: 希望把个人 AI 助手跑在本地、数据不出设备的隐私敏感用户
需要长期记忆与深度研究能力的知识工作者和研究者
想用 Rust 构建或扩展桌面 AI 智能体的开发者

en.tag: A local-first personal AI superintelligence for Mac, Windows and Linux
en.what: OpenHuman is an open source personal AI for Mac, Windows and Linux, built around local-first memory, agent orchestration and deep research. It combines a brain that remembers everything, an orchestrator and a deep researcher into one local-first assistant.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust core, a GitBook docs directory (gitbooks/) with demo screenshots, plus community links to Discord, Reddit and X.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust as a cross-platform desktop app; docs are built with GitBook, with community and distribution via GitHub Discussions, Discord and Product Hunt.
en.hot: It landed Product Hunt daily and weekly top-post badges, and has reached 39,586 stars with 3,715 added this month, ranking 20th on the Rust monthly trending list — its local-first privacy pitch rides today's wave.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want a personal AI assistant running locally with data kept on-device
Knowledge workers and researchers needing long-term memory and deep research capabilities
Developers who want to build or extend a desktop AI agent in Rust

zh.tag: 基于节点程序化引擎的开源 2D 图形创作工具
zh.what: Graphite 是一个免费开源的矢量与栅格图形引擎，提供完整的 2D 内容创作应用。它把图层合成与节点式生成设计结合，实现完全非破坏性的编辑工作流，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器前端、节点图核心引擎、矢量/栅格渲染模块以及官网与社区资源，整体更像一个游戏引擎而非传统创作软件。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，围绕自研节点图与渲染引擎构建，支持 Web 端编辑器运行。
zh.hot: 凭借 27,209 颗星（本月新增 445）登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 21 名，开源免费的定位与程序化设计理念吸引了大量设计师与开发者关注。
uses: 平面设计师与数字艺术家，寻找免费开源的非破坏性创作工具
程序化设计与动态图形爱好者，希望用节点图生成视觉内容
Rust 与图形引擎开发者，想研究或参与开源渲染项目
教育场景中教授矢量、栅格与节点式图形工作流

en.tag: Open-source 2D content creation app powered by a node-based procedural graphics engine
en.what: Graphite is a free, open-source vector and raster graphics engine offering a full 2D content creation app. It combines layer-based compositing with node-based generative design for a fully nondestructive editing workflow, currently in alpha.
en.content: The repo contains the editor frontend, the node-graph core engine, vector/raster rendering modules, plus website and community assets, structured more like a game engine than a conventional creative app.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, built around a custom node-graph and rendering engine, with a web-based editor.
en.hot: With 27,209 stars (445 added this month), it ranks 21st on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, drawing designers and developers with its free, open-source and procedural design approach.
uses: Graphic designers and digital artists seeking a free, open-source nondestructive tool
Procedural design and motion graphics enthusiasts wanting node-based visual generation
Rust and graphics engine developers interested in studying or contributing to an open-source renderer
Educators teaching vector, raster and node-based graphics workflows

zh.tag: 一个 CLI 统一管理开发工具、环境变量与任务
zh.what: mise 是一个用 Rust 编写的开发环境管理工具，把工具版本、环境变量和项目任务统一到一个 mise.toml 配置文件中。它让 shell、编辑器和 CI 使用完全一致的开发环境，避免版本漂移。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档站点（docs/）、工具注册表与插件系统，以及用于安装、任务运行、环境加载和机器初始化的各模块。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，发布在 crates.io，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows（winget），通过插件/注册表机制管理数百种开发工具。
zh.hot: 凭借 33,714 颗星和本月新增 1,594 星，mise 登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 18 名，反映出开发者对统一、可复现开发环境的强烈需求。
uses: 希望在不同项目间切换 Node、Python、Go 等工具版本的开发者
需要让本地、CI 与团队环境保持一致的工程团队
想用一份配置同时管理环境变量、任务和机器初始化的用户

en.tag: One CLI to manage dev tools, env vars, and tasks
en.what: mise is a Rust-based development environment manager that unifies tool versions, environment variables, and project tasks in a single mise.toml file. It keeps your shell, editor, and CI on the exact same setup, eliminating version drift.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, a docs site (docs/), the tool registry and plugin system, plus modules for installation, task running, environment loading, and machine bootstrap.
en.stack: Written in Rust and published on crates.io, it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows (winget), managing hundreds of dev tools via a plugin/registry system.
en.hot: With 33,714 stars and 1,594 added this month, mise ranks 18th on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for unified, reproducible dev environments.
uses: Developers switching between Node, Python, Go, and other tool versions across projects
Engineering teams needing consistent local, CI, and teammate environments
Users who want one config for env vars, tasks, and machine bootstrap

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-purchases 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式，并附带演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS developers needing ipa packages for testing or analysis
Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: 自托管聚合仪表盘，把订阅源集中一处
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量级、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，用于集中展示 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、天气、YouTube 等订阅源。它通过美观简洁的界面，让用户在一个页面中快速浏览所有信息流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务、YAML 配置文件示例、文档（配置、主题、预配置页面）、社区组件目录以及 Docker 部署支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖少量 JavaScript（原生），生成单一可执行文件（<20MB），支持多平台和 Docker 容器。
zh.hot: 凭借极低的资源占用、丰富的组件生态和高度可定制性，Glance 在自托管社区广受欢迎，目前已收获 36,682 颗星，今日新增 22 颗。
uses: 自托管爱好者：搭建个人信息中心，整合 RSS、新闻、天气等订阅源。
开发者和技术爱好者：监控 GitHub、Hacker News、Reddit 等技术社区动态。
追求效率的用户：通过自定义布局和主题，打造专属的极简仪表盘。

en.tag: Self-hosted dashboard aggregating all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates feeds like RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, weather, YouTube, and more. It presents all your information streams in a beautiful, streamlined interface for quick browsing.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, YAML configuration examples, documentation (configuration, themes, preconfigured pages), community widgets directory, and Docker deployment support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with minimal vanilla JavaScript, producing a single binary under 20MB for multiple OS/architectures, and a small Docker container.
en.hot: With its low resource usage, extensive widget ecosystem, and high customizability, Glance has gained popularity in the self-hosting community, amassing 36,682 stars with 22 added today.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: build a personal dashboard to aggregate RSS, news, weather, and more.
Developers and tech enthusiasts: monitor GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, and other tech communities.
Productivity-focused users: create a minimal, personalized dashboard with custom layouts and themes.

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，hub 基于 PocketBase，agent 独立运行。支持 Docker/Podman，可通过 Docker 镜像部署，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队，需要轻量级服务器监控且不想部署重量级方案
使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史
需要设置告警（如 CPU、内存、磁盘）并及时收到通知的运维人员
希望通过 OAuth 集成现有身份认证系统的企业用户

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container
Ops personnel who need to set alerts (e.g., CPU, memory, disk) and receive timely notifications
Enterprise users who want to integrate existing authentication via OAuth

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的多语言依赖漏洞扫描器，直连 OSV 数据库
zh.what: OSV-Scanner 是 Google 官方维护的开源漏洞扫描工具，用于发现项目依赖中已存在的安全漏洞。它把项目的依赖清单与 osv.dev 数据库中的漏洞信息进行匹配，并给出修复建议。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 主体、文档与示例，底层复用 OSV-Scalibr 库；支持语言、包管理器、操作系统包和容器镜像等多种扫描目标。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 开发，依赖 OSV-Scalibr 与 osv.dev 数据，提供命令行界面并集成 SLSA 3、OpenSSF Scorecard 等供应链安全实践。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方项目，它覆盖 10+ 语言与主流包管理器，本月新增 216 star、总计 1.1 万，登上 GitHub Go 月榜第 5，反映供应链安全需求持续升温。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 中扫描依赖漏洞，防止引入已知风险
安全团队批量审计多语言、多包管理器项目的依赖安全
运维人员检查 Linux 系统包与容器镜像的基础镜像漏洞
需要按严重程度和修复成本规划升级的工程团队

en.tag: Google's open-source dependency vulnerability scanner powered by the OSV database
en.what: OSV-Scanner is an officially supported open-source tool from Google that finds known vulnerabilities in your project's dependencies. It matches a project's dependency list against the osv.dev database and offers remediation guidance.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based CLI, documentation and examples, built on top of the OSV-Scalibr library; it supports scanning languages, package managers, OS packages and container images.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it relies on OSV-Scalibr and osv.dev data, ships a CLI, and follows supply-chain practices like SLSA 3 and OpenSSF Scorecard.
en.hot: As an official Google project covering 10+ languages and major package managers, it gained 216 stars this month for a total of 11k, ranking 5th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list amid rising supply-chain security demand.
uses: Developers scanning dependencies in CI/CD to avoid known risks
Security teams auditing multi-language, multi-package-manager projects
Ops engineers checking Linux OS packages and container base images
Engineering teams planning upgrades by severity and remediation cost

zh.tag: 自建私有搜索引擎，索引浏览记录与本地文件
zh.what: Hister 是一个注重隐私的搜索引擎，可以索引你访问过的网页和本地文件的内容，支持全文搜索。它提供 Web 界面、终端界面和 MCP 接口，方便你随时找回信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI（基于 Svelte）、浏览器扩展（Firefox/Chrome）以及终端客户端。支持多用户、语义搜索、爬虫和浏览器历史导入。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 CGO（需要 C 编译器），Web 前端使用 npm 和 Svelte。
zh.hot: 今日新增 142 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4。在隐私担忧加剧的背景下，自托管搜索引擎需求上升，Hister 提供完整功能且易于部署。
uses: 注重隐私的个人用户，希望本地搜索自己的浏览历史和文件。
团队或组织，需要内部文档和网页的私有搜索解决方案。
开发者，希望集成 MCP 到 AI 助手，实现个性化信息检索。

en.tag: Self-hosted private search engine for your browsing history and local files
en.what: Hister is a privacy-focused search engine that indexes the full content of pages you visit and files you keep, enabling full-text search. It offers web, terminal, and MCP interfaces for easy information retrieval.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend, a web UI (Svelte-based), browser extensions for Firefox/Chrome, and a terminal client. It supports multi-user, semantic search, crawler, and browser history import.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with CGO dependencies (requires C compiler), and npm/Svelte for the web frontend.
en.hot: Gained 142 stars today, ranking #4 on Go trending. Amid growing privacy concerns, self-hosted search engines are in demand, and Hister offers full features with easy deployment.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to search their browsing history and files locally.
Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

zh.tag: 现代跨平台任务运行器，Make 的 Go 替代品
zh.what: Task 是一个受 Make 启发的构建工具，专为现代工作流设计，提供简单易读的 YAML 语法来定义任务。它支持跨平台运行，无需依赖系统 shell，并内置文件监控、任务依赖和并行执行等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Task 的 Go 源码、命令行工具、文档网站源码（位于 website/ 目录）以及示例任务文件。核心是一个可执行二进制，通过 taskfile.yml 文件定义任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 minimal 第三方库，支持通过 Homebrew、Scoop、npm 等多种方式安装。
zh.hot: 作为 Make 的现代化替代品，Task 在开发者中持续流行，GitHub 上已有 16k+ star，本月新增 193，位列 Go 趋势榜第 19 名。其简洁的 YAML 配置和跨平台特性吸引了大量寻求更友好构建工具的用户。
uses: 个人开发者或团队希望用更直观的 YAML 替代复杂 Makefile 来管理项目任务
需要跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）一致运行构建脚本的 CI/CD 流程
希望通过任务依赖和并行执行优化开发工作流的全栈开发者

en.tag: A fast, cross-platform task runner as a modern Make alternative
en.what: Task is a build tool inspired by Make, designed for modern workflows with a simple YAML syntax to define tasks. It runs cross-platform without relying on system shells and includes features like file watching, task dependencies, and parallel execution.
en.content: The repository contains the Go source code, CLI tool, documentation website source (in website/), and example task files. The core is an executable binary that reads tasks from a taskfile.yml.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go with minimal third-party dependencies, installable via Homebrew, Scoop, npm, and more.
en.hot: As a modern alternative to Make, Task remains popular among developers, with 16k+ stars and 193 new stars this month, ranking 19th on GitHub's Go trending list. Its simple YAML config and cross-platform nature attract users seeking a friendlier build tool.
uses: Individual developers or teams wanting a more intuitive YAML alternative to complex Makefiles for managing project tasks
CI/CD pipelines that require consistent build script execution across Windows/macOS/Linux
Full-stack developers looking to optimize workflows with task dependencies and parallel execution

zh.tag: 开源 Linux 服务器管理面板，兼 AI 管理平台
zh.what: 1Panel 是一个现代开源的 Linux 服务器管理面板，提供直观的 Web 界面来管理服务器、网站、数据库、容器等。它还集成了轻量级 AI 管理功能，支持部署和管理 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的面板源码、文档（多语言）、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置等。主要目录包括 cmd、frontend、backend、docs 等。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端采用 Vue.js，依赖 Docker 和 Docker Compose 进行容器管理，支持多种数据库（如 MySQL、PostgreSQL）。
zh.hot: 1Panel 拥有超过 250 万自托管用户，GitHub 星标 36,831，本月新增 452，因其功能全面且易用而广受欢迎。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速管理多台 Linux 服务器，无需命令行操作。
需要部署和管理 Docker 容器、网站、数据库的系统管理员。
希望轻松运行 AI 应用或模型，并集成到服务器管理中的用户。
教育或学习用途，用于理解服务器管理面板的架构与实现。

en.tag: Open-source Linux server management panel with AI platform capabilities
en.what: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel offering an intuitive web interface to manage servers, websites, databases, containers, and more. It also integrates lightweight AI management features for deploying and managing AI applications.
en.content: The repository contains full panel source code, multi-language documentation, installation scripts, Docker image configurations, etc. Main directories include cmd, frontend, backend, docs.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, frontend uses Vue.js, relies on Docker and Docker Compose for container management, supports multiple databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).
en.hot: With over 2.5M self-hosters and 36,831 GitHub stars (452 added this month), 1Panel is popular for its comprehensive features and ease of use.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly manage multiple Linux servers without CLI operations.
System administrators needing to deploy and manage Docker containers, websites, and databases.
Users who want to easily run AI applications or models integrated into server management.
Educational or learning purposes to understand the architecture of a server management panel.

zh.tag: 自托管的开源任务管理器，数据完全自主掌控
zh.what: Vikunja 是一个功能全面的任务管理工具，支持看板、列表、表格等多种视图，以及团队协作、时间跟踪、文件附件等特性。它强调用户对数据的完全掌控，可自托管部署，也提供云端托管服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 应用、桌面客户端（Electron）以及移动端应用（通过 Flutter 实现），并提供完整的 API 文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 数据库；前端基于 Vue.js，桌面端使用 Electron，移动端使用 Flutter。
zh.hot: 本周新增 78 星，总星数 5258，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其自托管、数据自主的理念受到关注，且项目活跃，持续迭代。
uses: 个人用户希望完全掌控自己的任务数据，避免依赖第三方云服务
团队需要自建任务管理系统，并希望有看板、时间跟踪等高级功能
开发者想研究 Go 后端与前端分离的完整项目架构

en.tag: Self-hosted open-source task manager with full data ownership
en.what: Vikunja is a feature-rich task manager supporting kanban, list, table views, team collaboration, time tracking, file attachments, and more. It emphasizes full data ownership, allowing self-hosting or using the hosted cloud service.
en.content: The repository includes a backend service written in Go, a frontend web app, a desktop client (Electron), and mobile apps (via Flutter), along with comprehensive API docs and installation guides.
en.stack: Backend in Go with SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL support; frontend built with Vue.js; desktop via Electron; mobile via Flutter.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars this week, total 5258, ranking #19 on the Go weekly trending. Its self-hosting and data ownership philosophy attracts attention, with active development.
uses: Individuals who want full control over their task data without relying on third-party cloud services
Teams needing a self-hosted task management system with advanced features like kanban and time tracking
Developers interested in studying a full-stack project with Go backend and separate frontend

zh.tag: 专为 Kubernetes 打造的不可变安全 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Talos Linux 是一个专为运行 Kubernetes 而设计的现代 Linux 发行版，主打安全、不可变与极简。它没有 shell 和交互式控制台，所有系统管理都通过 API 完成，并使用双向 TLS（mTLS）认证保护访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Talos 操作系统的完整源码（Go 编写），涵盖内核配置、系统服务、API 接口、安装与升级工具，以及配套的文档与社区协作文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，深度集成 Kubernetes 与容器运行时，依赖 Linux 内核、mTLS 及不可变基础设施理念，采用原子更新机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 11143 颗星和本月新增 240 星登上 GitHub Go 月榜第 15 名，反映出社区对安全、可预测的 Kubernetes 底层操作系统的强烈需求。
uses: 运维与平台工程师：用于构建安全、不可变的 Kubernetes 节点

en.tag: A modern, immutable, secure Linux distribution built for Kubernetes
en.what: Talos Linux is a modern Linux distribution purpose-built for running Kubernetes, emphasizing security, immutability, and minimalism. It has no shell or interactive console; all system management is done via an API secured with mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication.
en.content: The repo contains the full source of the Talos OS written in Go, covering kernel configs, system services, the API layer, install/upgrade tooling, plus documentation and community files.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, deeply integrated with Kubernetes and container runtimes, relying on the Linux kernel, mTLS, and immutable-infrastructure principles with atomic updates.
en.hot: With 11,143 stars and 240 added this month, ranking 15th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list, it reflects strong community demand for a secure, predictable Kubernetes OS.
uses: DevOps and platform engineers building secure, immutable Kubernetes nodes
Enterprise IT teams needing to reduce config drift and simplify cluster upgrades
Security-sensitive environments wanting a smaller attack surface and API-driven host management
Kubernetes enthusiasts curious about a minimal OS with no shell

zh.tag: 跨平台开源备份工具，支持增量、端到端加密与去重
zh.what: Kopia 是一款快速、安全的开源备份/恢复工具，可对重要文件与目录创建加密快照，并保存到本地、网络存储或云端。它不做整机镜像，而是让你自由选择要备份的数据，同时提供 CLI 与 GUI 两种界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心备份引擎、CLI 与 GUI 客户端、Docker 镜像构建、文档站点以及完整的测试与 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 生态的存储与加密库，支持 Docker 部署，并通过 GitHub Actions 进行构建与测试。
zh.hot: 凭借 14082 颗星与本月新增 273 星登上 Go 月榜第 20 名，其端到端加密、去重与跨平台特性正好切中自托管备份需求。
uses: 需要为个人电脑或服务器做加密增量备份的自托管用户
希望用 CLI 或 GUI 管理云端/网络存储快照的运维人员
关注数据去重、压缩与端到端加密的隐私敏感型用户
想集成备份能力到自有系统的 Go 开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source backup tool with incremental, E2E-encrypted, deduplicated snapshots
en.what: Kopia is a fast, secure open-source backup/restore tool that creates encrypted snapshots of the files and directories you care about and stores them locally, on network storage, or in the cloud. Instead of imaging your whole machine, it lets you pick what to protect, and ships with both CLI and GUI.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based backup engine, CLI and GUI clients, Docker image builds, documentation site, and full test/CI configuration.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it relies on Go storage and crypto libraries, supports Docker deployment, and uses GitHub Actions for build and testing.
en.hot: With 14,082 stars and 273 added this month, it ranks 20th on the monthly Go trending list, as its E2E encryption, deduplication, and cross-platform support hit the self-hosted backup need.
uses: Self-hosters who need encrypted incremental backups for PCs or servers
Ops engineers managing cloud or NAS snapshots via CLI or GUI
Privacy-conscious users who value deduplication, compression, and E2E encryption
Go developers looking to integrate backup capabilities into their own systems

zh.tag: 把多家 AI 订阅额度统一转成 API 的中转网关
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，把 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅账号统一接入成标准 API 接口。它支持多人拼车共享订阅额度，让原生客户端工具无缝调用，从而更高效地分摊使用成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端服务、Vue 管理面板，以及 Docker 部署配置和 logo、赞助商等资源文件，并附中英日多语言 README。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 1.27，前端为 Vue 3.4+，数据层依赖 PostgreSQL 15+ 与 Redis 7+，并提供 Docker 一键部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.1 万 star、日增 136 并登上 GitHub Go 日榜第 4，它切中了订阅额度共享与统一接入的真实痛点，因此持续走热。
uses: 想用一份订阅额度供多人或团队共享的开发者
需要把多家模型统一成 OpenAI 兼容接口的自建网关用户
希望用 Claude Code、Codex 等原生工具低成本接入的工程师
研究 AI API 中转与配额分发架构的技术学习者

en.tag: An open-source gateway that turns multi-vendor AI subscriptions into unified APIs
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway that unifies Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok subscription accounts behind standard API endpoints. It supports shared/carpool quota distribution so native client tools work seamlessly while splitting costs more efficiently.
en.content: The repo ships a Go backend service, a Vue admin panel, Docker deployment configs, plus logo and sponsor assets, with READMEs in Chinese, English and Japanese.
en.stack: Backend is Go 1.27, frontend is Vue 3.4+, with PostgreSQL 15+ and Redis 7+ for data, and Docker-ready deployment.
en.hot: With 41k stars, +136 today and a #4 spot on the GitHub Go daily trending list, it hits the real pain of shared subscription quota and unified access.
uses: Developers who want to share one subscription quota across a team
Self-hosters needing a unified OpenAI-compatible gateway for multiple models
Engineers using Claude Code, Codex and similar tools at lower cost
Learners studying AI API relay and quota-distribution architecture

zh.tag: 跨平台资源嗅探下载工具，支持视频号、抖音等主流平台
zh.what: 一款基于代理抓包的资源下载工具，可嗅探并下载视频号、小程序、抖音、快手、小红书、酷狗、QQ音乐等平台的视频、音频、图片、m3u8和直播流。它通过设置系统代理拦截网络请求，筛选出可下载资源，降低普通用户获取素材的门槛。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go + Wails 桌面应用源码，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，提供发布版下载、在线文档、交流群及 Mini 版和 Electron 旧版分支。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言和 Wails 框架构建跨平台 GUI，依赖系统代理进行抓包，支持 m3u8 解析和视频解密，可能涉及证书安装。
zh.hot: 凭借对国内主流平台资源的广泛支持和简单易用的界面，该项目已获得 19780 颗星，本月新增 780 星，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 语言第 16 名。
uses: 需要下载视频号、抖音等平台素材的内容创作者和运营人员
希望保存直播流或 m3u8 视频用于个人学习的普通用户
研究网络抓包和资源嗅探技术的开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform resource sniffer and downloader for WeChat Channels, Douyin, and more
en.what: A proxy-based resource downloader that sniffs and downloads videos, audio, images, m3u8, and live streams from platforms like WeChat Channels, Mini Programs, Douyin, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, Kugou, and QQ Music. It intercepts network requests via system proxy and filters downloadable resources, making it easy for non-technical users to save media.
en.content: The repo contains full source code for a Go + Wails desktop app supporting Windows/macOS/Linux, with release downloads, online docs, community groups, plus a Mini version and an Electron legacy branch.
en.stack: Built with Go and Wails for cross-platform GUI, relies on system proxy for packet capture, supports m3u8 parsing and video decryption, and may require certificate installation.
en.hot: With broad support for popular Chinese platforms and an easy-to-use interface, it has gained 19,780 stars, adding 780 this month, ranking 16th on GitHub Trending monthly for Go.
uses: Content creators and operators who need to download materials from WeChat Channels, Douyin, etc.
Regular users who want to save live streams or m3u8 videos for personal learning
Developers researching network packet capture and resource sniffing techniques

zh.tag: 面向智能体系统的超低延迟模型路由，改个端点即可降本 40-70%
zh.what: weave-os/router 是一个面向智能体（agentic）系统的模型路由器，能在 50 毫秒内把每条提示词分发到最合适的模型上。它通过替换 API 端点的方式接入，无需改动业务代码，即可在成本与效果之间自动权衡，宣称可降低 40% 至 70% 的开销。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 语言实现，主体是一个可独立部署的路由服务，包含路由决策逻辑、模型适配层与配置示例，README 以品牌视觉和架构图为主，代码结构围绕服务端与接入端点展开。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，依赖以标准库和轻量 HTTP/路由组件为主，通过兼容 OpenAI 风格的接口对接多家模型供应商，部署形态为独立服务或网关。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3351 颗星、总量 4274，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 语言第 19 名；在 LLM 成本焦虑和智能体大规模落地的双重背景下，一个「改端点就省钱」的路由层正好切中痛点。
uses: 正在构建多智能体或 LLM 应用的工程团队，希望在不改代码的前提下压低推理成本
需要按任务难度自动选择模型、兼顾质量与预算的 AI 平台与基础设施负责人
对推理延迟敏感、要求路由决策在 50ms 内完成的实时对话与 Agent 场景
想快速对比多家模型供应商效果与性价比的研究者和独立开发者

en.tag: Ultra-low-latency model router for agentic systems; cut costs 40-70% with just an endpoint change
en.what: weave-os/router is a model router for agentic systems that dispatches every prompt to the most suitable model in under 50ms. It plugs in by simply changing an endpoint, requiring no business-code changes, and claims to cut costs by 40-70% by automatically balancing cost and quality.
en.content: The repo is written in Go and centers on a standalone deployable routing service, including routing-decision logic, a model adapter layer, and configuration examples; the README leans on brand visuals and architecture diagrams, with code organized around the server and its endpoint.
en.stack: Primarily Go, relying mostly on the standard library and lightweight HTTP/routing components; it connects to multiple model providers through OpenAI-compatible APIs and deploys as a standalone service or gateway.
en.hot: It gained 3,351 stars this month (4,274 total), landing at No. 19 on GitHub Trending's monthly Go chart; amid LLM cost anxiety and the agent boom, a routing layer that saves money via an endpoint swap hits the sweet spot.
uses: Engineering teams building multi-agent or LLM apps who want to cut inference costs without code changes
AI platform and infra leads who need automatic model selection balancing quality and budget
Latency-sensitive real-time chat and agent scenarios requiring routing decisions under 50ms
Researchers and indie developers comparing model providers on quality and cost-efficiency

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached
zh.what: Dragonfly 是一个现代化的内存数据存储，专为现代应用负载设计。它完全兼容 Redis 和 Memcached API，无需修改代码即可迁移。相比传统内存存储，吞吐量提升 25 倍，资源消耗降低 80%。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎源码、文档、基准测试、构建指南以及多语言 README。还提供了 Docker 镜像和云服务入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Linux 内核特性如 epoll 和 io_uring。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Helm charts 用于 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 作为 Redis 和 Memcached 的现代替代品，凭借惊人的性能提升和资源节省，在 C++ 社区持续火爆，今日新增 77 星，总星数达 31150。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟缓存服务的后端开发团队，可无缝替代 Redis。
希望在降低基础设施成本的同时提升性能的运维和架构师。
对内存数据库内部实现感兴趣的 C++ 开发者，可阅读源码学习。

en.tag: High-performance in-memory data store, Redis & Memcached compatible
en.what: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to adopt. Compared to legacy in-memory datastores, it delivers 25X more throughput and uses up to 80% less resources.
en.content: The repository contains core engine source code, documentation, benchmarks, build guides, and multi-language READMEs. It also provides Docker images and a cloud service entry point.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Linux kernel features like epoll and io_uring. Supports Docker deployment and provides Helm charts for Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for Redis and Memcached, it gains popularity in the C++ community due to its impressive performance gains and resource savings, with 77 new stars today and 31,150 total.
uses: Backend teams needing high-throughput, low-latency caching, seamlessly replacing Redis.
Ops and architects aiming to cut infrastructure costs while boosting performance.
C++ developers interested in the internals of in-memory databases for learning.

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。

uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.

Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是一个跨平台的机器学习推理和训练加速器，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow/Keras 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn、LightGBM、XGBoost 等经典机器学习库。它通过硬件加速器、图优化和变换，在不同硬件、驱动和操作系统上提供最佳性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ONNX Runtime 的完整源代码、文档、示例和发布版本，以及用于推理和训练的示例仓库和插件执行提供程序（如 QNN）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#、Java），并依赖 ONNX 格式和硬件加速库（如 CUDA、TensorRT）。
zh.hot: 作为微软开源的跨平台推理引擎，ONNX Runtime 在 AI 部署领域具有重要地位，本月新增 306 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 需要在多种硬件（CPU、GPU、NPU）上部署机器学习模型的开发者
希望加速 PyTorch 或 TensorFlow 模型推理的工程团队

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training accelerator for machine learning, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras, as well as classical ML libraries such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, and XGBoost. It leverages hardware accelerators, graph optimizations, and transforms to deliver optimal performance across various hardware, drivers, and operating systems.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and releases for ONNX Runtime, along with companion sample repositories for inference and training, and plugin execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for multiple languages (e.g., Python, C#, Java), and relies on the ONNX format and hardware acceleration libraries (e.g., CUDA, TensorRT).
en.hot: As Microsoft's open-source cross-platform inference engine, ONNX Runtime holds a key position in AI deployment, gaining 306 stars this month and continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Developers deploying ML models on diverse hardware (CPU, GPU, NPU)
Engineering teams looking to accelerate PyTorch or TensorFlow model inference
Enterprises needing a unified cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS) inference solution
AI infrastructure engineers researching model optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: Windows 开源用户态调试器，主打逆向工程与恶意软件分析

CTF 参赛者用于解决逆向工程挑战题。

en.tag: Open-source user-mode debugger for Windows, focused on reverse engineering and malware analysis
en.what: x64dbg is an open-source user-mode debugger for Windows, designed for reverse engineering and malware analysis. It supports debugging both 32-bit and 64-bit executables, offers a wide range of features, and is extensible via a comprehensive plugin system.

Malware analysts debug and analyze malicious samples in controlled environments.
Security enthusiasts learn assembly and low-level OS mechanisms.
CTF players solve reverse engineering challenges with it.

zh.tag: 为 AzerothCore 私服注入类真人玩家机器人
zh.what: 这是 AzerothCore 的一个模块，能为魔兽世界私服添加行为像真人玩家的机器人。它可以把你的小号变成机器人登录，也能生成随机机器人四处游荡、做任务、组队，模拟真实 MMO 体验。

私服管理员，用机器人填充世界、提升活跃度
研究游戏 AI 与 MMO 机器人行为的技术爱好者

en.what: This is an AzerothCore module that adds player-like bots to a World of Warcraft private server. It can log in your alt characters as bots and spawn random bots that wander, quest, and group up, simulating a real MMO experience.

Game AI enthusiasts studying MMO bot behavior

zh.tag: 英特尔开源深度学习推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是英特尔开源的深度学习推理优化与部署工具包，可将训练好的模型转换并加速到 CPU、GPU、NPU 等硬件上运行。它覆盖计算机视觉、语音识别、生成式 AI 与 NLP 等常见任务，支持从边缘到云端的部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 推理引擎、模型转换与优化工具（如 Model Optimizer、NNCF 量化）、多语言绑定（Python/Node.js/C）、示例教程与文档，并有 openvino.genai 等配套仓库。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为核心，提供 Python、Node.js、C 等绑定，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX、Keras、PaddlePaddle、JAX/Flax 及 Hugging Face 模型，可通过 pip、conda、npm、brew 安装。
zh.hot: 作为英特尔主推的推理部署方案，OpenVINO 在边缘 AI 与本地大模型推理需求增长下持续受关注，本月新增 211 star，累计 10822，位列 GitHub C++ 月榜第 11。
uses: 需要在英特尔 CPU/GPU/NPU 上部署高性能推理的 AI 工程师
希望把 PyTorch/TensorFlow 模型优化并落地到边缘设备的开发者
从事计算机视觉、语音或生成式 AI 应用的产品与研究人员
想学习模型量化、转换与推理加速的学生和爱好者

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning inference
en.what: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning inference, converting trained models to run fast on CPU, GPU, and NPU hardware. It covers computer vision, speech recognition, generative AI, and NLP, from edge to cloud.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++ inference engine, model conversion and optimization tools (Model Optimizer, NNCF quantization), multi-language bindings (Python/Node.js/C), samples, tutorials, and docs, plus companion repos like openvino.genai.
en.stack: Core in C++ with Python, Node.js, and C bindings; supports PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, PaddlePaddle, JAX/Flax, and Hugging Face models, installable via pip, conda, npm, and brew.
en.hot: As Intel's flagship inference deployment solution, OpenVINO keeps gaining traction amid rising edge AI and local LLM inference demand, adding 211 stars this month for 10,822 total and ranking 11th on GitHub's monthly C++ trending list.
uses: AI engineers deploying high-performance inference on Intel CPU/GPU/NPU
Developers optimizing and shipping PyTorch/TensorFlow models to edge devices
Product teams and researchers working on vision, speech, or generative AI apps
Students and hobbyists learning model quantization, conversion, and inference acceleration

zh.tag: 可扩展分布式梯度提升库，支持多语言多平台
zh.what: XGBoost 是一个优化的分布式梯度提升库，旨在高效、灵活且可移植。它实现了梯度提升框架下的机器学习算法，提供并行树提升（GBDT、GBM），能够快速准确地解决许多数据科学问题。同一套代码可在 Kubernetes、Hadoop、Spark 等分布式环境运行，处理数十亿样本。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、多语言接口（Python、R、Java、Scala、C++ 等）、分布式集成（Spark、Dask、Flink 等）、文档、示例和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、R、Java、Scala 等语言绑定，支持分布式框架如 Spark、Dask、Flink 和 DataFlow。
zh.hot: XGBoost 是机器学习竞赛和工业界的经典工具，拥有 28.7k 星标，本月新增 126 星，持续活跃。其高效性和多平台支持使其成为数据科学家的首选。
uses: 数据科学家和机器学习工程师用于构建高性能的梯度提升模型，解决分类、回归和排序问题。
需要在大规模数据集上训练模型的企业，利用其分布式能力处理海量数据。
Kaggle 竞赛参与者，利用其准确性和速度提升模型表现。
研究人员和开发者，通过其多语言接口集成到现有系统中。

en.tag: Scalable, portable, distributed gradient boosting library for multiple languages and platforms
en.what: XGBoost is an optimized distributed gradient boosting library designed to be highly efficient, flexible, and portable. It implements machine learning algorithms under the Gradient Boosting framework, providing parallel tree boosting (GBDT, GBM) that solves many data science problems fast and accurately. The same code runs on major distributed environments (Kubernetes, Hadoop, Spark, etc.) and can handle billions of examples.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ implementation, multi-language interfaces (Python, R, Java, Scala, C++), distributed integrations (Spark, Dask, Flink), documentation, examples, and tests.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for Python, R, Java, Scala, and more; supports distributed frameworks like Spark, Dask, Flink, and DataFlow.
en.hot: XGBoost is a classic tool in ML competitions and industry, with 28.7k stars and 126 new stars this month, remaining active. Its efficiency and multi-platform support make it a top choice for data scientists.
uses: Data scientists and ML engineers use it to build high-performance gradient boosting models for classification, regression, and ranking.
Enterprises needing to train models on large-scale datasets leverage its distributed capabilities to handle massive data.
Kaggle competitors utilize its accuracy and speed to improve model performance.
Researchers and developers integrate it into existing systems via its multi-language interfaces.

zh.tag: 快速本地神经语音合成引擎，支持多语言与离线部署
zh.what: Piper 是一个快速、本地的神经文本转语音（TTS）引擎，使用 espeak-ng 进行音素化，支持多种语言和声音。它可以在本地运行，无需联网，适合隐私敏感和低延迟场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心库 libpiper、Python 绑定、命令行工具、HTTP 服务器以及训练新声音的文档和脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 espeak-ng 进行音素化，提供 Python 包（piper-tts）和 C/C++ API，支持 pip 安装。
zh.hot: Piper 因其高质量、低延迟的本地 TTS 能力而受欢迎，已被 Home Assistant、NVDA 等知名项目采用。本月新增 459 星，总星数达 5536，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（C++）第 14 名。

嵌入式或边缘设备开发者，寻求轻量级 TTS 解决方案

en.tag: Fast local neural text-to-speech engine with offline, multilingual support
en.what: Piper is a fast, local neural text-to-speech engine that uses espeak-ng for phonemization and supports multiple languages and voices. It runs entirely offline, making it ideal for privacy-sensitive and low-latency applications.
en.content: The repository includes the C++ core library libpiper, Python bindings, a command-line interface, an HTTP server, and documentation/scripts for training new voices.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on espeak-ng for phonemization, provides a Python package (piper-tts) and C/C++ API, and supports pip installation.
en.hot: Piper is popular for its high-quality, low-latency local TTS capabilities and has been adopted by well-known projects like Home Assistant and NVDA. It gained 459 stars this month, reaching 5,536 total, and ranked 14th on GitHub Trending monthly (C++).
uses: Developers needing offline speech synthesis for smart homes, accessibility tools, etc.
Accessibility app developers providing text-to-speech for visually impaired users

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
